jobs.title: UK Public Relations Account Executive (UK Based)
jobs.excerpt: We’re growing, and officially expanding our services to the UK.
jobs.description:
We’re growing, and officially expanding our services to the UK. As part of this exciting new chapter, we’re looking for a UK-based Public Relations Account Executive who’s deeply plugged into the local media scene. You should know the UK press landscape like the back of your hand and have a strong pulse on what drives both editorial and influencer conversations across the region.

This AE will help lead accounts across media and influencer relations, thought leadership, and broader communications strategy. Depending on the client, work may also include content creation and distribution, social strategy and management, and data-driven reporting and analysis.

Account Executives at our agency are execution pros—skilled at juggling multiple accounts and consistently delivering polished work. You’ll interact directly with clients via email, calls, and meetings, and eventually become the day-to-day lead on 4+ accounts, steering execution, communications, and reporting with oversight from an Account Supervisor or Director. AEs also often play specialist roles within larger, integrated teams.

The right person will be based in the UK, confident, adaptable, and eager to grow. You learn fast, communicate clearly, and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment. While we’re headquartered in Miami, this is a full-time role with Work-From-Anywhere flexibility (see benefits for more).


Some things to note about this role:

  • Key responsibility is to consistently produce results within our core services of media and influencer relations.
  • AE's are highly skilled at media facing communications including trade shows, media events, and pitches.
  • AE's are confident in all aspects of written and face-to-face client communications.
  • Successful AE's leverage personal experience and agency expertise to proactively lead their client's strategy and should be comfortable telling clients what they need to hear versus what they want to hear.
  • AE's are execution specialists, constantly reiterating their daily approach to become more efficient.
  • Always learning is key to the advancement of this role, be a student and participant of client communications and strategy development, actively seeking out every opportunity to learn from agency senior team leads.
  • The ability to clearly articulate how results produced coincide with client's goals / objectives, is highly valued and should be a focus as it is a common skill of team members that grow beyond the AE role.

Cover Letter:Feel free to include a cover letter detailing something interesting about yourself and/or career that we will not get from reading your resume. Doesn't need to be long, just specific to this position. It’s your opportunity to sell yourself, use it.

About MBA: We are a "Best Agency to Work For" and the leading PR agency for consumer technology and innovative lifestyle brands in the U.S. Headquartered in Miami since 2002 (with a full-remote team), we have partnered with more than 800 brands from startups to Fortune 500. We successfully help clients launch, gain market share, enter new categories, sell products, attract retailers, raise capital and get acquired. In addition to providing public relations and digital marketing services, we also offer an in-house primary research and analytics team, and a design studio with a full suite of creative services.

Some advice for how to be successful:

We hire, promote and fire people based on these values. They act as a compass for all communications and decision making.

  • Think Like An Entrepreneur: Know the details of our business and understand how you impact our culture, work and financial success.
  • Adopt a Growth Mindset: Don’t settle or become complacent. Grow by taking advantage of opportunities to do work outside your comfort zone.
  • Take Initiative: Do not wait for someone to tell you what to do. Act in the absence of specific direction. Be proactive and decisive.
  • Act with Purpose: Focus on impact above all else. Know the intended result, find the most efficient path, and get shit done.
  • Communicate Assertively: Proactively tackle difficult conversations with empathy and confidence. Give and request feedback in real-time with helpful intent.
  • Inspire Accountability: Embrace ownership of every task. Surface your mistakes. Share what you learn and use it to improve. Others will do the same.

Other things we think would be cool if you could do:

  • Run a 5k in under 25 minutes
    • We have 2 or 3 people that can do this, but we have a couple Ironman athletes (including Max), a few marathoners and a mountain biker who does 80+ mile races. Lots of yogis too.
  • Solve a Rubik's cube in under a minute
    • We had an intern that could and it was mind-blowing.
  • Compete in Brazilian Jiu Jitsu
    • She competed in the Pan-American Championship, largest Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu tournament in North America, she's also one of our new Account Coordinators.
  • Climb Mt. Kilimanjaro
    • Our Director of Operations did this, only blacked-out from high altitude and oxygen deprivation once. Nailed it.
  • Be a world champion in anything
    • Youngest Yo-Yo World Champion in history worked with us for years.
  • Start your own business
    • Max did...and one guy owns his own photography business...the rest of us are working on it.
  • A snake shot (Foosball)
    • Google it. No spinning.

Requirements

  • Ideally, minimum 2 years of relevant PR or marketing experience. Prior agency setting is strongly preferred
  • Understanding of product launches, brand storytelling and media and influencer relations strategies
  • Understanding of digital/new media marketing strategies
  • Expert in persuasive writing and verbal communication
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills
  • Awesomeness

Benefits

Work hard, play hard is slightly outdated and work life balance implies some sort of struggle to do one and not the other. We think work should be a fun, beneficial, and enjoyable part of your life and that your life should be a fun, beneficial, and enjoyable part of your work. We try our best to provide benefits that make this a reality, and the daily transition and integration of work & life as seamless as possible.

  • Unlimited Vacation
    • It's EXACTLY what it sounds like.
  • Work-From-Anywhere-Flexibility
    • Truly work-from-anywhere with flexible schedules, which for some people means fully-remote, WFH 100% and for some includes a combo of home and our Miami office.
    • Approximately 30% of our 50 person team is located outside of South Florida.
  • We set you up from day 1 with all the tools to get shit done regardless of physical location.
  • For the Moms and Dads out there…We have 20+ baby humans in our extended family, needless to say we accommodate the hectic schedules of SuperMoms and SuperDads. 100% flexible schedule helps, but accommodating school drop-offs, and unforeseen events is our specialty and you’ll have the team support to do so with ease. If you would like to speak to one of our parents about their schedule, team support they receive, our maternity/paternity policy and new parent benefits, let us know.
  • Social gatherings are a weekly occurrence. We all actually like hanging out with each other, so we find time in a variety of ways including team lunches, happy hours, in person group work sessions, etc. And for those fully-remote outside Miami, there will be one or two occasions throughout the year you can join us in Miami for special events. We also hold weekly virtual meetings and lunches.
  • Benefits
    • Flexibility – “Unlimited” and “Anywhere” is as Flexible as it Gets
      • Home Office Stipend
    • Growth – Expand and Fine Tune Your Skills
      • Free Unlimited Self-Help/Business Books
    • Wellness – Add Workout to Your Work Day
      • $600 annual Fitness/Wellness Stipend
      • Parental Leave + Paid Return-To-Work
    • Finance – “Match” is Literally Free Money
      • $360 Annual Cell Data Reimbursement
    • Team – You Will Actually Like Most of Us
      • $1,500 Employee Referral Bonus
    • Fun – Mandatory Company Meetings
      • Paid Miami Visits for Remote Team

Workers Compensation Claims Adjuster (Midwest Region)

Location: Work from Home

Who says you can't have it all? Cottingham & Butler Claims Services (CBCS) is offering the opportunity to work in a fast-paced and exciting position with NO commute! You will be working from home so previous workers compensation adjusting experience is required (i.e. taking statements, paying lost wage benefits, filing state forms, denying claims, subrogation, litigation, etc.).

As a Work Comp Adjuster, you will be responsible for investigating, evaluating, negotiating, and settling workers compensation claims on behalf of our clients. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication and negotiation skills, be detail-oriented, and possess a strong understanding of workers compensation laws and regulations. You will be communicating with a wide variety of individuals, to include CEO's, claimants, providers offices, and attorneys. Experience handling claims in multiple jurisdictions is vital for success in this role.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 1 year experience as a workers compensation claims adjuster.
  • License/state experience in the midwest.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of workers compensation laws and regulations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Proficiency in computer programs, including Microsoft Office and claims management software.

If you are looking for a position that will allow you to stay in claims, continue to grow in your career, and also have the flexibility that working from home allows, this is the position for you. We will provide your office equipment and IT support, as well as training and support from our home office.

If this sounds like a good fit to your career and life goals, we'd love to talk!

Pay & Benefits

  • Salary – Flexible based on your experience level.
  • Most Benefits start Day 1
  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • Flex Spending or HSA
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Profit-Sharing/ Defined Contribution (1-year waiting period)
  • PTO/ Paid Holidays
  • Company-paid ST and LT Disability
  • Maternity Leave/ Parental Leave
  • Company-paid Term Life/ Accidental Death Insurance

Cottingham & Butler

At Cottingham & Butler, we sell a promise to help our clients through life’s toughest moments. To deliver on that promise, we aim to hire, train, and grow the best professionals in the industry. We look for people with an insatiable desire to succeed, are committed to growing, and thrive on challenges. Our culture is guided by the theme of “better every day” constantly pushing ourselves to be better than yesterday – that’s who we are and what we believe in.

As an organization, we are tremendously optimistic about the future and have incredibly high expectations for our people and our performance. Our ability to grow as a company, fuels investments in new resources to better serve our clients and provide the amazing career opportunities our employees want and deserve. This is why we are a growth company and why we are committed to being better every day.

Job Description:

The Nextpower Sales Analyst will input and manage all aspects of customer projects information within the CRM system, generate quotations and comprehensive proposals based on project technical requirements and customer specific needs. The Senior Sales Analyst works closely with the Project Engineering, Logistics, Operations and Finance teams to ensure that Nextpower is consistently exceeding customer expectations while ensuring sales maintains maximum margin contribution. This role will include a mix of internal and external management responsibilities. Internally, coordinating and driving departments to provide associated inputs to quotations. Externally, following up with customers for information and tasking work to outside contractors. The Analyst will support Account Managers, Sales Directors and other Sales Leaders on the Global Sales Team with significant learning opportunities.

We are looking for someone who demonstrates:

· Exemplary critical thinking skills

· Tenacious and commitment to execution and efficiency

· Independent and self-motivated worker

· Solution orientated

· Intense collaboration and teamwork

· Passionate customer focus

· Commitment to thoughtful, fast, disciplined execution

· Exemplary written and oral communication skills

· Relentless drive to win

· Keen attention to detail

· Ability to anticipate and quickly react to changing market conditions

· Exceptional time management and multitasking skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) how you will measure success:

  • Achieving / Exceeding group sales targets.
  • Data cleanliness in CRM system
  • Ability to coordinate and drive different departments to hit customer due dates
  • Support of other team members
  • Accuracy and completeness of handoff packages for the Operations team
  • 90% of allocated leads are followed up and closed out
  • Bid strategy summary report

Here is a glimpse of what you’ll do:

  • Sales Analyst team will divide, follow up, and close incoming US leads
  • Run bid strategy meeting for projects before quotes are released to customer
  • Working with your Sale Leader, you will assume functional control of complex multi-$M opportunities and usher them through the NX Sale Process from Customer RFP to contract execution and handoff.
  • Manage day-to-day interactions with key account stakeholders
  • Coordinate sales proposals with key stakeholders
  • Provide creative input to bid strategy
  • Track sales activities using NetSuite ERP and Salesforce CRM
  • Manage all CRM system reporting, improvements and modifications
  • Generate Sales reports & Presentations, and present to a wide variety of stake holders
  • Create and maintain sales models, ensuring positive contribution margin on all Nextpower sales
  • Work closely with the Global Sales/Business Development Team on creative deal structuring and bid strategy
  • Work closely with Marketing & Product Management Team to provide input on new products
  • Work with Customer Care to ensure efficient communications and provide excellent customer satisfaction
  • Continually streamline, standardize and improve proposal templates, bankability binders, and client presentations
  • Form excellent working relationships with other Nextpower departments, including Customer Applications, Cost Accounting, Logistics, and Engineering to ensure on-time delivery and best in class quality of all Nextpower products.
  • Support the Director of Sales Operations and Manager of Sales Analysis on an ad-hoc basis
  • Other job related duties as assigned

Here is some of what you’ll need (required):

  • 5+ Years of B2B Sales Support experience
  • BS/BA in a business or technical field (MBA desired)
  • Sales analysis, financial analysis, business development, and/or program management experience
  • Solar experience and passion for solar always a plus
  • Proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Experience utilizing CRM (Salesforce preferred) and ERP (Netsuite preferred) systems
  • Proven analytical background
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Demonstrated attention to detail in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel to meet customer 20% of the time

Nextpower offers a comprehensive benefits package. We provide health care coverage, dental and vision, 401(K) participation including company matching, company paid holidays with unlimited paid time off, generous discretionary company bonuses, life and disability protection and more. Employees in certain positions may be eligible for stock compensation. All plans are in accordance with relevant plan documents. For more information on Nextpower’s benefits please view our company website at www.Nextpower.com

Pay is based on market location and may vary based on factors including experience, skills, education and other job-related reasons. The annual salary range for this position is 90,000.00 to 105,000.00 plus a commission structure based on commission calculation, such as percentage of sales or specific metrics.(Applicable to California)

NEXRSR

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.

Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We are Nextpower

We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Software Engineer to join a highly innovative deep-tech environment, working on complex engineering challenges at the intersection of software and AI

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role where you will work across the full stack to understand customer problems, rapidly prototype solutions, and build production-ready applications that deliver real value.

The Role

You will:

  • Work directly with customers to understand their engineering challenges and shape impactful software solutions.

  • Build rapid prototypes, gather user feedback, and iterate toward production-ready applications.

  • Develop and maintain REST APIs and microservices using Python and FastAPI.

  • Work with data scientists and machine learning engineers to bring advanced physics models into customer-facing applications.

  • Deploy and operate applications using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, AWS

  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, designers, and platform teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

  • Identify reusable components and contribute improvements to the core platform.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience delivering applications to production.

  • Strong experience with Python, backend development, REST APIs, and microservices.

  • Experience with FastAPI or similar Python frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform.

  • Experience working with AWS

  • Ability to take ownership of complex problems and drive solutions end-to-end.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments.

  • Excellent communication skills and confidence working directly with customers.

Nice to Have

  • Background in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Aerospace, or another engineering discipline.

  • Experience with scientific computing, machine learning, simulation, or physics-based applications.

  • Experience in a customer-facing, solutions engineering, consulting, or forward-deployed role.

Working Conditions

  • Full-time, 40h/week

  • 1099 Contract initially

  • PTO provided

  • Background check required

Our values

We are a company that seeks the best for both our employees and clients, reaching beyond expectations in turning dreams into reality. Our way of working is rooted in our core values (Integrity, Excellence, Proactivity, Innovation, and People), with an expectation that our future colleagues will make these their second nature in their everyday work and life. We don’t ask for perfection, but we do appreciate people motivated to better themselves in every conceivable aspect.

About IT Labs

Founded in 2005, IT Labs is an international software tech company, specializing in purpose and process-driven teams for high-performance, innovation, transformation, and efficiency. Our HQ is in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, and we have teams around the world - the UK, the Netherlands, Brazil, Argentina, Serbia, Croatia, BIH, Montenegro, North Macedonia, and the Middle East. We are constantly growing, and we would love for you to become part of our team!

This is a versatile senior C# pod, not four slots on one project. Nice to have (strong pluses)

•AI coding tool experience.

  • Cloud (Azure or AWS), containerization, CI/CD.

This is a remote role. CircleLink Health is looking for passionate, tech savvy registered nurses to work remotely and serve patients enrolled in Medicare’s Chronic Care Management Program. In this part time role (about 20-25 hrs. per week), an RN Care Coach will be assigned a group of patients that they will be following and calling each month. In these monthly calls you will provide education, coordinate care, close preventive care gaps, and coach on strategies for self-management to keep them out of the hospital.

This Role Requires Precision, Discipline, and Accountability

The Care Manager role is not a step back from bedside nursing — it’s a step into a more complex, structured, and performance-driven environment. To succeed, you must bring more than clinical knowledge:

✅ Excellent documentation skills — Your charting must be complete, timely, and accurate.

✅ Strong time management — Case tasks must be prioritized and closed on schedule.

✅ Ownership of outcomes — Each case is closely tracked for quality, compliance, and effectiveness.

Expectations are high, and performance is regularly reviewed. This is not a role where details can be missed or timelines pushed — we need professionals who take initiative, stay organized, and consistently deliver.

If you’re ready for a challenging, fast-paced environment where your work is held to high standards and makes a real difference, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Utilize our specialized care management software to call Medicare patients with 2 or more chronic conditions (Diabetes, CHF, Chronic Pain, COPD, etc.) on a monthly basis
  • Build and maintain rapport with patients to help coach them to improved health through SMART goals and education on self-management strategies
  • Implement and improve the Plan of Care by updating medications, appointments due, biometrics, symptoms, and interventions made
  • Connect the patient with community resources as needed, including transportation, personal care needs, prescription/DME assistance, social services, etc.
  • Conduct Transitional Care Management activities to high risk patients discharged from the hospital and the ER to reduce unnecessary readmissions.
  • Close care gaps by encouraging and assisting with preventive care measures, i.e. annual well visits, vaccines, cancer screens, follow-up/specialist appointments, etc.

Requirements

  • Fluent in English
  • Self-directed, able to work independently with little supervision while meeting performance metrics
  • Passion for nursing and improving patient outcomes
  • Good with technology and eager to learn and use new software
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Timely communication is essential, and nurses are expected to respond to all messages and emails within 24–48 hours.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

Education and Experience:

  • Current, unrestricted Compact License / multistate RN license
  • Proficiency with electronic health records and web-based applications
  • 3+ years' experience as a Registered Nurse

Preferred Education and Experience, but not required:

  • Spanish fluency
  • Case Management or Chronic Disease Management experience highly preferred
  • Certified Diabetes Educator
  • Experience with Motivational Interviewing or other behavior change communication techniques

Scheduling and Other Requirements

  • RN needs a STRONG internet-connected computer
  • Minimum of 20 hours of availability per week required
  • You will commit to your own schedule using our software.
  • This is a 1099 contract position with no end date. Care coaches are responsible for their own taxes and insurance.

Benefits

Compensation:

RN Care Coach compensation is paid at the rate of $15.00 for the first 20-minute increment (20-min milestone), $12 for the second 20-minute increment (40-min milestone), and$11.50 for the 3rd 20-minute increment (60-min milestone).

A clinical encounter occurs after two criteria are met: 1/ A successful interactive clinical call with the patient or their caregiver. 2/ A 20-min, or 40-min, or 60-min milestone is met on the patient's chart. Example pay scenarios, but not limited to:

  • Two 20-min successful calls with 2 different patients pays $30 for the two 20-min visits. ($15+$15=$30)
  • A 40-min encounter with the same patient pays $27. ($15+$12=$27).
  • A 60-min encounter with the same patient pays $38.50. ($15+$12+$11.50=$38.50)

Pay Timing:

Monthly via direct deposit, 40 days after the last day of the month of service. This is due to the time it takes Medicare to process reimbursements. Your pay after the first check will be 30 days from the end of the previous month.

Fraud Alert:

CircleLink Health has identified fraudulent emails sent from @joincirclelinkhealth.team, which is NOT affiliated with our company. Official CircleLink emails come only from @circlelinkhealth.com. Please report any suspicious messages to .

About CircleLink Health:

CircleLink Health is a company of passionate clinicians, technologists and businesspeople tackling the $600B problem of preventable chronic and post-acute complications. We’re building a world-class Care Management platform to enable providers while accelerating the shift to preventative care instead of status quo reactive care. Learn more about us here.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are At Heart & Stroke our mission is to promote health, save lives and enhance recovery.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Heart & Stroke our mission is to promote health, save lives and enhance recovery. We are committed to a culture that exemplifies our core values: champion health, practice humility, embrace change, drive impact, learn and grow and be heartfelt as we work together to beat heart disease and stroke.

We believe in equity, diversity and inclusion ― it’s embedded in our values and core mission work to support all people in Canada to lead healthier lives. We are committed to applying this principle to cultivate a welcoming environment that embraces diversity among our employees. Candidates from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to, Indigenous peoples, racialized communities, 2SLGBTQIA+ communities, women, and people living with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

To learn more about our mission, values, commitment to EDI, and the difference Heart & Stroke makes in the lives of people in Canada at every age, please visit our website.

The opportunity

Please note Heart & Stroke offers a hybrid work option, and candidates can work from anywhere in Canada. There is also occasional travel (including overnight) required up to 10 days/year.

We are currently looking for a Senior Manager, Research Management & Impact role to join our Research & Science team. Reporting to the Vice President, Research & Science, the role oversees the post funding management and impact of Heart & Stroke funded research. This role is accountable for leading the administration of Heart & Stroke’s funded research portfolio, including compliance, post-funding management, reporting, and processes that support the measurement, maximization, and communication of research impact.

A core part of the role is the administration, compliance, and oversight of Heart & Stroke’s funded research portfolio across the post-funding lifecycle. This includes ensuring that recipients and institutions meet funding requirements, overseeing payment and claims processes, supporting annual reporting, coordinating mid-point reviews, managing end-of-funding reporting, and identifying and escalating risks or issues that may affect accountability, stewardship, or compliance. The role also supports annual business planning, process improvement, and the modernization of research management and reporting systems to strengthen efficiency, data quality, and organizational insight.

The role will also lead the identification, interpretation, and communication of the impact of Heart & Stroke funded research. Working closely with the VP, Research & Science and cross-functional partners, the role develops approaches to capture, analyze, and translate research outcomes into meaningful insights, narratives, and evidence-informed recommendations. Through these approaches the role serves to support organizational strategy, knowledge mobilization, marketing, fundraising, advocacy, and mission priorities. Finally, the role serves as a key functional lead for research and science impact by supporting effective, integrated, and coordinated action that helps position the organization at the leading edge of evolving evidence and best practices in heart and brain health.

How you will make an impact every day

Annual business planning, implementation and coordination of Heart & Stroke funded grants and awards

  • Leads the annual planning process for post-award management and research impact, establishing priorities, deliverables, timelines, governance, and resource requirements aligned with organizational strategy.

  • Creates the knowledge translation and mobilization framework for Heart & Stroke research, ensuring it aligns with the Foundation’s impact goals and performance strategy.

  • Offers strategic leadership in the development and implementation of knowledge translation and mobilization initiatives for Heart & Stroke funded research.

  • Directs cross-functional planning and prioritization with input from mission leadership to identify key research and science impacts of Heart & Stroke programs.

  • Leads the identification, assessment, and interpretation of research and science impacts relevant to Heart & Stroke priorities, translating insights into recommendations for programs, strategy, and mission execution.

  • Advises senior leadership on risks, trade-offs, and opportunities related to research management and impact frameworks, practices, policies and procedures.

  • Leads organizational alignment of research and science impact work with mission strategy, ensuring a coordinated and consistent approach across functions, priorities, and audiences.

  • Establishes governance, decision-making, and escalation processes for post-award management and research impact work, balancing risk, capacity, and organizational priorities.

Post grant and award management and administration

  • Leads the post-award compliance function, ensuring grant holders and host institutions adhere to grant agreements, policies, and reporting requirements, and establishing risk-based approaches for monitoring and escalation.

  • Provides strategic leadership and subject-matter expertise to the SRC budget review process, including the refinement of budget review guidelines, adjudication standards, and stewardship expectations.

  • Oversees the integrity of post-award financial records and reporting, ensuring accurate tracking, reconciliation, and contribution to departmental financial planning and annual reporting.

  • Oversees post-award claims and payment processes, ensuring strong financial controls, policy adherence, stewardship of funds, and timely resolution of complex issues.

  • Exercises decision-making authority over non-routine post-award financial and compliance issues, assessing risk, determining appropriate resolution or escalation, and safeguarding organizational resources and reputation.

  • Partners with Finance to strengthen controls, forecasting, reporting, audit readiness, and stewardship practices related to funded research.

Business analysis and research information management

  • Leads the modernization of grant management, reporting, and knowledge translation systems, identifying and implementing improved processes, tools, and technologies that strengthen efficiency, data quality, and organizational insight.

  • Establishes organizational frameworks and standards for research program metrics and performance reporting, and synthesizes findings into actionable insights for senior leadership decision-making.

  • Leads the design, implementation, and evaluation of progress and final reporting mechanisms to strengthen evidence capture, compliance oversight, mission impact assessment, and organizational learning.

Translation of funded research results to support marketing and fundraising.

  • Leads enterprise-wide cross-functional approaches in collaboration with department specialists to translate funded research into impact narratives and stories that will support digital, marketing, communications and development.

  • Shapes the research and science content strategy in collaboration with the VP, Research and Science for fundraising and marketing campaigns by identifying timely, credible, and mission-relevant discoveries, milestones, and impact stories.

  • Contribute to fundraising and marketing campaigns e.g. year end, heart month, stroke month with relevant high-value research impact narratives, opportunity identification, and scientifically sound positioning of Heart & Stroke funded research.

  • Partners with Development leadership to inform, strategize and support fundraising plans to maximize the impact of Heart & Stroke research programs.

  • Synthesizes and interprets research impact data to inform fundraising, health information, public awareness, and stewardship priorities.

  • Leads and advises on the accurate, timely, and audience-appropriate dissemination of mission impact stories and research evidence across organizational channels (i.e., fundraising, development, marketing and communications teams).

  • Provide input on funded research content and data for donor proposals and pitches.

  • Serves as a key advisor to the VP, Research and Science and other leaders on research impact strategy.

Team Leadership

  • Provide clear direction, guidance and feedback on day-to-day activities and priorities.

  • Builds a high-performing, collaborative team culture that enables strong cross-functional partnership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • In partnership with the Vice President, Research and Science, establishes performance plan and objectives and review on an ongoing basis.

  • As required, recruit skilled talent in support of current and future Foundation needs, following Foundation policies, interviewing methodology and assessment guidelines.

  • Familiarize and comply with all Heart & Stroke policies while ensuring accurate administration of employee related information: absence records, vacation, title, etc.

Who we need

Education

  • Masters in science within a health research related field

  • Cerebrovascular and cardiovascular subject matter expertise is a strong asset.

  • Knowledge related to knowledge translation and mobilization frameworks, required.

  • Knowledge related to the Canadian health research system and health care delivery, required.

Experience

  • Minimum 7 years’ experience in a management role.

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in research, with a preference for health research grant management and administration, including compliance, progress reporting, financial claims, and grant close-out.

  • Experience in analyzing and interpreting research and clinical data.

  • Experience managing operational budgets and external vendors/consultants (SOWs, contracts, deliverables, performance).

  • Experience in bringing together a range of constituents in pursuit of shared objectives, aligned to organizational values and policy position, including people with lived experience.

  • Experience in planning knowledge translation and mobilization frameworks to support evidence-informed health policy and practice.

  • Experience in a cross-functional role in an organization that crosses departments and seeks overall alignment.

  • Demonstrated experience implementing KT/KM initiatives (e.g., evidence-to-action products, convenings, practice/policy engagement, dissemination strategies) and measuring uptake.

  • Extensive knowledge of frameworks and tools required to promote and measure health equity, including anti-oppressive and anti-racist strategies,

  • Demonstrated understanding of Indigenous history, colonization, racism, and Calls to Action

  • Experience engaging external partners with a focus on building health equity within the cardiovascular and stroke health system in Canada.

Skills

  • Excellent leadership skills and ability to influence others by articulating sound, rational arguments.

  • Ability to establish, lead and maintain positive working relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, influencing teams within and outside your department.

  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills are essential. Strong writing skills are imperative.

  • Exercises sound judgment in ambiguous situations.

  • Ability to translate complex scientific information into practical organizational action.

  • Demonstrated leadership of enterprise cross-functional initiatives with governance, deliverables, timelines, and risk management.

  • Ability to develop trusting relationships and partnerships with diverse groups and co-create win-win solutions that advance the Foundation’s mission.

  • Excellent strategic thinking and change management skills

  • Excellent presentation, verbal and written communication skills to prepare wide range of outputs and help stakeholders understand data/evidence. Effective communicator both verbally and in written formats; capable of communicating technical content to audiences at varying levels of knowledge

  • Desire and ability to acquire technical knowledge of the scientific and research issues associated with heart disease and stroke

  • Ability to work inter-departmentally and to communicate effectively with senior volunteers and staff across the Foundation, providing guidance and supporting its application.

  • Strong computer skills and ability to use technological tools to organize and advance the work of the team (i.e., MS Office Suite, SharePoint, CRM and other workflow tools, digital engagement platforms).

  • An ability to work in both official languages is an asset.

What we offer

At Heart & Stroke, we make it a priority to foster a culture of caring by implementing practices and programs that foster respect, compassion, trust and attentiveness to our own and others’ health and well-being.

This role offers a hiring range of $95,000 to $119,000, aligned with our compensation framework and your professional background. We believe that time off is integral to the personal health and wellness of our employees. We offer a generous paid time-off package including vacation days, personal days, wellness days, and paid company-wide closure between December 25 and January 1. We also provide competitive health, medical, dental and vision benefits, life insurance, disability benefits, an employee assistance program (EAP) and a defined contribution pension plan with employer matching. Our employees also enjoy a flexible hybrid working model and reimbursement for mobile phones and home office setup, as well as opportunities for professional development.

Apply now

If you want to join the fight to beat heart disease and stroke, please apply by sending your resume by September 30,2026. Applicants must be currently residing in Canada and legally entitled to work in Canada.

Only those candidates that qualify will be selected for an interview. Interviews may be conducted virtually or in-person. Selected candidates will be notified in advance if an in-person interview is required.

Accommodation

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, barrier-free and accessible environment. If you have been contacted for an interview and require accommodation to participate in the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will do our best to address your needs.

jobs.description:
Who we are

At WELLSTAR, we are committed to reshaping Canadian healthcare by leveraging technology to address the administrative burdens that pull physicians away from their true calling—patient care. Our mission is to support providers and patients, shifting the emphasis back to quality, timeliness, and positive outcomes. With a comprehensive suite of technology solutions, we have successfully helped thousands of providers adopt and benefit from modern, interoperable technologies that improve patient outcomes and system efficiency.

Whether you are in research and development, administration, communications, operations leadership, or technology, joining us now is an opportunity to play a critical role in transforming how healthcare is managed and experienced in Canada.

The opportunity

WELLSTAR, a majority-owned subsidiary of WELL Health Technologies Corp, is a high-growth SaaS company with a focused objective of reshaping healthcare through digital enablement. Our innovative solutions are designed to streamline care delivery, integrate healthcare systems and improve patient outcomes.

Reporting to the VP, Product Management, we are hiring a Director, UI/UX Design to lead the design function for the Clinical Platform Group. As our new Director, UI/UX Design, you will lead and develop an established team of designers while owning the quality, consistency, and evolution of the end-to-end product experience. You will set the design direction for a modern, AI-first EMR platform, strengthen user research and design practices, and ensure the needs of clinicians remain central to how the product evolves. Working as a peer to Product and Engineering leadership, you will bring greater structure and consistency to how teams collaborate from problem definition and discovery through design, development, and release.

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada, with occasional travel for team on-sites and clinic visits.

What’s in it for you

Leadership and influence. You will step into an established design team with the opportunity to make a strong team even better. You will have the scope to develop designers, raise the bar on craft and consistency, and shape how the design function evolves as the product and organization grow. Working alongside Product and Engineering leadership, you will have a voice in decisions that influence both the product experience and how teams work together.

Shape an AI-first healthcare experience. You will help define how clinicians interact with AI in a product they rely on to deliver care. From how AI-generated suggestions are presented to how confidence, transparency, and clinician control are built into the experience, you will influence some of the most important design questions facing Nexus AI EMR as the platform evolves.

Build better ways of working. You will have the opportunity to strengthen and mature an existing design practice rather than build one from the ground up. You will refine research, design processes, cross-functional collaboration, and the design system, creating the structure that helps designers do their best work and enables Product, Design, and Engineering to move forward together.

What you will do:

  • Lead and develop the design team. You will coach and support an established team of designers, creating clear ownership, providing meaningful feedback, and helping each person build on their strengths and grow. You will foster a collaborative critique culture and create the conditions for the team to consistently deliver high-quality work.
  • Own the end-to-end product experience. You will be accountable for the quality, consistency, and coherence of the Clinical Platform Group product experience across clinical and administrative workflows. You will establish and uphold a high design standard, incorporating accessibility and clinical safety considerations into how experiences are designed and delivered.
  • Shape AI-assisted experiences. You will set the design direction for how AI is integrated into clinical workflows, including how suggestions are surfaced, confidence and provenance are communicated, and clinicians remain in control. You will help ensure AI-enabled experiences are practical, intuitive, and designed around the realities of clinical care.
  • Strengthen how Design, Product, and Engineering work together. You will partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to bring design into problem definition, discovery, refinement, and delivery. You will improve handoffs and feedback loops so requirements, designs, edge cases, and intended experiences are clearly understood and carried through to what is released.
  • Evolve design practices and systems. You will refine the design process from intake and discovery through critique, handoff, and design QA, keeping it structured without creating unnecessary complexity. You will champion the design system, patterns, documentation, and tools that help the team work efficiently and deliver a consistent experience.
  • Bring users closer to product decisions. You will establish a sustainable approach to user research, including interviews and engagement with clinics, and ensure insights are shared effectively across Design, Product, and Engineering. You will help turn what the team learns from clinicians and customers into meaningful improvements to the product and roadmap.

What you bring:

  • The design leadership experience. You have experience leading and developing product designers, including coaching, providing meaningful feedback, supporting career development, and managing performance. You know how to assess the strengths of an established team, build trust, and create the clarity and support people need to do their best work.
  • The product design expertise. You have designed and shipped complex, workflow-heavy software where usability, accuracy, and attention to detail matter. You bring strong design judgment and can critically evaluate work, challenge assumptions, and raise the quality and consistency of the user experience without imposing a rigid design philosophy.
  • The ability to evolve a design practice. You have improved how a design team operates, whether through stronger discovery and research practices, critique and review, design systems, handoffs, or design QA. You can introduce structure without unnecessary process and understand how to measure whether changes are making the team and the product better.
  • The cross-functional approach. You have worked closely with Product and Engineering teams in an agile product environment and understand how design fits into discovery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, development, and release. Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to build, and scale the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform, currently under development. If you thrive at the intersection of innovation and execution, this role is your chance to lead transformative projects and help shape Kestra’s future.

What you would do

  • Architect, build, and scale the infrastructure for Kestra’s SaaS platform.

  • Automate cloud resource provisioning and management to enhance reliability and efficiency.

  • Optimize monitoring, deployment, and repair systems to ensure high availability.

  • Improve and maintain CI/CD pipelines for smooth, reliable deployments.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and application issues promptly.

  • Drive innovation with solutions that enhance engineering productivity.

Our Tech Stack

  • Datastore: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch

  • Queuing: Redis, Kafka, Google Pub/Sub

  • Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes

  • IAC: Terraform

  • Cloud: GCP, AWS

  • Monitoring: ELK, Prometheus, Grafana

  • Deployment: ArgoCD

  • Tools: GitHub for repo management, actions, and issues

We work with a variety of modern technologies, and you’ll get the opportunity to explore new tools and approaches as we grow.

What we are looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or similar infrastructure-focused roles.

  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes and Terraform, with hands-on experience in GCP or AWS.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with a focus on automation and scalability.

  • Fluent in English and comfortable working in a fully remote environment.

  • Experience managing and monitoring distributed systems and databases such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch.

  • Adaptability to a startup environment, where delivering impactful features quickly is a priority.

Perks & Benefits

  • Work from anywhere: We’re a remote-first company, so you can work from wherever feels like home. Plus, you’ll have access to coworking spaces worldwide if you ever need a change of scenery.

We aim to move quickly (2-3 weeks), but we can adjust the timeline if needed.

  • Intro call with the hiring manager (30 min)

  • Technical test (2 hour, homework done in async)

  • Team chat with one of your future colleagues (30 min)

  • Final discussion with one of our co-founders (30 min)

We’re here to make the process smooth and transparent for you.

jobs.description:
**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH**

Location: Remote – Latin America
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote (Telecommute)
Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor
Industry: Construction / General Contracting
Compensation:$1,600–$1,900 USD/month
Schedule: Full-Time | Availability to work during U.S. business hours
English Proficiency: Professional written and spoken English required

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based construction company specializing in the development of community parks, amenity centers, recreational spaces, monuments, and other outdoor environments for residential developers and communities.

The company works closely with project managers, construction managers, landscape architects, and other industry partners to deliver high-quality projects with a strong focus on execution, cost control, and operational excellence.

As the organization continues to manage a growing portfolio of active construction projects, it is strengthening its financial and project accounting capabilities to provide greater visibility into project performance and costs.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Job Cost Accountant to own the accuracy and integrity of job cost data across an active portfolio of construction projects.

This role is dedicated to project financial performance and will be responsible for running and reviewing job cost reports, maintaining accurate cost coding, reconciling project financial data between Sage 100 and Procore, managing the monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule, and partnering directly with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

This is not a passive reporting role. The Job Cost Accountant will be embedded with project teams and serve as a financial partner to operations, helping ensure that costs are accurately captured, forecasts remain current, and project leadership has reliable financial information for decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Job Cost Reporting & Accuracy

  • Run, review, and distribute weekly and monthly job cost reports from Sage 100 for all active projects.

  • Reconcile Procore commitments, change orders, and invoicing against Sage 100 job cost detail.

  • Identify financial variances and work with project teams to resolve discrepancies at the source.

  • Review cost coding for AP invoices, subcontractor billings, labor, and equipment charges before they close to the job.

  • Identify misallocated expenses and coordinate corrections with the appropriate project stakeholders.

  • Maintain an accurate cost code structure in collaboration with finance and project leadership.

  • Ensure job cost information rolls up accurately for financial reporting, project analysis, and estimating feedback.

Project Management & Construction Management Partnership

  • Conduct formal monthly job cost reviews with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

  • Review budget vs. actual costs, committed costs, job cost detail, and forecast-to-complete estimates.

  • Partner with project teams to identify and correct misallocated expenses.

  • Serve as a primary finance resource for questions related to job costs, cost code selection, and committed cost reconciliation.

  • Escalate recurring coding or accountability issues to finance and project leadership when appropriate.

WIP & Percentage of Completion

  • Own the monthly WIP schedule across all active projects.

  • Maintain accurate calculations for:

    • Cost to date

    • Estimated cost at completion

    • Percentage complete

    • Earned revenue

    • Over/under billings

  • Partner with Project Managers to validate monthly cost-to-complete estimates.

  • Identify and challenge outdated or unsupported project forecasts.

  • Deliver a clean, accurate, and defensible WIP package as part of the monthly financial close process.

Specialized Cost Tracking

  • Partner with project leadership to capture the true cost of specialized construction activities when deeper cost analysis is required.

  • Establish tracking approaches before activities begin, including appropriate cost codes, labor tracking, equipment capture, and reporting structure.

  • Ensure cost information is collected accurately in real time rather than reconstructed after project activities are completed.

  • Prepare actual-cost reporting that can support future estimating, purchasing, project planning, and strategic decision-making.

Systems, Reporting & Documentation

  • Work extensively in Sage 100 and Procore as the primary systems for project cost accounting.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent financial data across both systems.

  • Build and maintain Excel reporting workbooks summarizing job cost, WIP, committed cost, and project financial performance.

  • Use AI-enabled tools and services, where appropriate, to improve reporting, reconciliation, and document review processes.

  • Maintain organized documentation and strong data hygiene across project accounting workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of job cost accounting experience with a general contractor, specialty contractor, or construction company.

  • Construction industry accounting experience is required.

  • Hands-on experience with construction job costing and project financial reporting.

  • Working proficiency with Sage 100 Contractor or Sage 100 construction job cost modules.

  • Working proficiency with Procore, including commitments, change orders, and invoicing.

  • Experience preparing and maintaining WIP schedules and percentage-of-completion calculations.

  • Strong understanding of cost codes, committed costs, project budgets, actual costs, and cost-to-complete forecasting.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, reconciliations, and reporting workbooks.

  • Experience reconciling financial information across accounting and project management systems.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and coordinate corrections with operational teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Ability to work effectively with U.S.-based finance, project management, and construction teams in a fully remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting multiple active construction projects simultaneously.

  • Experience working directly with Project Managers and Construction Managers on monthly financial reviews.

  • Knowledge of construction revenue recognition and percentage-of-completion accounting.

  • Experience with AP coding, subcontractor billing, change orders, commitments, and construction cost controls.

  • Experience using AI or automation tools to improve accounting, reconciliation, or reporting workflows.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will ensure that project financial data is accurate, timely, and actionable. Project Managers and Construction Managers will have a reliable financial partner who understands their projects, WIP reporting will be accurate and defensible, cost coding issues will be identified and corrected quickly, and leadership will have greater visibility into the true financial performance of every active project.

  • This is a remote/telecommute position.

About EPR Fireworks

EPR is a leading provider of cloud-based unified records management and operations software for fire and emergency medical services agencies. Since its founding in 2016, EPR has established itself as a trusted technology partner to approximately 500 fire and EMS agencies across 35 states. The company's comprehensive, cloud-based platform delivers an integrated solution encompassing incident reporting, electronic patient care records, fire prevention, workforce management, equipment logistics, training and certifications, advanced analytics, and community engagement capabilities.

EPR's platform development follows a continuous feedback methodology, incorporating insights from fire chiefs, department officers, medical directors, inspectors, and frontline fire and EMS personnel. The company's team includes numerous former and current firefighters and EMTs, ensuring authentic industry perspective in product design and functionality. With NERIS V1 compatibility and over 270 pre-configured reports, EPR Fireworks provides customizable solutions supported by exceptional customer service. The platform's integrated architecture eliminates data silos while ensuring regulatory compliance with evolving requirements.

About the Opportunity

EPR is seeking a strategic and hands-on Growth Marketing Manager to own the programs and channels that turn marketing strategy into measurable growth. This role will lead integrated campaigns across events, webinars, email, lead generation, nurture, and other demand-generation programs, connecting marketing activity directly to engagement, qualified opportunities, and pipeline.

Events are a significant part of EPR's go-to-market strategy. This person will play a hands-on role in planning and executing conferences and industry events across the country and should be comfortable traveling throughout the year. The role extends well beyond event logistics: the Growth Marketing Manager will be responsible for turning events into campaigns through pre-event targeting and promotion, onsite engagement, and disciplined post-event follow-up.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a campaign strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute it. This person will own programs from concept through measurement, coordinating audiences, messaging, channels, timelines, follow-up, and reporting.

EPR is looking for a curious, data-driven marketer who enjoys experimenting, moves quickly, and continually asks what is working, what is not, and what should happen next.


Requirements

Key Responsibilities Include:

·Event Marketing:Own marketing strategy and execution for EPR's conferences, tradeshows, and industry events, including planning, promotion, booth experience, onsite execution, lead capture, and post-event follow-up. Travel to key events throughout the year is required.

·Integrated Campaigns:Plan and execute multi-channel campaigns across email, events, webinars, digital channels, and other growth programs.

·Email & Nurture:Build and optimize email campaigns, audience segmentation, nurture programs, webinar communications, and event follow-up designed to move prospects through the buyer journey.

·Webinars & Digital Programs:Manage webinars and digital programs from promotion and registration through execution, follow-up, and performance analysis.

·Lead Generation & Conversion:Partner closely with Sales to improve the path from marketing engagement to qualified conversation and pipeline.

·Campaign Measurement:Track campaign performance, conversion rates, sourced and influenced pipeline, and channel effectiveness. Translate results into recommendations for future investment.

·Marketing Operations:Maintain strong campaign processes, audience lists, attribution, CRM hygiene, and reporting in partnership with Sales and Revenue Operations.

·Partner Marketing:Support select co-marketing opportunities with strategic partners, including joint launches, webinars, events, and campaigns when appropriate.

·Cross-Functional Collaboration:Work closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and the VP of Marketing to bring campaigns and go-to-market initiatives to market.

Critical Skills:

· 0-3 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, integrated marketing, event marketing, or B2B SaaS marketing.

·Demonstrated experience planning and executing multi-channel campaigns from strategy through measurement.

·Strong experience with B2B events and tradeshows, including planning, onsite execution, lead generation, and follow-up.

·Willingness and ability to travel throughout the year for industry conferences, events, and company initiatives.

·Strong email marketing and campaign management skills, including segmentation, nurture, testing, and performance analysis.

·Ability to connect marketing activity to measurable outcomes including engagement, qualified opportunities, pipeline, and revenue.

·Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, events, and deadlines simultaneously.

·Comfortable working within CRM, marketing automation, webinar, analytics, and campaign management platforms.

·Data-driven, curious, and comfortable testing new approaches and continuously improving performance.

The Ideal Candidate:

·Experience in B2B SaaS, GovTech, public safety, or another complex B2B market is preferred.

·A hands-on marketer who enjoys both planning the campaign and executing the details.

·Moves with urgency.You’re comfortable making decisions, executing quickly, and adjusting based on results rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

·Energized by events and comfortable representing EPR alongside customers, prospects, partners, and the Sales team.

·Understands that a successful event begins well before the booth opens and continues well after everyone goes home.

·Commercially minded and interested in how marketing ultimately contributes to pipeline and revenue.

·Organized enough to manage detailed execution while maintaining sight of the larger growth objective.

·Collaborative, low-ego teammate who communicates clearly, takes ownership, and follows through.

·Curious and tech-forward, with an interest in using automation and AI to improve marketing productivity and performance.

  • Experience with abstraction platforms (Crossplane, Pulumi, Terraform CDK).

jobs.excerpt: From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity.
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a an Analyst to join our GTM Analytics team, where we turn data into the insights that shape decisions across Sales, Strategy, RevOps, Marketing, Deal Desk, and more. Most of your work will be answering business questions directly — pulling and structuring data, summarizing it clearly, and delivering a recommendation. When a request genuinely calls for a dashboard, you'll help scope the requirements and hand them off to our central data team to build.

In this role, you'll work on well-scoped, clearly framed requests — writing SQL to pull data, looking up how a metric is already built in Looker or Omni when one exists, using Claude to refine and debug your queries, and shaping the output in Excel or Google Sheets into something a stakeholder can act on. This is a developmental role: as you build experience, you'll take on progressively more ambiguous and higher-stakes requests.

This is a full-time position based out of our Costa Rica office.

Technologies You’ll Use

SQL, Excel and/or Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, formulas), Claude (or similar AI assistants), Salesforce (viewing/reading data) — exposure to BI tools like Looker, Omni, Sigma, or Hex is a plus

What You’ll Do

  • Write and adapt SQL queries against well-defined requests, using Claude to refine logic and troubleshoot errors
  • Look up existing metrics in Looker or Omni to understand how they're already built, and reuse that logic where it applies
  • Pull, clean, and structure data in Excel or Google Sheets to answer scoped stakeholder questions
  • Summarize findings into clear, plain-language takeaways for non-technical stakeholders
  • Validate data accuracy against source systems before sharing outputs
  • Ask clarifying questions to properly scope a request before starting work
  • Escalate requests that require deeper analytical judgment to senior team members
  • Maintain documentation of recurring requests and their underlying logic
  • Support ad hoc reporting needs across Sales, Strategy, RevOps, Marketing, Deal Desk, among others
  • Build working knowledge of dbt Labs' GTM data model (Salesforce objects, opportunity stages, fiscal calendar)

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Working knowledge of SQL (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, basic aggregate functions)
  • Comfortable using AI tools like Claude to write, debug, or refine queries and analysis
  • Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, formulas)
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Basic understanding of SaaS sales concepts (opportunity stages, pipeline)
  • Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work
  • Comfortable asking questions rather than guessing at ambiguous requests
  • Comfortable navigating existing Looker or Omni dashboards to trace how a metric is defined and built

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience building in BI or exploratory-analysis tools like Looker, Omni, Sigma, or Hex (not required — happy to teach this on the job)
  • Familiarity with Salesforce
  • Prior internship or role in analytics, RevOps, or FP&A
  • Basic Python

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

jobs.description:
Join Shift Collab

At Shift Collab, we're a clinician- and women-led, award-winning national virtual mental health therapy practice of over 100 Social Workers and Psychotherapists reshaping virtual mental health care across Canada.

Right now, our biggest need is therapists who can commit to evening session slots, specifically between 6 and 9 PM EST, when client demand is highest. This is an independent contractor role and evening availability is a requirement.

What This Role Actually Looks Like

We invest heavily in growing your caseload through marketing, client matching, and a strong referral engine. What we need from you is a partner in that effort: someone who shows up consistently, runs excellent Meet & Greet sessions, builds strong therapeutic relationships, and keeps clients engaged in thoughtful treatment planning.

We do the heavy lifting on visibility and operations. You focus on delivering excellent clinical care and building a caseload that lasts.

Hours We Need Most

Our clients book most often in the evening, so this posting is targeted specifically at therapists who can meet that demand.

  • Required availability: 6 to 9 PM EST on weekdays.
  • Weekend or daytime availability is a strong asset in addition to evening hours.
  • 8 to 10 hours a week with the bulk of those hours concentrated in the evening window.
  • Potential for schedule growth, based on your availability and our demand.

What We Handle, So You Don't Have To

Billing, scheduling, client intake admin, and back-office support are all covered. Our secure telehealth platform gives you one place to manage sessions and notes. Your time goes to clinical work and client relationships, not chasing paperwork.

Compensation

Our compensation model reflects clinical experience, tenure, client demand, market rates, and the full support that comes with practicing at Shift Collab. Your rate is part of a broader model that includes client referrals and matching, marketing, billing, scheduling, intake administration, technology, and ongoing practice support.

Why Therapists Stay

  • Remote work. We're remote-first, so there's no commute.
  • Real professional growth. Regular workshops, webinars, and clinical training, plus access to supervision and peer groups.
  • Admin and marketing support. We take care of the infrastructure behind your practice and invest in bringing new clients to Shift.
  • A real community. Being 100% virtual doesn't mean practicing alone. Peer supervision, team meetings, and knowledge-sharing keep you connected.
  • Your own professional presence. We help build your bio and visibility, with opportunities for some therapists to write, speak, or contribute their expertise publicly.
  • Support for you, too. Wellness resources, peer support, regular touchpoints, and social events help you stay connected to the community.

Who Thrives Here

Therapists who:

  • Approach the therapeutic relationship with engagement over acronyms
  • Deliver high-quality, accessible virtual care and understand virtual-first practice
  • Excel at Meet & Greet sessions and know how to turn a first conversation into a strong therapeutic match
  • Take retention and treatment planning seriously so clients feel cared for and know where their therapy is going
  • See caseload growth as a shared effort and are ready to actively partner on it
  • Are available 6 to 9 PM EST on weekdays, ideally with some weekend availability too
  • Want a long-term engagement, not a short-term gig

What You Bring

  • Master's in Social Work or Counselling Psychology, registered as an MSW RSW or RP
  • A minimum of 2 years of post-licensure experience
  • Professional liability insurance
  • Reliable internet and a secure, private workspace
  • Strong virtual therapy skills and comfort with telehealth platforms
  • Experience or certifications in the following are an asset: ADHD and neurodiversity, EMDR, Couples Therapy, Family Therapy, IFS, anxiety, work stress and burnout, and OCD
  • Fluency in additional languages beyond English is a strong asset
  • A genuine commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion and to working with a diverse client base
  • Professional references and a Vulnerable Sector Check, required for all successful candidates

Ready to Apply?

Applications close September 27, 2026. If this sounds like your kind of fit, we'd love to hear from you before then.

Our Hiring Philosophy

Our organization is deeply committed to employment equity and diversity in the workplace. We wholeheartedly welcome applications from women, members of racialized groups, visible minorities, Aboriginal persons, persons with disabilities, persons of any sexual orientation, and persons of any gender identity or gender expression.

We are committed to ensuring that each individual has genuine, open, and unhindered access to employment opportunities within our company. Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodations for interviews or other meetings, please let us know.

Disclaimer

In accordance with Ontario's Employment Standards Act, we want to be transparent about our use of artificial intelligence in this hiring process. Shift Collab uses applicant tracking software (Workable) that may include AI-assisted features to help organize, parse, and rank applications. All hiring decisions, including screening, interviewing, and final selection, are made by members of our People Operations and Clinical teams. AI is used to support our process, not to make decisions on our behalf.

Molecule and BIO.xyz are building the foundation of Decentralized Science (DeSci) — where biotech meets web3 to make scientific research community-owned, transparent, and faster to market.

Molecule provides the infrastructure to turn intellectual property (IP) into programmable, on-chain assets through our IP-NFT framework and evolving protocol stack. This enables researchers, patients, and communities to fund and govern biotech projects in new, open ways.

is the coordination and economic layer of DeSci, powering BioDAOs through funding, governance, and ecosystem alignment.

Together, we are creating a new model for scientific discovery — one where breakthroughs are owned and advanced by the communities that believe in them.

The Role

You will be an AI Scientist at Molecule. In your first four weeks, you will live on-site, embedded with the founding team, and ship your first autonomous agent fleet into production against a real disease area. From day one you own the loop: design the agents, deploy them, pilot them, iterate, and generate scientific output that moves IP forward.

This is not a research role with a roadmap handed to you. You will pick targets, stand up infrastructure, recruit your sub-agents, and prove that autonomous science works at the bench-to-IP level. After the residency, you scale: more fleets, more disease areas, more shots on goal.

What You'll Do

  • Architect and deploy fleets of scientific agents spanning literature mining, target identification, molecular design, assay design, and data analysis

  • Pilot each fleet against a specific disease area and drive it to a tangible deliverable — a validated target, a candidate molecule, a novel dataset, an IP-NFT

  • Run multiple fleets in parallel across disease areas, reporting results directly to the CEO

  • Own the full stack: agent design, orchestration, evaluation, and scientific judgment on outputs

  • Define and set the standard for how autonomous science gets done at Molecule

Who You Are

  • Entrepreneurial to the core. You ship. You don't wait for permission.

  • Technically deep across LLMs, agent frameworks, and at least one wet-science domain - chemistry, biology, pharma, structural biology, or genomics

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You may be the only person in the room who knows how to do what you do, and that energizes you

  • Credential-agnostic. PhD, MSc, BSc, or straight from high school - output matters, not titles. If you hold a degree, it should be from a top-tier institution (Oxbridge, Ivy League, MIT, Caltech, Stanford, ETH/EPFL, Imperial, or equivalent). If you skipped the degree, show us what you built instead.

  • All-in on intensity. Willing to live on-site for 4 weeks and operate at founder pace

What We Offer

  • An early seat at the company building the infrastructure for autonomous science

  • Direct ownership over a frontier no one else is running at

  • Equity in the form of $BIO token allocation

  • The fastest path from idea to deployed IP that exists in biotech today

We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equality and weaving a community that values diverse perspectives and experiences and are actively seeking a diverse pool of applicants. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
