Role Description

We are seeking a Senior FP&A Partner to help shape and accelerate growth across our core business. This highly visible role will serve as a strategic thought partner to Product leadership, using financial analysis, business insights, and structured problem-solving to influence both near-term priorities and long-term strategy.

The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen with a deep understanding of SaaS business models and growth drivers. They will translate complex data into clear insights, identify opportunities to improve business performance, and help leaders evaluate investments and strategic tradeoffs. Success in this role requires a self-starter who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, building structure where it does not yet exist, and collaborating across Product, Finance, Data Science, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams.

This individual will also be expected to embrace AI-enabled ways of working, using modern tools to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of financial analysis and decision support.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to Product leadership, helping shape short-term priorities and long-term direction for the core business
  • Build driver-based financial models that connect product performance and customer behavior to revenue, ARR, retention, and profitability
  • Evaluate growth initiatives, product investments, pricing strategies, and resource allocation decisions through rigorous financial and strategic analysis
  • Develop business cases and scenario analyses that clearly articulate expected returns, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs
  • Partner across Product, Finance, Data Science, and Marketing to establish targets, define success metrics, and evaluate business performance
  • Identify emerging trends, performance gaps, and growth opportunities, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership
  • Improve the speed, quality, and scalability of financial analysis through automation, standardized processes, and AI-enabled workflows

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative field, with eight or more years of relevant experience in FP&A, strategic finance, corporate finance, investment banking, consulting, or a similarly analytical role
  • Advanced financial modeling skills, including experience building driver-based forecasts, scenario analyses, and investment cases
  • Experience supporting Product, Growth, or Monetization teams within a subscription-based or SaaS company
  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models and metrics, including ARR, conversion, retention, churn, customer lifetime value, marketing customer acquisition metrics, and unit economics
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex data and open-ended business questions into clear insights and actionable recommendations
  • Proven ability to work independently, take ownership, and create structure in fast-moving or ambiguous situations
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional partnership skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and non-finance stakeholders
  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve analysis, modeling, automation, communication, or other daily workflows

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating product-led growth initiatives, pricing and packaging decisions, customer funnel performance, or retention strategies
  • Experience developing long-range plans and strategic financial models for a scaled technology business
  • Familiarity with SQL, data visualization platforms, or other tools for independently accessing and analyzing business data
  • Experience partnering with Data Science, Analytics, Product Development or Engineering teams to define metrics and measure product performance

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.description:
Our portfolio company is an agtech company delivering digital scouting and agronomic decision support for commercial growers, propagators and nurseries, and seed producers. The company has customers in Canada, the Netherlands, Greece, the United Kingdom and other markets, and will continue to grow its customer base across these geographies and expand into additional markets worldwide.

The Role

We are hiring a senior client leader to own the post-sale customer journey across an international portfolio of commercial growers. The role combines leadership of Customer Success and related operational teams, strategic account management, enterprise implementation oversight and commercial expansion. Its purpose is to help customers turn the company's platform into an operationally valuable part of crop management, convert successful pilots and limited deployments into long-term scaled relationships, and build a consistently high standard of service across markets.

What You'll Do

  • Own customer health, retention and expansion across the portfolio; build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and personally lead strategic or at-risk accounts, resolving expectation gaps before they become commercial risks.
  • Lead, coach and set priorities for the Customer Success team, introducing structured account plans, customer health scoring and consistent service standards and reporting across markets.
  • Own the end-to-end onboarding process and the customer-facing quality of support, coordinating with Product, Engineering and the Senior Project Manager, and finding pragmatic solutions when a standard response isn't enough.
  • Oversee account administration, billing readiness and renewal or expansion forecasts, and represent the customer voice in product and management discussions.

What We Expect

  • Substantial hands-on experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, Key Account Manager or in a comparable client-management role for complex B2B digital products, IT solutions or technology-enabled projects, with demonstrated ownership of retention, renewals, expansion and senior customer relationships — including difficult conversations and recovery of at-risk accounts.
  • Strong command of professional customer-management methods — account and success plans, stakeholder mapping, customer journey design, health scoring, QBR or executive-review cadences, risk management and escalation frameworks — and practical experience with CRM, support and customer-success platforms, dashboards and playbooks.
  • At least two years of direct people-management experience, with responsibility for priorities, performance, coaching and development of customer-facing or related teams.
  • Demonstrated experience moving customers from pilot or proof of concept to multi-site, enterprise or otherwise scaled deployment, and strong understanding of business-process management — mapping, redesigning and embedding processes and controls.
  • Experience implementing digital products or IT systems for corporate customers, or leading an IT support or service-delivery function; ability to diagnose whether an issue is related to adoption, service, hardware, data or product capability and coordinate the right specialists without overpromising.
  • Strong commercial judgement working with contracts, subscriptions, billing, renewal dates and value or ROI discussions; fluent professional English for nuanced customer and executive conversations; willingness to travel internationally; strong organisation and attention to detail across multiple countries and parallel priorities.

Nice To Have

  • Knowledge of or experience in agriculture, commercial horticulture, protected cropping, integrated pest management, crop scouting, biological control or crop-protection technology, or relevant education in agronomy or horticulture.
  • Experience with computer vision, AI products, IoT or solutions that combine hardware, software and operational change.
  • Experience working across European and North American customers and cultures; Dutch or Russian language skills.

Candidate Profile

You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline. You can speak credibly with a grower in the greenhouse, challenge an internal team on a missed commitment, and then give management a concise, evidence-based view of risk and opportunity. You do not wait for customer dissatisfaction to become visible: you create clarity early, align stakeholders and follow through until the outcome is achieved.

Ein Dozent muss zwingend eine tiefgehende Fach- und Sachkunde nachweisen. Je nach Komplexität der Zentrifugen (z. B. Laborzentrifugen, Industrie- und Großzentrifugen in der Chemie oder Verfahrenstechnik) wird Folgendes gefordert:

  • Akademischer/Beruflicher Abschluss: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Biotechnologie, Physik oder eine Qualifikation als Techniker oder Industriemeister im relevanten Fachgebiet.
  • Sicherheits-Expertise: Exzellente Kenntnisse der gesetzlichen Vorgaben wie der Betriebssicherheitsverordnung (BetrSichV), der TRBS 1203 (Technische Regeln für Betriebssicherheit) sowie der berufsgenossenschaftlichen Regelwerke (z. B. DGUV Regel 100-500, Kapitel 2.11 zu Zentrifugen).
  • Prüfkompetenz: Der Dozent muss in der Regel selbst die Kriterien einer "Zur Prüfung befähigten Person für Zentrifugen" erfüllen, um dieses Wissen rechtssicher an zukünftige Prüfer weiterzugeben.
  • Praxisnahe Tätigkeit: Mehrjährige, zeitnahe berufliche Erfahrung in der Konstruktion, dem Betrieb, der Wartung oder der sicherheitstechnischen Prüfung von Zentrifugen. Reine Theorie reicht bei technischen Schulungen selten aus.
  • Gefährdungsbeurteilung: Erfahrung in der Durchführung und Erstellung von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen speziell für den physikalischen Betrieb von Zentrifugen (z. B. Beherrschung von Risiken durch Fliehkräfte, Unwuchten und Materialermüdung).

Didaktische und Pädagogische Kompetenz

Über Fachwissen hinaus, müssen Sie als Dozent in der Lage sein, Lerninhalte verständlich zu vermitteln:

  • Pädagogische Eignung: Erfahrung in der Erwachsenenbildung, nachweisbar durch Train-the-Trainer-Zertifikate oder eine Ausbildereignungsprüfung (AdA-Schein) und die Fähigkeit, theoretische Vorschriften (wie Schadensszenarien oder Gefährdungsbeurteilungen) anhand von realen Fallbeispielen und Praxisübungen verständlich zu erklären.

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based construction company specializing in the development of community parks, amenity centers, recreational spaces, monuments, and other outdoor environments for residential developers and communities.

The company works closely with project managers, construction managers, landscape architects, and other industry partners to deliver high-quality projects with a strong focus on execution, cost control, and operational excellence.

As the organization continues to manage a growing portfolio of active construction projects, it is strengthening its financial and project accounting capabilities to provide greater visibility into project performance and costs.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Job Cost Accountant to own the accuracy and integrity of job cost data across an active portfolio of construction projects.

This role is dedicated to project financial performance and will be responsible for running and reviewing job cost reports, maintaining accurate cost coding, reconciling project financial data between Sage 100 and Procore, managing the monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule, and partnering directly with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

This is not a passive reporting role. The Job Cost Accountant will be embedded with project teams and serve as a financial partner to operations, helping ensure that costs are accurately captured, forecasts remain current, and project leadership has reliable financial information for decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Job Cost Reporting & Accuracy

  • Run, review, and distribute weekly and monthly job cost reports from Sage 100 for all active projects.

  • Reconcile Procore commitments, change orders, and invoicing against Sage 100 job cost detail.

  • Identify financial variances and work with project teams to resolve discrepancies at the source.

  • Review cost coding for AP invoices, subcontractor billings, labor, and equipment charges before they close to the job.

  • Identify misallocated expenses and coordinate corrections with the appropriate project stakeholders.

  • Maintain an accurate cost code structure in collaboration with finance and project leadership.

  • Ensure job cost information rolls up accurately for financial reporting, project analysis, and estimating feedback.

Project Management & Construction Management Partnership

  • Conduct formal monthly job cost reviews with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

  • Review budget vs. actual costs, committed costs, job cost detail, and forecast-to-complete estimates.

  • Partner with project teams to identify and correct misallocated expenses.

  • Serve as a primary finance resource for questions related to job costs, cost code selection, and committed cost reconciliation.

  • Escalate recurring coding or accountability issues to finance and project leadership when appropriate.

WIP & Percentage of Completion

  • Own the monthly WIP schedule across all active projects.

  • Maintain accurate calculations for:

    • Cost to date

    • Estimated cost at completion

    • Percentage complete

    • Earned revenue

    • Over/under billings

  • Partner with Project Managers to validate monthly cost-to-complete estimates.

  • Identify and challenge outdated or unsupported project forecasts.

  • Deliver a clean, accurate, and defensible WIP package as part of the monthly financial close process.

Specialized Cost Tracking

  • Partner with project leadership to capture the true cost of specialized construction activities when deeper cost analysis is required.

  • Establish tracking approaches before activities begin, including appropriate cost codes, labor tracking, equipment capture, and reporting structure.

  • Ensure cost information is collected accurately in real time rather than reconstructed after project activities are completed.

  • Prepare actual-cost reporting that can support future estimating, purchasing, project planning, and strategic decision-making.

Systems, Reporting & Documentation

  • Work extensively in Sage 100 and Procore as the primary systems for project cost accounting.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent financial data across both systems.

  • Build and maintain Excel reporting workbooks summarizing job cost, WIP, committed cost, and project financial performance.

  • Use AI-enabled tools and services, where appropriate, to improve reporting, reconciliation, and document review processes.

  • Maintain organized documentation and strong data hygiene across project accounting workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of job cost accounting experience with a general contractor, specialty contractor, or construction company.

  • Construction industry accounting experience is required.

  • Hands-on experience with construction job costing and project financial reporting.

  • Working proficiency with Sage 100 Contractor or Sage 100 construction job cost modules.

  • Working proficiency with Procore, including commitments, change orders, and invoicing.

  • Experience preparing and maintaining WIP schedules and percentage-of-completion calculations.

  • Strong understanding of cost codes, committed costs, project budgets, actual costs, and cost-to-complete forecasting.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, reconciliations, and reporting workbooks.

  • Experience reconciling financial information across accounting and project management systems.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and coordinate corrections with operational teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Ability to work effectively with U.S.-based finance, project management, and construction teams in a fully remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting multiple active construction projects simultaneously.

  • Experience working directly with Project Managers and Construction Managers on monthly financial reviews.

  • Knowledge of construction revenue recognition and percentage-of-completion accounting.

  • Experience with AP coding, subcontractor billing, change orders, commitments, and construction cost controls.

  • Experience using AI or automation tools to improve accounting, reconciliation, or reporting workflows.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will ensure that project financial data is accurate, timely, and actionable. Project Managers and Construction Managers will have a reliable financial partner who understands their projects, WIP reporting will be accurate and defensible, cost coding issues will be identified and corrected quickly, and leadership will have greater visibility into the true financial performance of every active project.

  • This is a remote/telecommute position.

jobs.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

About the role

Dataiku is the platform for AI Success, helping organizations put AI to work across their business. The Growth team drives pipeline generation globally through paid media, content syndication, ABM, and marketing operations, and we're looking for a Senior Manager, Lifecycle Marketing to build and own the lifecycle function end to end.

You'll work closely with the VP of Digital & Growth and cross-functional partners across Web, Content, Acquisition, Field, Marketing Ops, Sales and Customer Success, supporting a global organization across regions. We don't have a lifecycle function today. Email and nurture are secondary responsibilities inside other teams' jobs, so nobody owns what a prospect or customer hears from us, in what order, or how often. There are existing nurture workflows without a current owner and no single view of what runs where, so establishing that visibility is the first priority. You'll build the function from there: the strategy, the systems, the programs, and the team.

What you'll own

The lifecycle operating system

  • One authoritative email and lifecycle calendar across prospect, new-user and customer programs: what goes out, to whom, from which team, and when.
  • Frequency governance, suppression logic and deliverability standards, including being able to say how much of an audience a given send reaches.
  • Segmentation and audience standards, set with the web and marketing ops teams who manage list creation today.
  • A standard for what a lifecycle program needs before it launches: entry criteria, success metric, exit.

Prospect and new-user nurture

  • New-user onboarding and activation nurture: the sequences that move a first touch to an engaged, sales-ready account.
  • Account progression communication: the programs that move accounts from first engagement toward qualified opportunity.
  • Nurture designed around named-account cohorts, built alongside the integrated campaign work so the two don't duplicate each other.
  • Visibility for BDRs into what a lead has already received before they reach out.

Customer lifecycle, retention and expansion

You'll partner closely with Customer Success and Product on this.

  • Programmatic customer nurture: adoption, education, and the sequences that keep users active after initial deployment.
  • Retention and expansion programs, built on account signals rather than calendar cadence.

Automation, data and measurement

  • The lifecycle layer of the marketing automation stack end to end: HubSpot workflows, Salesforce integration, and account and intent data from 6sense.
  • Consolidating the existing nurture workflows into something documented and maintained.
  • Reporting lifecycle contribution in terms the business already uses: engagement progression, influenced pipeline, retention and expansion. You'll build your own reporting rather than wait for a dashboard.
  • The data quality this function depends on, with marketing ops: deliverability, consent, record hygiene.

AI and agentic workflows

  • Lifecycle work inside agentic workflows, rather than AI as a separate experiment. Lifecycle is one of the clearest applications: audience assembly, copy variation, program QA, performance summaries.
  • A standard for what a well-built lifecycle agent looks like, and where human in the loop is required.

Building the function

  • This is the lead role for a function that doesn't exist yet. You'll build the team as the function develops.
  • Getting the rest of the organization aligned on what you're building. Lifecycle touches Web, Content, Acquisition, Field, Marketing Ops, Sales and Customer Success.

What you bring

  • 6+ years in lifecycle, nurture, email or growth marketing in B2B, ideally enterprise software with long, multi-threaded buying cycles.
  • Hands-on marketing automation depth. You've built and owned complex nurture programs yourself. HubSpot or Marketo depth, Salesforce fluency, and real comfort with the data model under both.
  • Command of deliverability, frequency capping, suppression, consent and list hygiene. This role exists partly because nobody has owned these.
  • Experience on both sides of the lifecycle, prospect and customer. If your background covers one, tell us how you'd approach the other.
  • Fluency with intent and account data (6sense, Demandbase or similar), and a view on where it should drive program entry rather than only reporting.
  • Comfort building with AI, expected rather than optional. No engineering background needed. You should already be using LLMs in your own work, with a view on where they belong in lifecycle programs and where human in the loop is required.
  • Analytical strength. You can define a metric, instrument it, and defend it, including when the honest answer is that the current number isn't reliable.
  • Comfort with a build role: ambiguity, direct conversations about tradeoffs, and establishing a function through influence before you have a team.
  • Experience working across regions in a global organization.
  • Excellent written English. Other languages welcome, not required.

Why this role

Lifecycle is unowned at Dataiku today. This role defines it, reporting to the VP who owns the function, with a mandate to build the team behind it.

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.
Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

ActiveProspect is on a mission to make consent-based marketing the best channel for online customer acquisition. We provide marketers the products they need to acquire qualified customers at scale. Our platform is trusted by thousands of companies engaged in direct-to-consumer marketing, helping them save wasted spend, comply with ever-changing regulations, and manage a constantly evolving partner landscape. Our flagship product, TrustedForm, is used to certify over 1 billion opt-in digital customer leads every year and is the gold standard for documenting prior express written consent for TCPA compliance.

Job Summary

You own customer and business outcomes, not tickets. You work like a forward-deployed engineer: your home base is a core team, and you deploy into projects, initiatives, and pods where the problem is, ship the outcome across the full stack (React on the frontend, Node.js and Python services on AWS), then carry what you learned back so the next team moves faster.. The technical bar is high, but coding ability is the floor here, not the ceiling. What sets this role apart is judgment: knowing the smallest thing worth shipping, when to kill your own idea, and when AI output is good enough versus when to override it.

You'll move between your home team and the initiatives you deploy into, shipping early, talking to customers, and deciding fast.

Responsibilities

  • Own outcomes end-to-end, wherever you're deployed. Frame the problem, design it, ship it, own the metric. Descope to the cheapest version that works. Prototype in days.
  • Stay close to customers. Shadow sales and support, join advisory conversations, and let customer reality drive technical decisions. Propose what to build, defer, and kill.
  • Own your domain and share it. Its interfaces, reliability, performance, and security, including on-call for the systems you own. Consent and PII handling are central to customer trust. Bring patterns, tooling, and hard-won context back to the wider org rather than hoarding them.
  • Build and scale both the product surface and the platform beneath it. Ship responsive, accessible React interfaces with a strong UI/UX eye, back them with Node.js and Python services and APIs, and keep the cloud batch platform and data pipelines that deliver multi-tenant products reliable as they scale.
  • Architect AI-driven leverage. Build AI-assisted workflows that hold up, evolve the team's practices as tooling changes (Cursor, Claude Code, and whatever comes next), and look for product wins AI unlocks (smarter routing, anomaly detection, and more).
  • Multiply the teams you touch. Mentor on judgment and product sense, not just syntax. Write decision memos and ADRs. Enable Product and Design to self-serve.

Qualifications and Skills

  • A track record of shipping something end-to-end that you cared about and owning the outcome, not just the code.
  • Product judgment: pushing back on a bad spec, proposing the cheapest experiment, descoping well, and collaborating with Product to suggest solutions rather than waiting for a fully specced ticket.
  • Comfort embedding with unfamiliar teams and codebases, getting productive fast, and leaving them better than you found them.
  • Deep full-stack expertise: React (component lifecycle, state management, rendering optimization), JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern CSS on the frontend; Node.js and Python services, RESTful APIs, and asynchronous data handling on the backend.
  • Cloud and data-pipeline depth: AWS core services (Lambda, EC2, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway) and cloud batch / workflow orchestration (Step Functions, Airflow, or similar) to deliver multi-tenant batch products and data solutions reliably at scale.
  • A strong UI/UX eye: you turn wireframes, mockups, and ambiguous requirements into intuitive, accessible, user-centric journeys.
  • Strong systems design judgment in ambiguous contexts, and a security mindset aligned with sensitive consumer data and compliance.
  • Fluency building your own AI-assisted workflows and reading AI output critically. Daily use of AI-native tools (Cursor, Claude Code) and precise prompting across OpenAI and Claude models, with the judgment to know when to trust output, how to review it for hidden bugs and security issues, and when to override it.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. Mentorship experience. 5-10% travel.

How It Works

You'll report to an Engineering Manager who owns several teams and stays out of their daily flow. As you embed, you'll often act as the player-coach Tech Lead, owning technical direction while the EM owns delivery health and stakeholder alignment across the group.

Success looks like movement in a user or business metric you/your team owns, high-value work deliberately not built, decisions made fast, and teams that move faster after you've worked with them, not just while you're there.

Principal Product Manager

Position Summary

Natera is at the forefront of personalized genetic testing, transforming the management of disease worldwide. As we scale our life-saving diagnostics, we are fundamentally transforming how software products are conceived, built, and delivered across our clinical and genomic portfolio.

We are seeking an experienced Principal Digital Product Manager to join our Oncology Comprehensive Genomic Profiling (CGP) Product Engineering team. In this senior individual contributor role, you will serve as the product lead for our most complex platform initiatives — owning end-to-end product strategy and execution across a sophisticated system of interconnected software products.

You will act as the product backbone for our most critical "Pillar" projects. Success in this role demands mastery from three dimensions: partnership with commercial teams to define product strategy/roadmap based on market needs; deep fluency in how end users - lab operations, clinical teams, customer success teams - actually work; and close collaboration with Engineering, R&D, and PMO on product design and delivery. You will synthesize all three into product decisions that hold up end-to-end — from order ingestion through lab execution to patient reporting — ultimately delivering reliable, high-quality solutions that patient care depends on.

Crucially, while this is an individual contributor role, you will operate as a central leader — driving consensus, roadmap alignment, and product excellence through influence rather than formal authority across Engineering, R&D, Commercial, and Clinical teams. You thrive in fluid environments, adapt quickly to change, and chart a clear path forward even amid unknowns.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision

  • Define Long-Term Vision: Develop and execute multi-year software product roadmaps for critical business units, balancing rapid prototyping with long-term commercial stability.
  • Architect Complex Solutions: Act as a high-level Architect, translating broad business goals into detailed functional workflows. You are accountable for the cohesion and integrity of the final end-to-end solution.
  • Founder's Mindset: Champion a culture of high agency and urgency, making quick, data-driven decisions in ambiguous situations to deliver critical milestones in a fast-paced environment.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Lead by expertise rather than authority, aligning stakeholders across R&D, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Regulatory to ensure the software roadmap meets broader business goals.

Product Excellence & Execution

  • End-to-End Ownership: Lead the full product lifecycle for complex software solutions, ensuring a seamless user journey across various system boundaries — from order ingestion through lab execution to patient reporting.
  • Technical Translation: Serve as the primary domain expert, translating complex scientific, clinical, or technical requirements into robust, scalable software specifications.
  • Operational Immersion: Passionately advocate for internal and external users by regularly shadowing operations and engaging with customers to ensure software solves real-world physical and clinical problems.
  • Systems Thinking: Maintain a "big picture" view of how software systems interact across the entire data lifecycle, understanding how upstream decisions ripple through to downstream clinical and reporting outcomes.
  • Agile Mastery: Lead with the rigor of a seasoned project manager, owning product backlogs and driving Agile ceremonies to ensure timely delivery of high-quality features.
  • AI-Native Product Development: Pioneer the use of LLMs and generative AI tools to accelerate product discovery, automate requirements synthesis, and continuously improve how we deliver value to users.

Regulatory & Quality Leadership

  • Compliance Champion: Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to ensure all products comply with relevant global standards and certifications, including FDA design controls, IEC 62304, and HIPAA.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and mitigate product risks, ensuring robust documentation and compliance without compromising development velocity.

Mentorship & Craft

  • Leveling Up the Org: Mentor and guide Senior Product Managers and cross-functional team members, instilling best practices in product management, agile development, and user-centered design.
  • Culture Building: Foster a product culture of accountability, technical rigor, and cross-functional collaboration across the organization.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of product management experience in high-scale software or biotech environments, with a proven track record of operating at a Director-level seniority.
  • Zero-to-One Track Record: Demonstrated experience building and launching new software products from the ground up in a startup or internal incubator environment.
  • Regulated Industry Expertise: Deep experience in highly regulated environments (e.g., FDA design controls, HIPAA, IEC 62304, or ISO standards). Exposure to HealthTech, MedTech, or genomics is highly advantageous.
  • Technical Aptitude: Strong ability to understand complex technical architectures (APIs, microservices, LIMS, Data Platforms, event-driven systems) and communicate effectively with engineering and scientific teams.
  • AI-Native Fluency: Hands-on experience using LLMs and generative AI tools to accelerate product workflows, requirements generation, or operational insight.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas and influence executive-level stakeholders.
  • Education: BS/MS in a relevant technical, scientific, or quantitative discipline; MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • High Agency & Technical Initiative: You are a natural builder who thrives in fluid, fast-moving environments. Rather than waiting for requirements to be handed down, you inspect systems, audit user needs, chart a path forward amid unknowns, and drive product decisions proactively.
  • Deep Systems-Level Cognition: You bring expert-level mastery of the system from two dimensions — architectural depth and functional fluency. You can trace how minor changes in upstream services impact downstream clinical reporting, catching product failure modes that only someone who truly knows the system would anticipate.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership through Influence: You operate as a central leader without formal authority — driving consensus, alignment, and product excellence across Engineering, R&D, Commercial, and Clinical teams through technical credibility, communication, and emotional intelligence.
  • User-Centric Validation Ethos: You understand that technically correct solutions are incomplete if the final product degrades the clinical or laboratory operational experience. You rigorously validate that software delivers on its promise for real users.

jobs.description:
Description

The Clinical Data Manager, will participate in various clinical data management activities required to ensure that data captured in a few clinical trials undertaken, or managed by Innovaderm, are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines, and Innovaderm standard operating procedures (SOPs) while respecting Innovaderm’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines.

This role will be perfect for you if:

  • You enjoy working with a mid-sized CRO where you can build professional relationships with your colleagues at all levels
  • You bring previous experience in managing data management
  • Dermatology is a therapeutic area you enjoy or want to learn more about

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provides general data management support to the project team, sponsor and external vendors, as needed.
  • Is responsible for the development of electronic case report form (eCRF) specifications (including data capture screens and edit check specifications) needed to build a study-specific clinical database/electronic data capture (EDC) system.
  • Is responsible for the programming and ongoing maintenance of the clinical database.
  • Is responsible for the validation and testing of the clinical database (e.g. User Acceptance Testing).
  • Is responsible for the development of eCRF completion guidelines and other training material required to train site users and monitors.
  • Conducts training for site users/monitors on the clinical database.
  • Develops data transfer agreements and specifications with vendors providing external data (e.g. laboratory results).
  • Conducts reconciliation between external data and data in the EDC system to ensure consistency, including reconciliation with sponsor safety databases for adverse events/serious adverse events data (if needed).
  • Provides support to study team in the development of external systems capturing clinical data, e.g. ePRO or IWRS, and ensuring that any data transfer requirements between these systems and EDC are documented and tested appropriately.
  • Is responsible for the development of the data management plan (DMP), and other clinical data management related documentation.
  • Is responsible for ongoing data review/cleaning during study conduct and also during preparation for database lock/close.
  • Codes medical terms in the clinical database, as required.
  • Generates data listings and reports needed for data review by the project manager (or other study team members) in preparation for database close/lock.
  • Monitors study status (e.g. enrollment, CRFs monitored/approved, etc.) on an ongoing basis and provides data status reports to the project team, as needed.
  • Ensures that data management documentation is complete and up-to-date in the trial master file (TMF).
  • Activates/de-activates new users in the clinical database in response to requests from the project manager and maintains records of such requests.
  • Responds to users requiring assistance with the EDC system.
  • Is responsible for archiving of the clinical database and related documents.
  • Participates in the definition, writing and updating of data management SOPs
  • Mentors and trains a Clinical Data Coordinator.
  • For any studies where any of the above activities have been outsourced to an external service provider:
  • Oversees/manages the vendor to ensure that timelines and deliverables meet with sponsor and protocol requirements
  • Ensures that their work is done in accordance with effective work orders and Innovaderm SOPs (if applicable).

Requirements

Education

  • B.Sc. or in a related field of study;
  • M. Sc. Or in a related field of study is an asset;

Experience

  • Between 5 to 10 years of clinical data management experience in clinical research in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or contractual research organization (CRO) industry;
  • Understanding of the drug development process and of applicable regulations, including Good Clinical Practices, ICH Guidelines;
  • Extensive experience working with EDC systems, and/or database structures, including demonstrated skills in database programming;

Knowledge and skills

  • Good understanding of CDISC SDTM/CDASH standards;
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented with effective project planning and time management skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English;
  • Excellent problem solving abilities;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated agility to juggle and prioritize multiple competing demands;
  • Knowledge of MedDRA and WHODrug dictionaries.
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Ongoing learning and development

Work location

Note that this opening is for a home-based position in Philippines. Attendance at some meetings outside of regular business hours (primarily in the evening) is required.

About Indero

A Global Clinical Leader In Dermatology and Rheumatology!

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

This role supports HCI by making the interface clearer, more readable, and easier to trust.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design the visual language, design system, and UI components for ActAI's product across web and mobile.

  • Create visual patterns that help users parse AI-generated content, distinguish system states, and understand confidence and reliability signals.

  • Design for information density and hierarchy in AI interfaces where content is dynamic, variable, and often uncertain.

  • Work with product and UX designers to translate interaction flows into polished, accessible visual designs.

  • Build and maintain a design system that supports speed, consistency, and clarity.

  • Define visual standards for error states, empty states, loading states, task states, and AI-generated output.

  • Contribute visual assets and design specs that engineers can implement accurately.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a visual or UI designer with a portfolio across web or mobile products.

  • Strong skills in typography, color, layout, and visual hierarchy.

  • Proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to design systems.

  • Ability to design for dynamic content where AI output varies in length, format, tone, and reliability.

  • Understanding of accessibility standards and how to design for legibility and contrast.

  • Comfort designing under ambiguity, with evolving product requirements.

  • Experience working closely with product and UX designers in fast-moving teams.

  • Awareness of how visual cues communicate AI system behavior, trust, and confidence.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. jobs.description:
About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You’ll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Director of Software Engineering to join our Product Development team. This role plays a key part in

providing senior technical and organizational leadership for SANS’ Cloud Platform Engineering organization — spanning platform core services (identity, product administration, and entitlements), DevOps tools and services, website engineering, and courseware & platform orchestration — while serving as the engineering executive for Project CORE, SANS’ enrollment and entitlement modernization program. This role leads individual contributors and engineering teams through their managers and leads; owns shared engineering platforms, standards, tooling, and vendor relationships; and drives the architecture, delivery, and cross-functional coordination required to modernize SANS’ enrollment, entitlement, and administrative systems. The Director partners closely with Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and fellow engineering directors to translate business strategy into secure, scalable, and maintainable systems.

As a Director of Software Engineering, you will:

  • Lead, manage, and mentor individual contributors and engineering teams through managers and leads.
  • Own engineering standards and best practices — CI/CD, code quality, secure development — and facilitate architecture governance across teams.
  • Plan and balance engineering capacity against shifting business priorities, communicating trade-offs to stakeholders.
  • Lead strategic modernization programs end to end: architecture, cross-team commitments, delivery planning, and executive reporting.
  • Direct modernization of core product platforms — enrollment, entitlement, identity, and product services — including integration with enterprise systems and retirement of legacy tooling.
  • Measure engineering effectiveness and drive continuous improvement across teams.
  • Champion incident management discipline and publish regular engineering communications to stakeholders.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • At least 10 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and 3+ years managing through engineering managers or leads.
  • Demonstrated success leading a large, multi-team modernization or systems-integration program from design through delivery.
  • Strong technical acumen with prior hands-on development experience and the ability to guide architectural decisions across services, integrations, and data flows.
  • Experience with modern AI development techniques and best practices.
  • Experience with enterprise business systems and integrations (e.g., Salesforce/Service Cloud, identity providers, payment/order management).
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices, including AWS, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, software procurement, licensing, and budgets.
  • Experience with Agile, SDLC, and modern development standards and best practices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level reporting and cross-functional coordination.
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Preferred qualifications include:

  • Experience in education technology, training delivery platforms, or certification systems.
  • Experience facilitating architecture governance (architecture councils, RFC processes, engineering standards).
  • Familiarity with identity and access management platforms (PingIdentity, Entra ID) and entitlement modeling.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted development tooling and governing its safe, cost-effective adoption.
  • Interest in a security-first mindset and secure coding practices.
  • Ability and passion for developing both individuals and teams.

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $200,000 to $240,000 OTE (comprised of base salary and bonus), depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.

SANS is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

SANS is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact SANS Human Resources.

US Job Seekers: Click here to view the “Know Your Rights” poster.

SANS complies with all applicable state and local laws regarding the consideration of applicants with arrest or conviction records. For positions governed by federal and/or state banking regulations, SANS will adhere to relevant requirements when evaluating candidates with criminal histories.

Employment eligibility in the United States is required. SANS does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. jobs.description:
Description

﻿Who We Are

﻿

WeSki's vision is to make it easy for skiers across the globe to book and enjoy their ideal ski trip at the best possible price. As the ultimate ski trip booking platform, WeSki enables everyone to design and book their ideal adventure in just a few clicks, quickly, seamlessly, and affordably. In an $100 billion industry that has remained largely traditional, this opens up a massive opportunity to redefine ski trips for modern consumers.

WeSki's technology compares millions of combinations of flights, accommodation, transfers, passes, gear, and lessons instantly, saving hours of planning. Each trip is fully customisable, giving customers the flexibility of building it themselves, but with the expert protection and support of a holiday provider.

With all trip components automatically linked, customers can relax and enjoy their holiday knowing that all the logistics are taken care of, alongside 24/7 customer service whilst they're away.

WeSki is an innovative, passionate, and fast-moving company. We partner with over 300 ski resorts (and counting) across 20 countries and have already sold over 180,000 ski holiday packages to skiers worldwide. We are in a rapid growth mode whilst maintaining profitability, making our business and product opportunities (and challenges) all the more exciting.

Role Overview

﻿

We are building a dedicated sales function at WeSki, and we are looking for the person to lead it. Many of our customers are happy to plan and book independently through our platform. Others want to talk to someone who genuinely knows the resorts, understands what makes a family ski holiday work, and can help them make confident decisions. This role exists to serve that second group properly.

The profile we are looking for is specific: an excellent travel professional who is also a genuine skiing expert. You need to bring both to the table, because our customers are trusting us with the trip they save up for all year, and that trust is built in the first few minutes of a conversation.

This is a founding leadership position. You will design the sales process end to end, define how success is measured, build and coach the team, and own the results. In the first season you will also sell personally: this is a hands-on role, not a purely managerial one. As the function proves itself, you will grow the team and hire into it.

The role reports into Customer Experience and works closely with Growth, Operations and Product. It is fully remote, with a strong focus on the UK and European markets. A deep understanding of the UK consumer travel market is essential.

Key Responsibilities:

﻿

  • Build the function. Design the sales process from first contact through to a booked holiday, including how enquiries are prioritised, how conversations are managed, and how a booking is handed over to our operations team.
  • Set the strategy. Define how we sell, to whom, and through which channels, and adapt it as the market and our product evolve.
  • Own the numbers. Define the KPIs for the team, monitor performance against them, and report on results to senior leadership.
  • Sell. Handle customer conversations directly, particularly in the early months. You will set the standard by demonstrating it.
  • Lead and develop the team. Coach the current team, raise the level of consultative selling across it, and create the structure a growing team needs.
  • Validate and improve. Test approaches, measure what works, and iterate. We would rather learn quickly than commit to assumptions.
  • Shape the tooling. Work with Product and Technology to build the systems and automation the team needs, so that time is spent with customers rather than on admin.
  • Lead AI adoption. Identify where AI can improve the sales process and implement AI-powered tools and workflows across the function. Experiment with new capabilities, measure their impact, and continuously improve how the team uses AI to sell more effectively and operate more efficiently.
  • Work across the business. Partner with Growth on the flow and quality of enquiries, and with Operations to ensure what we promise during a sale is delivered on the ground.
  • Recruit and onboard. As the function scales, identify, hire and develop the people who will join it.
  • Represent the customer. You will hear what customers want before anyone else. Bring that back and help shape the product.

Requirements

  • Genuine skiing expertise. You ski, you know European resorts first hand, and you can tell a customer which mountain suits their family and which does not. This is not a preference. A customer planning their one big trip of the year can tell within a sentence whether they are talking to someone who has actually been there.
  • A background in travel, as a travel agent, tour operator or equivalent. You have planned and sold real trips for real people, and you understand what goes into a holiday beyond the price: the connections, the transfers, the things that go wrong and how to prevent them.
  • Proven experience selling high-value, considered purchases to UK consumers in a consultative, advice-led way mixed with strong business acumen.
  • Deep understanding of the UK consumer travel or leisure market, including how UK customers research and buy.
  • Experience building a sales process or function from scratch, or substantially rebuilding an existing one. This role has no existing playbook to inherit.
  • Experience leading, coaching or mentoring salespeople, with a genuine interest in developing others.
  • Comfort owning a target and being measured against it, and the data literacy to define sensible metrics and interpret them honestly.
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills in English. A large share of customer conversations happen in writing, and clarity and warmth on the page matter as much as they do on the phone.
  • Self-direction and strong organization. This is a remote role with significant autonomy and broad ownership.
  • Comfort using AI and automation tools as part of everyday work.
  • Flexibility during our peak booking period, including weekend availability as needed. Ski travel is a highly seasonal business and the busiest months are demanding.

Advantages (Not Mandatory):

  • Ski instructor, ski guide, seasonaire or resort-side experience.
  • Background in travel technology as well as traditional travel.
  • Experience working in a seasonal business.
  • Experience hiring and onboarding into a growing team.
  • Proficiency in French or other European languages.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end global payroll delivery for employees and contractors, ensuring payments, deductions, reimbursements, and changes are accurate, timely, compliant, and reconciled.
  • Calculate and validate variable compensation and bonuses for executives and non-GTM employees, coordinating finalized inputs, payroll execution, controls, and reconciliation with the GTM variable-pay partner.
  • Build and run a global payroll calendar with clear cutoffs, review cycles, approvals, funding timelines, and reimbursement service levels.
  • Design and administer equity and long-term incentive programs — grants, vesting, exercises, terminations — maintaining accurate records and cap-table integrity in partnership with Finance and Legal.
  • Own global benefits administration across markets, covering statutory and supplemental programs while balancing employee value, compliance, and cost.
  • Monitor benefits utilization, market competitiveness, employee feedback, and spend; recommend changes supported by data.
  • Own payroll and equity data integrity across BambooHR, Justworks, Remote, and Carta, including workflows, integrations, permissions, and reporting.
  • Manage global employment operations, including EOR/PEO relationships from a payroll perspective, own provider governance — contracts, funding, service levels, reconciliations, escalations, and periodic performance reviews.
  • Identify recurring failure points and manual work across these programs and implement sustainable fixes rather than workarounds.

Skills and Qualifications

Must-have:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience across global payroll, total rewards, benefits, HRIS, or people operations, with meaningful ownership of multi-country payroll.
  • Demonstrated experience managing direct-entity, EOR/PEO, and contractor populations across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Hands-on experience calculating bonuses or variable compensation and building review and approval controls.
  • Experience designing or administering equity and long-term incentive programs.
  • Experience auditing an HRIS (e.g., BambooHR), including data governance, workflows, permissions, integrations, and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of payroll compliance, equity tax considerations, audit requirements, and stock-based compensation accounting concepts such as ASC 718.
  • Evidence of improving complex or manual processes in a scaling, distributed organization.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with equity platforms such as Carta, Shareworks, or Pulley.

  • You trace a discrepancy to its root cause instead of accepting the first explanation.
  • You'd rather build the calendar and the checklist than answer the same question twice.
  • You treat a payroll error as your problem to close out, not someone else's to escalate.
  • You ask the clarifying question before the work starts, not after it's wrong.
  • You can explain a stock-comp technicality to an executive in one sentence they'll actually remember.

Hello, I’m Jacob, Senior Sales Manager at Customer.io! We're expanding our sales team in the United States and seeking motivated and successful Account Executives at the Mid-Market level to join us! This role offers a unique opportunity to take your sales career to the next level, with potential for upward mobility.

As an Account Executive, you’ll represent Customer.io to prospective customers and drive growth within key market segments. This is a full-cycle sales role (prospect, demo, close), where you'll be fielding both inbound and outbound demand.

About Customer.io

Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Responsibilities:

  • Pipeline Development and Management: Build and manage a pipeline through self-sourced leads and SDR-supported leads to drive new customer acquisition.
  • Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Lead the entire sales process from prospecting and discovery through demo and closing, focusing on new business acquisition within targeted accounts.
  • Customer Needs Analysis and Solution Alignment: Conduct discovery calls to understand customer business challenges and goals. Position Customer.io's solutions to meet these needs effectively.
  • Collaboration and Cross-Functional Feedback: Work closely with the SDR team for lead quality feedback and collaborate with Customer Success and Technical Support for a smooth hand-off post-sale.
  • Performance Tracking and Reporting: Own and report on individual sales metrics, including pipeline status and progress towards targets, to support informed decision-making.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B SaaS or MarTech sales, handling mid-market accounts
  • Location: We are currently hiring for positions based in the UK, Ireland, and the Americas (Canada and the USA). Candidates must be located in one of these regions to be considered for the role.
  • B2B SaaS or MarTech Experience: Proven success in new customer acquisition and closing deals within the B2B SaaS space, preferably MarTech
  • Sales Methodology: Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar framework that supports consultative selling and discovery to close.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and engaging presence to build rapport with new prospects.
  • Problem Solving: Strong ability to identify customer business needs and position relevant solutions effectively to drive acquisition
  • Deal Focus: Primarily handles mid-market accounts with shorter sales cycles and lower ACV deals
  • Support: Works closely with our SDR team for lead generation, with a balance between inbound and self-sourced opportunities
  • Responsibilities:
    • Engage in high-volume prospecting, cold and warm outreach
    • Manage the full sales cycle for deals typically under $50,000 ACV
    • Drive growth within mid-sized clients, nurturing relationships and uncovering business needs

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. We are offering a compensation package of $95,000 base + $95,000 variable for a total $190,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in local currency), subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. 30-minute video call with a Recruiter
  2. 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager
  3. 60-minute Mock Call w/ the Hiring Team

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact .

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We are passionate about our core values of Empathy, Transparency, Responsibility, and Awkwardness and are looking for new coworkers to share and build that passion!

jobs.title: Long-Form Content Writer – AI & Enterprise Technology
jobs.excerpt: Job OverviewThis role is primarily about writing.
jobs.description:
Job Overview

This role is primarily about writing.

We are looking for someone with outstanding English writing ability, strong research skills, excellent judgment, and the ability to develop a clear point of view and narrative around a subject.

Experience in technical writing within the AI, enterprise infrastructure, or enterprise IT highly desired.

The role will cover much more than blog posts. You may work on long-form articles, thought leadership, whitepapers, research-driven content, industry reports, case studies, website content, and other editorial and marketing assets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality long-form content across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, and related topics.
  • Research unfamiliar subjects thoroughly and develop a strong understanding before writing.
  • Produce long-form articles that are informative, engaging, structured, and original.
  • Develop thought-leadership content for technology and business audiences.
  • Write whitepapers, research-driven reports, industry guides, and educational resources.
  • Develop case studies and customer-focused stories.
  • Create website and landing-page content when required.
  • Write content for senior technology decision-makers, business leaders, IT professionals, and broader technology audiences.
  • Turn complex ideas into clear and compelling narratives without unnecessarily simplifying the subject.
  • Interview or collaborate with subject-matter experts when deeper technical insight is required.
  • Identify interesting angles, trends, questions, and stories within broader technology topics.
  • Adapt writing style and structure depending on the audience, subject, and content format.
  • Edit and refine content for clarity, flow, accuracy, originality, and readability.
  • Work with the marketing and SEO teams to align content with search intent and broader content objectives.

What We're Looking For

  • Native English-speaking candidates only.
  • Exceptional written English and a strong command of grammar, vocabulary, structure, and tone.
  • Demonstrated ability to write high-quality long-form content.
  • Strong storytelling and narrative skills.
  • Ability to make complex subjects interesting and easy to understand.
  • Excellent research skills and intellectual curiosity.
  • Ability to develop original ideas, angles, and perspectives rather than simply rewriting existing information.
  • Strong editing and self-editing skills.
  • Ability to write for different audiences and content formats.
  • Strong attention to detail and factual accuracy.
  • Ability to learn technical subjects quickly and communicate what you have learned clearly.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Content You May Work On

Depending on business requirements, your work may include:

  • Long-form articles
  • Thought-leadership pieces
  • Whitepapers
  • Industry reports
  • Research-driven content
  • Technology guides
  • Case studies
  • Website and landing-page content
  • Educational resources
  • Executive-level content
  • Technical and business content
  • Campaign and marketing content

Technical Topics

You may write about subjects including:

  • Artificial intelligence
  • AI infrastructure
  • AI data centers
  • AI factories
  • GPU computing
  • Cloud infrastructure
  • Enterprise IT
  • Data centers
  • Cybersecurity
  • Emerging technology
  • Enterprise hardware and services

Preferred Qualifications

  • Portfolio demonstrating exceptional long-form writing.
  • Experience writing technology, business, enterprise, or B2B content.
  • Experience creating whitepapers, reports, case studies, or thought-leadership content.
  • Basic understanding of SEO, search intent, headings, content structure, and keyword usage.
  • Experience working with subject-matter experts.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted research and writing tools.
  • Experience writing for enterprise or professional audiences.

What We Value Most

Writing quality comes first.

We are looking for someone who can take a subject, do the research, find the interesting story or insight within it, and produce writing that people actually want to read.

Strong technical knowledge is useful, but exceptional writing ability, curiosity, research skills, and editorial judgment are more important.

jobs.description:
Vice President of Finance
Location: Remote / United States
Department: Finance
Reports To: Executive Leadership


Position Overview:
We are looking for an experienced, highly capable Vice President of Finance to take ownership of our financial strategy and operations across both the United States and Mexico.
This is a senior-level position for someone who can operate independently, identify opportunities and risks, and provide leadership with clear financial insight to support business growth and decision-making.
The ideal candidate is self-sustaining, strategic, analytical, and hands-on. We are looking for someone with significantly more experience than a traditional finance specialist—someone who can build processes, analyze the business, challenge assumptions, and develop financial strategies rather than simply report on historical results.

Key Responsibilities:
* Lead financial strategy and planning for operations in both the U.S. and Mexico.
* Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow management, financial reporting, and financial analysis.
* Develop financial models and provide recommendations to executive leadership.
* Analyze profitability, operating costs, revenue trends, and opportunities for improvement.
* Establish and monitor financial KPIs and provide regular reporting to leadership.
* Support strategic decisions involving staffing, expansion, investments, pricing, and operational growth.
* Identify financial risks and develop strategies to mitigate them.
* Evaluate the financial impact of business initiatives and provide recommendations before major decisions are made.
* Help optimize the financial relationship and flow of funds between U.S. and Mexico operations.
* Work closely with accounting, payroll, HR, operations, and executive leadership.
* Improve and establish financial processes, controls, reporting structures, and internal procedures.
* Ensure financial information is accurate, timely, and useful for decision-making.
* Coordinate with external accountants, CPAs, tax professionals, banking partners, and other financial advisors as needed.
* Monitor compliance considerations affecting U.S. and Mexico operations in coordination with appropriate professional advisors.
* Identify opportunities to improve margins, reduce unnecessary expenses, and increase financial efficiency.
* Provide leadership with forward-looking analysis rather than simply historical financial reporting.
* Take ownership of financial projects and initiatives from beginning to completion.

What We’re Looking For:
* 8+ years of progressive finance, accounting, FP&A, or financial leadership experience.
* Experience in a senior finance management, Director of Finance, VP Finance, CFO, or similar role.
* Strong understanding of financial strategy, forecasting, budgeting, cash flow, and financial modeling.
* Experience working with U.S. and Mexican financial operations strongly preferred.
* Ability to understand complex financial information and translate it into clear business recommendations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets and financial modeling skills.
* Experience working with accounting/ERP and financial reporting systems.
* Strong communication skills in English; Spanish proficiency strongly preferred.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* High level of ownership, accountability, and business judgment.

The Person We’re Looking For
This position is not intended to be a traditional accounting or finance specialist role.
We are looking for someone who can come into the organization, understand how the business operates, identify what needs to be improved, and take ownership of the finance function without needing to be directed through every step.
The right person will be comfortable saying:“Here is what our numbers are telling us, here is the risk I see, here are our options, and here is what I recommend we do.”
We want a strategic financial partner to the executive team—someone who can help us make better decisions as we grow.

Compensation
Compensation will be competitive and based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability. We are open to a mid-to-high market compensation package for the right candidate.

Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on a growing organization and help shape the financial infrastructure and strategy of operations across two countries.
The person in this role will have significant visibility with executive leadership and the opportunity to directly influence business strategy, growth, and long-term financial performance.
