jobs.description:
About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier.

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through a couple of internal interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application! 😊

About Bundle

Bundle delivers live 1:1 leadership and manager training with expert instructors. No micro-lessons, no click-through tutorials, just real conversations that build skills people actually use. We work with enterprise and mid-market companies across manufacturing, healthcare, construction, and beyond, and we’ve hit our goals six quarters in a row. Now we’re building toward where performance management meets live leadership development.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Full-Time Instructional Designer to help us craft, refine, and scale the materials that power our training sessions. You will work closely with our core learning design team to apply sound adult learning practices and ensure every deck, plan, and resource meets Bundle's high standards for quality, engagement, and consistency.

This is a remote, hands-on opportunity perfect for a detail-obsessed designer who thrives in a fast-moving environment. You won't be building from scratch on day one; instead, you'll focus on formatting, updating, and tailoring existing content to match our proven frameworks while leveraging modern AI tools to streamline your workflow.

What You'll Do

  • Format and update presentation materials to seamlessly match Bundle's design templates.

  • Build learner-specific versions of existing training materials based on clear guidelines.

  • Execute light content edits and regular updates across existing learning assets.

  • Conduct quality control, reviewing all materials for design, formatting, and consistency against Bundle's Lesson Plans.

  • Apply adult learning principles (andragogy) to keep content clear, actionable, and engaging.

  • Utilize modern AI tools (including Claude and Microsoft Copilot) to enhance instructional design efficiency.

  • Manage files, resources, and documentation independently using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint.

What You Bring

  • Solid understanding of adult learning principles (andragogy) and how to apply them to professional training.

Program Administrative Assistant (Volunteer)

Mothers to Daughters

About Mothers to Daughters:

Mothers to Daughters (M2D) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit dedicated to empowering women across generations through leadership and entrepreneurship training, educational workshops, and networking opportunities. Through intergenerational mentorship and community service, M2D advances gender equality, fosters leadership, and equips women to drive social and economic change in their communities. This handbook outlines our values, policies, and operational procedures to guide team members in fulfilling our mission.

Our Mission at Mothers to Daughters is to accelerate the personal and professional growth of women by connecting them with the lived experiences, authentic insights, and transformative wisdom of successful women. Through intergenerational mentorship, we foster a legacy of economic empowerment, social resilience, and impact-driven innovation, equipping women to lead, innovate, and build sustainable solutions that transcend generations.

Our Vision is a world where women of all generations thrive through the power of intergenerational wisdom, driving inclusivity and gender equity for lasting global impact. By bridging generations, amplifying voices, and breaking down barriers, we aim to create a future where women are elevated to the heights they deserve—leading, innovating, and shaping a more equitable and prosperous world for all.

Our Core Values at Mothers to Daughters are:

  • UnwaveringRespect

    • We honor diverse perspectives and experiences, fostering an environment where every voice is valued.

    • We believe in mutual respect between generations, recognizing the wisdom of experience and the disruptive innovation of youth.

    • We encourage bold yet respectful dialogue in discussions around gender equality, relationships, and personal development.

  • Purpose driven-Trust

    • We prioritize transparency, accountability, and credibility, ensuring that our members, mentors, and sponsors feel confident in our work.

    • We believe trust is the cornerstone of meaningful mentorship, enabling honest, courageous conversations and impactful guidance.

    • We commit to upholding the integrity of our mission, maintaining the highest ethical standards in all our partnerships and programs.

  • Synergistic Collaboration

    • We recognize that transformative change happens when we work together across generations, cultures, and industries.

    • We actively forge alliances with organizations that align with our mission, including men’s groups working toward gender equity.

    • We foster a culture of dynamic knowledge-sharing, ensuring that mentorship is a two-way exchange where both mentors and mentees grow together.

  • Transformational Empathy

    • We understand that each woman’s journey is unique, committing to creating a safe space for shared experiences and personal growth.

    • We recognize societal and personal challenges women face and approach solutions with compassion and pragmatic action.

    • We champion vulnerability as a strength, encouraging open discussions about both breakthroughs and setbacks.

  • Impact-Driven Entrepreneurial Spirit

    • We believe in equipping women with the skills, mindset, and resources to take ownership of their futures—whether through career advancement, leadership, or business ventures.

    • We encourage innovation, agility, and adaptability, ensuring our programs evolve to meet the shifting needs of our global community.

    • We emphasize bold resilience, helping women break barriers, embrace risk, and lead with confidence.

  • Unapologetic Authenticity

    • We embrace and celebrate individuality, encouraging women to bring their whole selves to the table.

    • We champion unapologetic self-expression, ensuring that every woman’s voice is heard, respected, and amplified.

    • We commit to honest, transparent communication, rejecting performative feminism in favor of practical, high-impact actions that drive real change.

  • Future-focused Innovation

    • We embrace bold, transformative thinking, pushing boundaries to create solutions that redefine possibilities for women.

    • We leverage technology, data, and creativity to amplify mentorship, leadership, and economic empowerment initiatives.

    • We foster a culture of continuous learning and reinvention, ensuring that women stay ahead in an ever-evolving global landscape.

Position Overview:

Join the Mentorship Program Team at Mothers to Daughters (M2D) as a Program Administrative Assistant and play a vital role in supporting the smooth operation of our mentorship program. This volunteer position focuses on ensuring mentees and mentors have a seamless experience, from onboarding to ongoing participation in workshops and virtual events.

  • Act as the point of contact for mentors and mentees, facilitating smooth communication and addressing inquiries.

  • Assist in creating or organizing program resources such as guides, toolkits, or FAQs for mentors and mentees.

Presentation and Content Creation

  • Assist with creating slide decks for presentations and collaborative meetings.

  • Assist with drafting and organizing content for social media campaigns.

    • Lead market access analytics and evaluate team and business performance against defined KPIs.
    • Partner with Medical Affairs and other stakeholders to anticipate evolving payer evidence requirements and develop long-range evidence strategies.
    • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team while fostering a results-driven, customer-focused, and collaborative culture.
    • Develop and manage operating budgets consistent with corporate financial objectives.

Qualifications

    • 10+ years of relevant market access experience, including experience leading high-performing payer or field market access teams.
    • Comprehensive knowledge of the U.S. healthcare system, payer landscape, reimbursement environment, and related access challenges and opportunities.
    • Deep functional expertise in market access, pricing and contracting, lifecycle management, and the integration of patient access and support services.
    • Strong financial and analytical capabilities.
    • Demonstrated success developing scalable, customer-focused market access strategies.
    • Strong understanding of the commercialization process, reimbursement integration points, and clinical development.
    • Commercial experience across areas such as marketing, sales, product launches, pricing, or contracting.

    • Ability to travel as required.

jobs.excerpt: Help Shape the Future of One of E-Commerce’s Fastest-Growing BrandsThis is a remote position.
jobs.description:
Help Shape the Future of One of E-Commerce’s Fastest-Growing Brands

This is a remote position.

Afina is an eight-figure direct-to-consumer wellness brand and the #1-selling filtered showerhead brand on Amazon. As we expand across paid social, Amazon, retail, subscriptions, and new product categories, we’re looking for a curious, commercially minded Marketing Analyst to help drive our next stage of growth.

This isn’t a traditional reporting role. You’ll work directly with our founders and Head of Growth to uncover what motivates our customers, identify new opportunities, and turn complex data into clear, actionable strategies. Your insights will influence everything from advertising and customer acquisition to product development, category expansion, and the future direction of the business.

Why This Role Is Unique

This role sits at the intersection of analytics, marketing strategy, and business growth. You’ll use data to understand the business, uncover growth opportunities, translate insights into action, and help guide how the business scales and evolves.

  • Understand our customers deeply through data and help redesign our entire marketing engine
  • Shape what products we build and where the brand expands
  • Provide insights that inform decisions about new categories and future business lines
  • Stay ahead of emerging trends in marketing and D2C brands, strategically leveraging the latest tools to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Work directly with the founders and our Head of Growth on high-impact strategic initiatives

If you want a consumer-oriented career path that blends data, strategy, and growth, this is it.

What You’ll Do

Marketing & Growth Insights

  • Identify the drivers behind winning ads and creative to uncover scaling opportunities across different product lines
  • Evaluate customer-acquisition funnel performance across different marketing channels
  • Work with the creative team to empirically test new hypotheses based on data and guide marketing initiatives
  • Own the tracking of marketing performance and clearly communicate results through dashboards and reporting

Customer & Market Analytics

  • Analyze customer behavior, cohorts, retention, and purchasing patterns to uncover useful trends and insights
  • Build segmentation models to identify high-value and high-potential customer groups
  • Evaluate product lines to understand the drivers of repeat purchases, profitability, and lifetime value (LTV)
  • Conduct competitive research and market analysis to uncover whitespace and new product opportunities

New Product & Business-Line Strategy

  • Assess demand for future product launches and category expansion
  • Build simple business cases covering TAM, unit economics, margins, and payback
  • Research new markets, partnerships, and adjacent business opportunities
  • Work with the founders to model revenue scenarios and impact

Generalist Business Development

  • Identify new growth opportunities
  • Support due diligence for potential acquisitions or collaborations
  • Improve systems for analytics, reporting, and decision-making
  • Present insights directly to leadership each week

Who You Are

  • A recent graduate from a quantitative or analytical program, such as Data Analytics, Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, or Business Analytics
  • Deeply curious about consumer behavior, e-commerce, and digital marketing
  • Highly analytical and proficient in Excel or Google Sheets; experience with Python and SQL would be beneficial
  • Able to turn data into actionable insights that create real impact—not just dashboards
  • A strong communicator who can simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences
  • Passionate about product strategy, advertising, and understanding customers
  • A self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments
  • Coachable, ambitious, and excited to grow our business while building something meaningful

Bonus Qualifications

  • Prior experience with D2C, e-commerce, paid advertising, or analytics tools
  • Exposure to Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GA4, Looker Studio, or similar platforms
  • A strong interest in consumer brands

Kickstart Your Career in Marketing Analytics & Growth

  • Join a highly analytical consumer-growth team—ideal for emerging talent eager to learn marketing from first principles, not textbook templates
  • Work alongside experienced entrepreneurs
  • Take on meaningful responsibility from day one—your insights will influence real dollars and real decisions
  • Receive competitive compensation with a fast promotion path
  • No bureaucracy or “big company” politics—just speed, ownership, and a high learning velocity

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

  • Ontario, Canada
  • Toronto, Canada

About the Role

Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real-world problems by delivering business solutions powered by Cloudflare’s global AI-powered platform.

About the Role

We are seeking an exceptionally accomplished and visionary Majors Account Executive to join our Major Accounts sales team which focuses on Canada’s largest and most strategic customers. In this expert-level role, you will be the driving force behind Cloudflare's most strategic customer engagements, leading the charge in securing and expanding critical platform sales within focused accounts. The ideal candidate possesses a profound grasp of enterprise architecture across all four pillars (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to articulate how Cloudflare seamlessly integrates into modern cloud operating models.

As a Majors Account Executive, you will demonstrate the highest level of sales proficiency, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a recognized subject matter expert, providing in-depth education to customers and partners alike on Cloudflare’s extensive product ecosystem and its place within the broader security landscape. This role demands the ability to apply executive sponsorship programs, actively engaging with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and CEOs. You will lead virtual teams that include VPs and SVPs to navigate and close complex, transformative opportunities. You will shape our customers' digital transformation journeys, identifying opportunities within broader market trends and positioning Cloudflare as their indispensable strategic partner.

Responsibilities

  • Executive-Level Strategic Revenue Leadership: Own and execute the most critical territory and account plans, consistently exceeding multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas by architecting and closing large-scale platform sales within highly focused, strategic accounts.
  • Precision Forecasting & Pipeline Mastery: Lead with unparalleled accuracy in forecasting and demonstrate complete mastery of proactive pipeline management. Provide visionary insights and strategic guidance that shapes the direction of the sales organization.
  • Enterprise Architecture & Business Model Expertise: Exhibit an expert-level understanding of customer Enterprise Architecture across all four pillars (business, data, applications, technology), seamlessly mapping these to customer business models. Articulate precisely how Cloudflare fits into and optimizes a modern cloud operating model.
  • C-Suite Engagement & Executive Sponsorship: Lead and orchestrate complex customer engagements across numerous business units simultaneously, connecting the dots to solidify platform sales. Actively apply and manage executive sponsorship programs, ensuring direct engagement and influence with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs and CEOs.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence: Drive and lead highly complex virtual teams that include Product Managers, VPs, and SVPs to manage and close the most strategic customer opportunities. Proactively identify and resolve organizational roadblocks, leveraging company-wide learnings to ensure the most efficient delivery.
  • Digital Transformation Visionary: Serve as Cloudflare's leading voice on digital transformation, engaging deeply with customers on their key drivers for change (e.g., new offering development, customer capabilities). Expertly spot and seize opportunities for Cloudflare within broader market trends that influence these critical decisions.
  • Organizational Communication & Feedback: Connect themes from across departments and global locations to craft critical, crystal-clear messaging. Review performance and output across multiple organizations, providing feedback and solutions to enhance the entire organization’s performance. Deliver challenging news within a constructive learning context.
  • Long-Term Strategic Impact: Consistently articulate how decisions will impact Cloudflare years into the future, willing to trade short-term gains for significant long-term organizational benefit. Build trust by openly sharing learnings and modelling Cloudflare's highest expectations and standards.
  • Company-Wide Innovation & Problem Solving: Consistently and proactively address internal and external needs, driving urgency across the department and company to offer solutions that optimize efficiency. Constructively and humbly challenge the status quo to drive positive change and innovation company-wide, leveraging new insights for continuous iteration.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • 10+ years of experience selling complex, multi-million dollar technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model, with a track record of consistently exceeding quota and closing transformative platform deals.
  • Mastery in understanding Customer Enterprise Architecture (Business, Data, Applications, Technology) and adept at mapping Cloudflare solutions to complex business models and modern cloud operating environments.
  • Proven ability to apply and manage executive sponsorship programs, with extensive experience engaging directly and influencing CIOs, CISOs, CTO and CEOs.
  • Demonstrated success in leading and orchestrating virtual teams comprising VPs and SVPs to manage and close the most strategic customer opportunities.
  • Recognized authority on digital transformation, with a deep understanding of market trends and the ability to strategically position Cloudflare as a critical partner in driving customer innovation.
  • Exceptional strategic communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, capable of delivering impactful messaging to the highest levels of customer and internal leadership.
  • Bachelor's degree required, with an MBA or advanced technical degree or equivalent experience preferred.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

: We released to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.excerpt: Working at Omnisend is...  kind of boring.  Not the soul-crushing kind of boring — more like the “no drama, no chaos, just smart people doing great work” kind.
jobs.description:
Working at Omnisend is... kind of boring.
Not the soul-crushing kind of boring — more like the “no drama, no chaos, just smart people doing great work” kind. The kind that lets you focus on what matters, without pointless meetings, micromanagement, or bureaucracy. We’re data-driven. We test, we iterate, we improve. Gut feelings don’t drive decisions — insights do. We trust each other. We’re transparent, give actionable feedback, and honestly listen. No egos, no hand-holding — just a team of experienced professionals moving fast, adapting easily, and delivering impact. Omnisend is customer-funded and customer-driven. Our work is rooted in solving real problems that help ecommerce brands grow. No empty promises — we bring in results. And yes, we have fun. But the grown-up kind — workations, team gatherings, the occasional party. No forced fun, no awkward icebreakers. Just genuine moments with a team that actually enjoys working together.
We are looking for a Deliverability & Compliance Manager with a cross-channel focus and deep SMS
expertise to help protect sender reputation, maintain compliance, and improve customer outcomes across Omnisend’s messaging channels. The primary focus of this role will be SMS operations, including toll-free number and Sender ID verification, 10DLC registration, carrier policies, delivery-receipt analysis, rejection investigation, opt-in and opt-out correctness, provider coordination, and customer-impacting incident resolution.
The role will also contribute to broader Deliverability & Compliance initiatives across email and SMS byimproving shared processes, documentation, standards, escalation workflows, and operational reporting. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role that does not involve people managemen

What you’ll do

  • SMS deliverability and compliance
  • Investigate rejected, failed, delayed, or partially delivered SMS messages.
  • Analyze delivery receipts, provider responses, error codes, carrier behavior, and account
    configuration.
  • Diagnose whether an issue is related to customer setup, content, provider behavior, carrier
    filtering, account security controls, or a potential product defect.
  • Manage toll-free number, 10DLC, Sender ID, and related SMS registration workflows.
  • Review business documentation and identify missing or incorrect information required for
    verification or number porting.
  • Investigate rejection patterns and recommend actions to prevent repeat failures.
  • Apply carrier policies, content restrictions, opt-in requirements, opt-out handling, and suppression
    rules.
  • Coordinate with SMS providers on verification delays, rejected submissions, delivery issues, and
    suspected provider-side incidents.
  • Support customer-impact remediation, including escalation to Billing when provider incidents
    result in failed messages or credit-impacting issues.
    Cross-channel deliverability and compliance
  • Contribute to deliverability and compliance operations across email and SMS.
  • Support email authentication and sender-reputation initiatives involving SPF, DKIM, DMARC,
    domain or IP warmup, bounce monitoring, complaint monitoring, and blocklist prevention.
  • Participate in compliance audits for relevant senders, accounts, and customer cohorts.
  • Identify patterns that affect deliverability across channels and recommend shared controls or
    process improvements.
  • Help establish consistent standards for consent, suppression, sender identity, content
    compliance, escalation, and incident documentation.
  • Apply channel-specific requirements while maintaining a consistent cross-channel operating
    framework.
    Incident investigation and escalation
  • Own complex deliverability and compliance cases from initial investigation through resolution.
  • Prepare concise escalation summaries that include the issue, impact, evidence, root-cause
    hypothesis, requested action, and next steps.
  • Coordinate with Customer Support, Technical Support, Billing, Product, Engineering, Legal or
    Compliance, and external providers.
  • Identify when an issue requires a product fix, provider escalation, policy clarification, customer
    action, or operational workaround.
  • Follow up with responsible teams and confirm that resolution and prevention actions have been
    completed.
  • Contribute to post-incident reviews and ensure that recurring issues are tracked over time.
    Documentation and operational improvement
  • Create and maintain playbooks, SOPs, templates, troubleshooting guides, and escalation
    workflows.
  • Improve the speed, consistency, and quality of SMS registration and approval processes.
  • Standardize internal and customer-facing explanations for common verification, rejection,
    deliverability, and compliance scenarios.
  • Identify opportunities for small operational automations that reduce manual effort, errors, and
    unnecessary handoffs.
  • Turn recurring incidents into prevention measures, product feedback, or process changes.
  • Share knowledge with CX, Deliverability & Compliance, Product, and Engineering teams.
    Communication and stakeholder management
  • Explain technical deliverability and compliance topics clearly to technical and non-technical
    audiences.
  • Provide Customer Support teams with accurate guidance and customer-ready language.
  • Communicate provider delays, verification decisions, compliance restrictions, and technical
    findings in a concise and practical way.
  • De-escalate difficult customer-impacting situations while maintaining policy consistency.
  • Keep stakeholders informed about risks, blockers, progress, and expected resolution paths.

We expect that you’ll bring:

  • Experience in deliverability, messaging operations, SMS operations, telecommunications,
    technical support, compliance operations, trust and safety, or a related field.
  • Strong practical knowledge of SMS registration and deliverability, including toll-free verification,
    10DLC, Sender ID, carrier filtering, delivery receipts, and provider workflows.
  • Familiarity with email deliverability concepts such as SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sender reputation,
    domain or IP warmup, bounces, and complaints.
  • Strong investigation and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to manage complex operational cases from intake through resolution.
  • Experience coordinating escalations across Support, Engineering, Product, Billing, Compliance,
    or external providers.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to create clear documentation.
  • Excellent attention to detail when reviewing account information, customer documentation,
    message content, provider responses, and incident evidence.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining clear stakeholder communication.
  • Good judgment when applying policies and deciding when to escalate.

What we offer in return:

  • Gross salary starting from 3000 EUR/month based on experience
  • An unlimited learning budget for self-improvement complying with the best interest of Omnisend
  • Working methods and best practices inspired by the best tech companies in Silicon Valley
  • Senior colleagues that enable us to have a high-performing, productive environment where your growth will accelerate
  • Private health insurance
  • Remote work possibilities
  • Unlimited access to psychotherapy
  • A workstation budget
  • Personalized work anniversary gifts (house cleaning, spas, international flights & more that you choose depending on the year)
  • Attractive workations and team-led team-building events

This role must provide technical assurance that our maintenance practices are safe, ensuring consistent and robust SOPs across around 40 fleet assistants nationwide. At the same time they must provide strategic leadership, including fleet planning, upgrade programmes, and continuous improvement to increase reliability and reduce costs.

EMED is a product of several mergers and acquisitions, giving a variety of operating models. In some places maintenance is largely outsourced to local suppliers, while in others we undertake heavy work in-house. This role needs to work with all of these, while determining the right balance and future operating model.

Benefits for the role include

  • Competitive Salary plus Car allowance
  • 33 days annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays).
  • Life Assurance – providing colleagues and their family financial peace of mind and protection to the value of £5,000.
  • Private Medical Healthcare

Technical authority for fleet within EMED

  • Be the technical authority and source of assurance for all fleet and equipment maintenance related matters, ensuring safety and compliance

Supporting fleet operations

Fleet administration

  • Lead a team which manages fleet allocation and cascades across the business
  • Lead a team to which ensures all fleet admin tasks, including paperwork and systems, are up to date

jobs.description:
**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH**

Location: Remote – Latin America
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote (Telecommute)
Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor
Industry: Construction / General Contracting
Compensation:$1,600–$1,900 USD/month
Schedule: Full-Time | Availability to work during U.S. business hours
English Proficiency: Professional written and spoken English required

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based construction company specializing in the development of community parks, amenity centers, recreational spaces, monuments, and other outdoor environments for residential developers and communities.

The company works closely with project managers, construction managers, landscape architects, and other industry partners to deliver high-quality projects with a strong focus on execution, cost control, and operational excellence.

As the organization continues to manage a growing portfolio of active construction projects, it is strengthening its financial and project accounting capabilities to provide greater visibility into project performance and costs.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Job Cost Accountant to own the accuracy and integrity of job cost data across an active portfolio of construction projects.

This role is dedicated to project financial performance and will be responsible for running and reviewing job cost reports, maintaining accurate cost coding, reconciling project financial data between Sage 100 and Procore, managing the monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule, and partnering directly with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

This is not a passive reporting role. The Job Cost Accountant will be embedded with project teams and serve as a financial partner to operations, helping ensure that costs are accurately captured, forecasts remain current, and project leadership has reliable financial information for decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Job Cost Reporting & Accuracy

  • Run, review, and distribute weekly and monthly job cost reports from Sage 100 for all active projects.

  • Reconcile Procore commitments, change orders, and invoicing against Sage 100 job cost detail.

  • Identify financial variances and work with project teams to resolve discrepancies at the source.

  • Review cost coding for AP invoices, subcontractor billings, labor, and equipment charges before they close to the job.

  • Identify misallocated expenses and coordinate corrections with the appropriate project stakeholders.

  • Maintain an accurate cost code structure in collaboration with finance and project leadership.

  • Ensure job cost information rolls up accurately for financial reporting, project analysis, and estimating feedback.

Project Management & Construction Management Partnership

  • Conduct formal monthly job cost reviews with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

  • Review budget vs. actual costs, committed costs, job cost detail, and forecast-to-complete estimates.

  • Partner with project teams to identify and correct misallocated expenses.

  • Serve as a primary finance resource for questions related to job costs, cost code selection, and committed cost reconciliation.

  • Escalate recurring coding or accountability issues to finance and project leadership when appropriate.

WIP & Percentage of Completion

  • Own the monthly WIP schedule across all active projects.

  • Maintain accurate calculations for:

    • Cost to date

    • Estimated cost at completion

    • Percentage complete

    • Earned revenue

    • Over/under billings

  • Partner with Project Managers to validate monthly cost-to-complete estimates.

  • Identify and challenge outdated or unsupported project forecasts.

  • Deliver a clean, accurate, and defensible WIP package as part of the monthly financial close process.

Specialized Cost Tracking

  • Partner with project leadership to capture the true cost of specialized construction activities when deeper cost analysis is required.

  • Establish tracking approaches before activities begin, including appropriate cost codes, labor tracking, equipment capture, and reporting structure.

  • Ensure cost information is collected accurately in real time rather than reconstructed after project activities are completed.

  • Prepare actual-cost reporting that can support future estimating, purchasing, project planning, and strategic decision-making.

Systems, Reporting & Documentation

  • Work extensively in Sage 100 and Procore as the primary systems for project cost accounting.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent financial data across both systems.

  • Build and maintain Excel reporting workbooks summarizing job cost, WIP, committed cost, and project financial performance.

  • Use AI-enabled tools and services, where appropriate, to improve reporting, reconciliation, and document review processes.

  • Maintain organized documentation and strong data hygiene across project accounting workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of job cost accounting experience with a general contractor, specialty contractor, or construction company.

  • Construction industry accounting experience is required.

  • Hands-on experience with construction job costing and project financial reporting.

  • Working proficiency with Sage 100 Contractor or Sage 100 construction job cost modules.

  • Working proficiency with Procore, including commitments, change orders, and invoicing.

  • Experience preparing and maintaining WIP schedules and percentage-of-completion calculations.

  • Strong understanding of cost codes, committed costs, project budgets, actual costs, and cost-to-complete forecasting.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, reconciliations, and reporting workbooks.

  • Experience reconciling financial information across accounting and project management systems.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and coordinate corrections with operational teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Ability to work effectively with U.S.-based finance, project management, and construction teams in a fully remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting multiple active construction projects simultaneously.

  • Experience working directly with Project Managers and Construction Managers on monthly financial reviews.

  • Knowledge of construction revenue recognition and percentage-of-completion accounting.

  • Experience with AP coding, subcontractor billing, change orders, commitments, and construction cost controls.

  • Experience using AI or automation tools to improve accounting, reconciliation, or reporting workflows.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will ensure that project financial data is accurate, timely, and actionable. Project Managers and Construction Managers will have a reliable financial partner who understands their projects, WIP reporting will be accurate and defensible, cost coding issues will be identified and corrected quickly, and leadership will have greater visibility into the true financial performance of every active project.

  • This is a remote/telecommute position.

jobs.excerpt: Are you obsessed with owning marketing outcomes, not just marketing tasks?
jobs.description:
Are you obsessed with owning marketing outcomes, not just marketing tasks?

What if your campaigns didn't just hit a KPI, but shaped how millions of people grow, learn, and act on their potential?

This isn't a "manage an agency and report up" marketing job.

We're not looking for someone who orchestrates other people's execution. We're looking for someone who runs the campaigns themselves, leveraging AI to operate at the scale of a full marketing team.

And you deserve it because you are…

  • 🛠️ You're not "a marketing manager who briefs agencies." You're a builder. You see an opportunity and your hands itch to write the campaign, launch it, and read the results yourself.

  • 🤖 You don't fear AI, you leverage it. Claude Code, prompt pipelines, and automation tools are core to how you work, you treat AI as a team of interns that lets you run what used to require five hires.

  • ⚡️ You'd rather launch a scrappy campaign this week than a perfect plan next quarter. Bias to action is your default setting.

  • 📊 You make decisions with data. You can read performance across channels, kill what doesn't work fast, and double down on what does.

3–5 years under your belt, ready to own marketing outcomes end to end in a startup.

Full-time, remote or Dubai office. French and English fluency required.

About Paradox

WHAT WE DO

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging :

- Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)

- Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals),

- Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

OUR BELIEFS

We believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

At Paradox, we believe people deserve more.

More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

We believe that every human learns differently, and that technology can do more than entertain or save time.
It can translate insight into transformation, through AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding.

Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should change how you live, think, and create.

OUR VISION

At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow.

We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness.

Founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come.

Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity.

To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective.

We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact.

While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us.

Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations be our marketing.

And that’s where you come in.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

Own marketing performance across channels, not as a coordinator, but as an operator. You set the strategy, but you also execute it, using AI leverage to punch well above the size of your team.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Own channel strategy & execution : You set priorities across paid, organic, and lifecycle marketing, and you execute the core of it yourself rather than fully delegating.

  2. Run campaigns hands-on : Briefs, copy, targeting, launch, analysis. You touch the full loop, not just the strategy slide.

  3. AI leverage : You leverage Claude Code daily to build campaign assets, automate reporting, generate creative variations, and run processes that would otherwise require a full team. This is expected, not optional.

  4. Read the data & reallocate fast : You live in GA4, ad platforms, and Looker Studio. You reallocate budget/effort toward what compounds within days, not months.

  5. Coordinate the extended team : You brief and align Growth, Social, and Content Factory efforts so channels reinforce each other instead of working in silos.

  6. Report outcomes, not activity : You bring data-backed recommendations to leadership, not just a status update.

You'll own KPIs: CAC/LTV by channel, pipeline/revenue attributable to marketing, campaign velocity (launches per month).

Desired outcomes: A marketing engine that runs lean, compounds over time, and doesn't require headcount growth to scale output.

DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF?

Experience

  • 3–5 years in marketing, ideally with both strategic and hands-on execution experience (not pure agency-management background).

  • You can show us what you've built and shipped : tests, landing pages, automations, audiences. Portfolio > pedigree. A scrappy before/after beats a polished CV.

  • You already use AI daily to create leverage and solve complex issues.

Personality

  • Curiosity: You relentlessly dig into why users behave the way they do until you uncover the insight behind the data.

  • Hands-On Execution : you build, you don't just brief.

  • Precision: You care about clarity in hypotheses, clean data, and unambiguous results.

  • Agility: You move fast, adapt instantly to new findings, and turn insights into tests within hours, not weeks.

Language

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

  1. You want a strict separation between work and life. Execution speed is our biggest advantage right now. A 9-to-5 mindset guarantees you'll fall behind.

  2. You need clarity, stability, and established process before you can act. We're still building the machine. If you need everything defined before you move, wrong place.

  3. You want to be told exactly what to do. We hire people who bring solutions, not people who wait for instructions.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

In the heart of our headquarters stands the 100 000 Dreams Wall,

Every photo on that wall is a life rewritten:

“I ran a marathon.”

“I started my company.”

“I found peace with my father.”

You will play a crucial role in the development of an Iconic Product.

Growth & Ambition

-> 🏅Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

Impact & Meaning

->Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people

->Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!
We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reach a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

-> ❤️ Contributing to the Paradox Foundation (our non-profit), dedicated to empower teenagers

But that's not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

Freedom & Well Being 🗽

-> 😎A company culture based on autonomy & accountability

-> 🗽Flexible working hours

-> 🌎A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want

-> 💻Work on Mac, for us it counts :)

HIRING PROCESS 📃

📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey.

💻 A 15-30 minutes video call, to assess the fit between the position, the company, and your own career path.
💻 A video-call focused on your career to review your background & see how we can match your desires with our needs.
💻 Aculture-fit video call to check in depth the alignment between you and our values and culture.
💼 Reference calls to get in-depth insights about how you work in different environments, make your onboarding easier, and give everybody on the team the insurance to be surrounded by A-Players.
🤗 Welcome aboard!

If you’re not joining to tweak landing pages.
If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're launching a program for experienced engineers transitioning into system architecture roles. The curriculum is being built by a team of senior authors. What we need now is the person who brings it to life for students: hosts the live sessions, reviews the work, runs the architecture review boards, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you.

This is a teaching and review role. You'll be the senior technical presence the cohort learns from week to week. You'll run live sessions and office hours, give real architectural feedback on student deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually designed and shipped systems at scale, has opinions about what good architecture looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their design is wrong, not just whether it runs.

Your audience: experienced engineers leveling up to system architecture roles. Many already write production code daily. They will spot shallow feedback instantly, so the bar here is real seniority, not familiarity.

Format: Async-first with scheduled live sessions. Live sessions and office hours are timed around a US-based cohort. Estimated 15 to 25 hrs/week.

Areas of expertise

We will bring on three Experts, each focused on one of the following areas.

Expert A — System Foundations, API & Data

  • Module 1 — Foundations of System Engineering (Architecture principles, OpenTelemetry, distributed systems)
  • Module 2 — API & Service Architecture (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, service boundaries, DDD)
  • Module 3 — Data Architecture & Storage Patterns (SQL/NoSQL, sharding, replication, Redis caching)

Expert B — Cloud, Distributed Systems

  • Module 4 — Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering (Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, FinOps)
  • Module 5 — Distributed Systems & Event-Driven Architecture (CAP theorem, event-driven, Kafka, alert routing)

Expert C — Security, AI Systems & Architecture Leadership

  • Module 6 — Security & Compliance Architecture (Zero-trust, threat modeling, compliance, secure CI/CD)
  • Module 7 — AI Systems Design & Integration (LLM integration, RAG, ML reliability, AI governance)
  • Module 8 — Architecture Documentation & Leadership (ADRs, C4 diagrams, technical communication)

Please indicate in your application which area fits you best. If you have overlapping skills, don’t hesitate to apply and indicate it in your application. Submit all resumes or CV's in English.

What you will do

  • Mentor students through 1:1 video calls, Q&A sessions, and group events, helping them clarify concepts and navigate assignments.
  • Host webinars and workshops on program topics, industry insights, and extracurricular skills.
  • Review and assess student projects, providing clear, constructive feedback aligned with program standards.
  • Engage with students on the Hub through written guidance, ongoing communication, and curated learning resources.
  • Share professional expertise to equip students with practical skills and career strategies.
  • Foster a collaborative learning environment that builds confidence, encourages interaction, and supports student growth.
  • Conduct Mock Interviews providing constructive feedback on both their technical responses and interview skills.
  • Record instructional videos for the curriculum, clearly explaining key concepts, methodologies, and course topics to support student learning.

Requirements

  • 5+ years as a senior software/systems architect, platform engineer, or senior backend/infrastructure engineer
  • Has designed and shipped systems at scale in a real company, not just coursework or side projects
  • Depth across the architectural spine: system design, API and service architecture, cloud and infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD), and distributed systems
  • Can explain why a decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's architecture live
  • Strong technical communication: comfortable leading a live session and writing clear, specific review feedback
  • Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work

What we can offer you

  • Milestone-based payments tied to deliverables
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours
  • A digital office — we use modern tools (Notion, Miro, Slack, Figma) to keep collaboration smooth
  • Professional trust and autonomy — no micromanaging
  • The chance to see real impact: our metric is graduates landing jobs in tech
  • Join a diverse, international, and close-knit team excited to work with you

Highlights:

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team — where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset.

About the Role

You'll run the programs employees feel most directly: payroll, variable compensation, equity, and benefits, across every country, entity, and contractor arrangement we operate in. You'll bring order to a complex, distributed environment — building calendars, controls, and processes that make sure people get paid accurately and on time, every time. This is a hands-on role for someone who traces issues to the source rather than passing them along, and who builds systems other people can trust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end global payroll delivery for employees and contractors, ensuring payments, deductions, reimbursements, and changes are accurate, timely, compliant, and reconciled.
  • Calculate and validate variable compensation and bonuses for executives and non-GTM employees, coordinating finalized inputs, payroll execution, controls, and reconciliation with the GTM variable-pay partner.
  • Build and run a global payroll calendar with clear cutoffs, review cycles, approvals, funding timelines, and reimbursement service levels.
  • Design and administer equity and long-term incentive programs — grants, vesting, exercises, terminations — maintaining accurate records and cap-table integrity in partnership with Finance and Legal.
  • Own global benefits administration across markets, covering statutory and supplemental programs while balancing employee value, compliance, and cost.
  • Monitor benefits utilization, market competitiveness, employee feedback, and spend; recommend changes supported by data.
  • Own payroll and equity data integrity across BambooHR, Justworks, Remote, and Carta, including workflows, integrations, permissions, and reporting.
  • Manage global employment operations, including EOR/PEO relationships from a payroll perspective, own provider governance — contracts, funding, service levels, reconciliations, escalations, and periodic performance reviews.
  • Identify recurring failure points and manual work across these programs and implement sustainable fixes rather than workarounds.

Skills and Qualifications

Must-have:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience across global payroll, total rewards, benefits, HRIS, or people operations, with meaningful ownership of multi-country payroll.
  • Demonstrated experience managing direct-entity, EOR/PEO, and contractor populations across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Hands-on experience calculating bonuses or variable compensation and building review and approval controls.
  • Experience designing or administering equity and long-term incentive programs.
  • Experience auditing an HRIS (e.g., BambooHR), including data governance, workflows, permissions, integrations, and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of payroll compliance, equity tax considerations, audit requirements, and stock-based compensation accounting concepts such as ASC 718.
  • Evidence of improving complex or manual processes in a scaling, distributed organization.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with equity platforms such as Carta, Shareworks, or Pulley.

You'll Thrive Here If You…

  • You trace a discrepancy to its root cause instead of accepting the first explanation.
  • You'd rather build the calendar and the checklist than answer the same question twice.
  • You treat a payroll error as your problem to close out, not someone else's to escalate.
  • You ask the clarifying question before the work starts, not after it's wrong.
  • You can explain a stock-comp technicality to an executive in one sentence they'll actually remember.
  • You hold sensitive employee information with real discretion, not just a policy about it.
  • You'd rather fix the process than route around it one more time.
  • You're comfortable owning ambiguity across payroll, equity, benefits, and systems in the same week.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is: €4,000 - €4,750 gross per month.

jobs.excerpt: Department OverviewThe Department of Anesthesiology and Perioperative Medicine is integral to the healthcare, education and research missions at OHSU.
jobs.description:
Department Overview

The Department of Anesthesiology and Perioperative Medicine is integral to the healthcare, education and research missions at OHSU. In this extraordinary time, we have proudly stepped up our efforts to meet these commitments. We provide clinical services at OHSU hospitals and collaborate with the VA Portland Health Care System and Hillsboro Medical Center. We specialize in providing excellent perioperative care and anesthesia services to our patients using state-of-the-art technology and pharmacologic tools with an emphasis on patient safety. In the operating rooms our anesthesiologists work in care teams with our fellows, residents, and nurse anesthetists as well as independently. Post-operative care is under the medical supervision of our department. We play a prominent role in the caring for patients in the cardiovascular, neurosciences, and newly-launched virtual intensive care units. In the ICU our team includes anesthesiology intensivists, critical care fellows, physician assistants/nurse practitioners, and residents. The role of our team in the ICUs is comprehensive and critical to achieving the highest quality outcomes for our patients.

This position provides professional fee coding and billing support to the Department of Anesthesiology and Perioperative Medicine, with a primary focus on pain management and critical care services. Responsibilities include reviewing provider documentation to ensure services are accurately and appropriately coded and supported by the medical record; assigning CPT, ICD-10-CM, and HCPCS codes in accordance with applicable Medicare, Medicaid, payer, and coding guidelines; and ensuring accurate and timely charge submission for professional services rendered at OHSU. The position provides technical expertise on third-party payer and reimbursement requirements, resolves coding and documentation issues, and may provide education to physicians and other clinical staff regarding coding and billing practices, documentation requirements, and regulatory or coding changes. Coding assignments may vary based on departmental needs and operational priorities. The position is responsible for meeting established standards for coding accuracy, productivity, timeliness, and compliance.

Function/Duties of Position

  • Billing review: Review provider documentation in Epic to ensure accurate, complete, and compliant coding of professional services. Initiate and manage provider documentation queries through Epic In Basket or Outlook to obtain clarification necessary for accurate coding. Assign CPT, ICD-10-CM, and HCPCS codes per applicable federal, state, and payer guidelines. Ensure timely charge capture and resolve coding edits to support accurate claim submission. Coordinate billing information and verify charges are complete before submission. Enter and maintain coding and billing information accurately in Epic and other applicable systems. Maintain a coding accuracy of 95% or greater while meeting departmental productivity standards of 8 to 15 codes per hour. Complete assigned work within established turnaround time expectations and comply with departmental policies and applicable coding guidelines.
  • Compliance support: Resolve coding, documentation, and billing issues with providers prior to submission to CMMI/UPS for processing. May serve as a resource on professional billing policies and documentation standards. Monitor updates from CMS, AMA, CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, payer bulletins, coding newsletters, and regulatory agencies. May communicate coding, billing, and regulatory updates to providers and coworkers. May assist with implementing process changes as needed. Ensure practices comply with applicable federal, state, payer, and organizational guidelines. Identify opportunities to improve coding quality, compliance, workflow efficiency, and accurate reimbursement. Participate in coding quality reviews, compliance initiatives, and ongoing education to maintain proficiency.
  • Billing and collection support: Serve as a resource to billing staff on coding and billing questions, help resolve coding-related claim edits, assist with identifying coding issues that may delay billing or reimbursement, respond to coding inquiries and support accurate charge capture and timely charge submission.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Minimum two years of professional fee coding experience in a hospital or healthcare setting; completion of a medical records coding program through an accredited college or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • Knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, and relevant coding and reimbursement regulations, strong medical terminology, proficiency in Epic, Microsoft Word and Excel, excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across clinicians, billing, and administrators, plus the ability to work independently and meet productivity and turnaround times.
  • Current Certified Professional Coder (CPC) required.
  • Current coding certification from AAPC or AHIMA:
  • Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) through the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA). Active AHIMA membership may be required for some positions.
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC) through the American Academy of Professional Coders; OR equivalent certification.
  • Ability to perform the job duties with or without accommodation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Accredited coding program training.
  • Two years of professional fee coding experience in pain management and critical care.

  • Some college course work or education in classes related to anatomy and physiology, CPT and ICD-10-CM coding.

  • Two years of professional fee coding experience in pain management and critical care.

  • Current Certified Professional Coder (CPC)

Additional Details

Primarily remote with flexible work hours based on departmental needs and manager approval.

Why apply to OHSU?

We are Oregon's only public academic health center. In addition to caring for patients, we lead groundbreaking research. We also train the next generation of health care professionals. As Portland's largest employer, we give you opportunities to learn and advance in a system of hospitals and clinics across Oregon and Southwest Washington. All are welcome. OHSU welcomes people of all ages, ethnicities, genders, national origins, religions and sexual orientations. jobs.title: SEO Specialist
jobs.excerpt: The Role:We are looking for an experienced SEO Specialist to support our agency and client accounts on an hourly and/or project basis.
jobs.description:
The Role:

We are looking for an experienced SEO Specialist to support our agency and client accounts on an hourly and/or project basis. This role is best suited for someone with a strong understanding of the technical and on-page sides of SEO who can independently analyze websites, identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and translate SEO findings into actionable strategies.

The ideal candidate understands how websites are structured, how search engines crawl and interpret content, and how on-page and technical factors influence organic visibility. They will also have an understanding of the evolving search landscape, including AI-generated search results, LLMs, AI Overviews, and emerging approaches to optimizing content and websites for AI-driven discovery.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical & On-Page SEO

    • Conduct technical and on-page SEO audits for client websites.

    • Analyze site architecture, crawlability, indexation, internal linking, redirects, canonicalization, metadata, structured data/schema, page speed/Core Web Vitals, and other technical SEO factors.

    • Review title tags, meta descriptions, headers, URLs, content structure, internal linking, image optimization, and other on-page elements.

    • Identify technical issues and prioritize recommendations based on SEO impact and level of effort.

    • Evaluate website architecture and make recommendations for improving search engine accessibility and user experience.

    • Identify opportunities to improve existing pages rather than relying solely on creating new content.

    • Understand local SEO fundamentals where applicable, including location-based optimization and local search visibility.

  • SEO Research & Strategy

    • Conduct keyword research and develop keyword/topic strategies.

    • Analyze search intent and identify opportunities based on how users are searching.

    • Perform competitive SEO research and identify gaps and opportunities.

    • Analyze SERPs to understand what search engines are rewarding for specific queries.

    • Develop actionable SEO recommendations for websites and individual pages.

    • Stay current with changes to Google and other search engines and their ranking systems.

  • Content Briefs & Recommendations

    • Develop detailed SEO-focused content briefs for writers and clients.

    • Provide recommendations for page topics, keyword targeting, search intent, headings, content structure, internal links, FAQs, and other on-page opportunities.

    • Review existing content and recommend updates, consolidation, expansion, or optimization.

    • Provide guidance on how content can better satisfy search intent and compete in the SERPs.

    • Work with content teams to ensure SEO strategy is incorporated into content development.

  • SEO Reporting & Analysis

    • Create clear, client-friendly SEO reports and audits.

    • Analyze organic traffic, rankings, conversions, visibility, and other relevant SEO performance indicators.

    • Translate data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations rather than simply presenting metrics.

    • Identify trends, opportunities, and potential issues within SEO performance.

    • Be comfortable working with tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics/GA4, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and similar SEO platforms.

  • SEO & LLM / AI Search

    • Understand how search is evolving beyond traditional Google results.

    • Have familiarity with Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other LLM-driven search/discovery experiences.

    • Understand emerging concepts around Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI search visibility, entity optimization, structured content, and content designed to be understood and surfaced by AI systems.

    • Evaluate websites and content for opportunities to improve visibility across both traditional search engines and AI-driven search experiences.

    • Stay informed about changes in how users discover information through search engines and LLMs.

Requirements:

  • 2+ years SEO experience preferred

  • Strong technical and on-page SEO knowledge.

  • Experience with Google Search Console and GA4.

  • Experience with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or comparable SEO tools.

  • Understanding of schema/structured data.

  • Understanding of site architecture, crawlability, indexation, and internal linking.

  • Strong keyword research and search intent skills.

  • Experience creating SEO audits and client-facing reports.

  • Experience developing SEO content briefs.

  • Familiarity with local SEO is a plus.

  • Experience with WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow, Shopify, or other common CMS platforms is a plus.

  • Knowledge of AI search, LLM optimization, GEO, and/or AI Overviews is strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
Viseven Group — міжнародна MarTech компанія, що спеціалізується на інтерактивному контенті та хмарних рішеннях для глобальних фармацевтичних компаній з 2009 року. Постійне зростання та саморозвиток закладені в нашій корпоративній ДНК. Наші унікальні розробки та підходи активно використовуються більш ніж у 50 країнах світу. Рішення Viseven представлені на великих галузевих заходах у Барселоні, Філадельфії, Лондоні тощо.
Команда, яка швидко зростає, включає понад 700+ висококваліфікованих технічних і нетехнічних експертів: front- і back-end розробників, BA фахівців та менеджерів, які створюють, локалізують і налаштовують програми у офісах по всьому світу: Житомир (Україна), Таллінн (Естонія), Познань (Польща), Нью-Делі (Індія), Бриджвотер (США).

Обов’язки:

  • Створювати адаптивні UI/UX-рішення на основі потреб користувачів, бізнесу та технічних вимог, зокрема дизайни, макети та інтерактивні прототипи;
  • Застосовувати методи користувацько-орієнтованого дизайну, а також використовувати доступні результати досліджень і зворотний зв’язок для розробки та валідації дизайн-рішень;
  • Брати участь у розвитку дизайн-системи для наявного та майбутнього функціоналу; підтримувати її компоненти, патерни та документацію;
  • Готувати дизайни та специфікації, готові до реалізації, і супроводжувати процес передачі макетів розробникам;
  • Перевіряти реалізований функціонал на відповідність затвердженим дизайнам; виявляти розбіжності, проблеми з юзабіліті та можливості для покращення;
  • Співпрацювати з дизайнерами, бізнес-аналітиками, продакт-менеджерами, розробниками, QA та технічними письменниками; комунікувати прогрес, ризики та залежності;
  • Презентувати дизайн-рішення та їхнє обґрунтування внутрішнім стейкхолдерам; враховувати зворотний зв’язок та ітеративно вдосконалювати рішення.

Необхідні знання та навички:

  • Від 3 років релевантного досвіду в продуктовому, UI/UX-дизайні та портфоліо робіт із цифровими продуктами;
  • Ґрунтовні практичні знання UI, візуального, UX та interaction design, зокрема побудови користувацьких сценаріїв, вайрфреймів, адаптивного UI, увага до деталей і візуальна послідовність;
  • Впевнене володіння Figma, включно з компонентами, змінними, прототипуванням і підготовкою макетів до передачі розробникам;
  • Розуміння та практичний досвід використання AI-інструментів у дизайн-процесах, а також здатність критично оцінювати результати їхньої роботи;
  • Досвід роботи з просунутим прототипуванням, motion design або релевантними інструментами Adobe Creative Cloud буде перевагою;
  • Практичні знання дизайн-систем, стандартів доступності WCAG 2.2, Apple Human Interface Guidelines та Material Design 3;
  • Знання методів користувацько-орієнтованого дизайну та здатність використовувати результати досліджень, аналітики, зворотний зв’язок і usability-тестування для валідації дизайн-рішень;
  • Розуміння процесів розробки продуктів/програмного забезпечення, Agile-практик та базових обмежень фронтенд-розробки;
  • Здатність швидко навчатися, самостійно працювати в межах визначеної зони відповідальності, ефективно співпрацювати з командою та чітко пояснювати дизайн-рішення;
  • Англійська — від Upper-Intermediate або вище.

Що ми пропонуємо?

Команда має для нас велике значення, тому ми цінуємо її та надаємо можливість кожному ділитися своїм баченням, втілювати власні ідеї, зростати у професійному середовищі, зберігаючи баланс між роботою та особистим життям.
Приєднавшись до Viseven, ви отримаєте:
· Конкурентоспроможну винагороду та регулярний перегляд заробітної плати
· Професійне та кар'єрне зростання

· Лікарняний без підтверджуючих документів - 4 робочих дні на рік
· Документально оформлений лікарняний - 20 робочих днів на рік
· Відпустку по сімейних обставинах - 3 оплачуваних робочих дні (у разі одруження, народження дитини або тяжкої втрати)
· Комплексне медичне страхування (включаючи курс масажів та фізіопроцедур)
· Курси вивчення англійської мови
· Можливість участі в професійних форумах і конференціях
· Регулярні корпоративні заходи та тімбілдінги
· Досвідчену команду та дружню атмосферу
· Приємне робоче середовище: комфортний, повністю обладнаний офіс та можливість працювати вдома

The ideal candidate is passionate about preserving the future of news through innovative storytelling and engagement experiences. This role is right for you if you’re constantly monitoring the latest trends in messaging (including email newsletters, SMS, WhatsApp, Discord) and emerging platforms and love to experiment and innovate.

As a key strategic leader on the new USA TODAY audience team, you will combine expertise in newsletter strategy, messaging, data analytics, and platform insights to grow audience and discoverability, deepen engagement, and support new revenue opportunities. You will also help strengthen audience engagement across the newsroom by coaching journalists on effective newsletter and messaging practices that build trust and loyalty. The successful candidate will be a collaborative, strategic thinker who can work across divisions and translate company-wide priorities into clear, actionable plans for the newsroom.

Help us ensure the future of journalism is strong and that our newsroom continues to evolve to meet the needs of a growing digital audience.

This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the US, except for Alaska, Hawaii and Wyoming. If you live near one of our local newsrooms, you may have the option to use that as a base of operations.
