jobs.description:
Secretary of the Board (Volunteer)

Mothers to Daughters

About Mothers to Daughters:

Mothers to Daughters (M2D) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit dedicated to empowering women across generations through leadership and entrepreneurship training, educational workshops, and networking opportunities. Through intergenerational mentorship and community service, M2D advances gender equality, fosters leadership, and equips women to drive social and economic change in their communities. This handbook outlines our values, policies, and operational procedures to guide team members in fulfilling our mission.

Our Mission at Mothers to Daughters is to accelerate the personal and professional growth of women by connecting them with the lived experiences, authentic insights, and transformative wisdom of successful women. Through intergenerational mentorship, we foster a legacy of economic empowerment, social resilience, and impact-driven innovation, equipping women to lead, innovate, and build sustainable solutions that transcend generations.

Our Vision is a world where women of all generations thrive through the power of intergenerational wisdom, driving inclusivity and gender equity for lasting global impact. By bridging generations, amplifying voices, and breaking down barriers, we aim to create a future where women are elevated to the heights they deserve—leading, innovating, and shaping a more equitable and prosperous world for all.

Our Core Values at Mothers to Daughters are:

  • UnwaveringRespect

    • We honor diverse perspectives and experiences, fostering an environment where every voice is valued.

    • We believe in mutual respect between generations, recognizing the wisdom of experience and the disruptive innovation of youth.

    • We encourage bold yet respectful dialogue in discussions around gender equality, relationships, and personal development.

  • Purpose driven-Trust

    • We prioritize transparency, accountability, and credibility, ensuring that our members, mentors, and sponsors feel confident in our work.

    • We believe trust is the cornerstone of meaningful mentorship, enabling honest, courageous conversations and impactful guidance.

    • We commit to upholding the integrity of our mission, maintaining the highest ethical standards in all our partnerships and programs.

  • Synergistic Collaboration

    • We recognize that transformative change happens when we work together across generations, cultures, and industries.

    • We actively forge alliances with organizations that align with our mission, including men’s groups working toward gender equity.

    • We foster a culture of dynamic knowledge-sharing, ensuring that mentorship is a two-way exchange where both mentors and mentees grow together.

  • Transformational Empathy

    • We understand that each woman’s journey is unique, committing to creating a safe space for shared experiences and personal growth.

    • We recognize societal and personal challenges women face and approach solutions with compassion and pragmatic action.

    • We champion vulnerability as a strength, encouraging open discussions about both breakthroughs and setbacks.

  • Impact-Driven Entrepreneurial Spirit

    • We believe in equipping women with the skills, mindset, and resources to take ownership of their futures—whether through career advancement, leadership, or business ventures.

    • We encourage innovation, agility, and adaptability, ensuring our programs evolve to meet the shifting needs of our global community.

    • We emphasize bold resilience, helping women break barriers, embrace risk, and lead with confidence.

  • Unapologetic Authenticity

    • We embrace and celebrate individuality, encouraging women to bring their whole selves to the table.

    • We champion unapologetic self-expression, ensuring that every woman’s voice is heard, respected, and amplified.

Overview

LMI is seeking an Applied Statistician, Forecasting & Simulation to support passport demand forecasting for the Department of State, Bureau of Consular Affairs, Passport Services.

This role is focused on applied statistics, forecasting, predictive modeling, econometrics, and simulation. The successful candidate will develop, evaluate, and refine statistical models used to forecast passport demand and help government stakeholders understand demand drivers, uncertainty, and potential future scenarios.

The ideal candidate has a strong statistical foundation, experience with time series and forecasting methods, and the ability to critically evaluate model assumptions, performance, and limitations.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain statistical, econometric, and time series models to forecast passport demand.
  • Apply forecasting methods such as regression, ARIMA, exponential smoothing, state space models, Bayesian methods, and other appropriate techniques.
  • Develop simulations and scenario analyses to evaluate uncertainty and potential future outcomes.
  • Perform model validation, backtesting, sensitivity analysis, residual analysis, and forecast error evaluation.
  • Analyze historical demand, survey data, economic indicators, demographics, travel trends, policy changes, and other potential demand drivers.
  • Evaluate model assumptions, data quality, structural changes, bias, and sources of uncertainty.
  • Compare alternative modeling approaches and recommend methods based on accuracy, interpretability, and statistical rigor.
  • Monitor actual demand against forecasts and identify opportunities to improve model performance.
  • Communicate methodology, assumptions, uncertainty, and analytical findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Maintain reproducible analytical workflows, model documentation, and technical artifacts.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or another highly quantitative discipline.
  • Ability to operate efficiently using new and emerging tools of quantitative analysis.
  • Experience in statistical analysis, forecasting, econometrics, predictive modeling, or related quantitative analysis.
  • Strong knowledge of regression, probability, statistical inference, time series analysis, model validation, and uncertainty.
  • Experience developing and evaluating forecasting models using ARIMA, regression-based forecasting, exponential smoothing, state space models, or comparable methods.
  • Experience with simulation, scenario analysis, or probabilistic modeling.
  • Experience validating models through backtesting, sensitivity analysis, residual analysis, or out-of-sample testing.
  • Proficiency with Python, R, Stata, SAS, MATLAB, or comparable statistical tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to independently structure and solve complex quantitative problems.

Desired Qualifications

  • Master's degree or PhD in Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with demand, economic, population, workload, or other longitudinal forecasting.
  • Experience with Bayesian methods, Monte Carlo simulation, multivariate time series, or advanced econometric techniques.
  • Experience analyzing survey data, including sampling, weighting, representativeness, and sampling error.
  • Experience with Python statistical libraries, Stata, or R.
  • Experience working with economic, demographic, travel, public policy, or government administrative data.
  • Experience developing or evaluating simulation models and scenario-based forecasts.
  • Experience supporting federal government customers.

About SafeLease

At SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.

SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.

We're a team of 85, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.

About The Role

We’re looking for a revenue leader to own all distribution, servicing, and customer success across SafeLease’s full suite of self-storage insurance products — tenant protection, tenant insurance, and specialty property & casualty. You will run the commercial engine of the business unit, responsible for how our products reach the market through both our direct-to-operator channel and our growing network of retail agents and brokers, how partners and customers are served day-to-day, and how we retain and expand relationships over time.

This role sits within the Storage Products business unit alongside the General Manager. You’ll work cross-functionally with our CRO’s sales organization, our CMO’s product marketing team, and our CIO’s insurance product group — but your accountability is to the vertical’s revenue number and the health of its customer base. SafeLease recently opened its specialty P&C program to independent retail agents and brokers nationwide, and the Revenue Lead will scale this channel alongside our established direct distribution to operators.

What You’ll Own

Distribution:

  • Design and execute the distribution strategy across all self-storage insurance products (tenant products and commercial P&C), spanning both the direct-to-operator channel and the retail agent/broker network.

  • Own and grow the retail agent and broker channel launched in 2026, including producer onboarding, activation, and ongoing relationship management.

  • Identify, develop, and manage relationships with key distribution partners such as facility management companies, REITs, aggregators, technology platforms, and independent insurance agencies.

  • Collaborate with the centralized Sales and Marketing teams to align pipeline generation with vertical-specific positioning and messaging.

  • Build and optimize the distribution mix across direct and agent channels to balance growth with unit economics.

Servicing:

  • Own the end-to-end servicing experience for storage insurance customers and distribution partners.

  • Ensure onboarding, policy administration, and ongoing support meet or exceed expectations at scale.

  • Build and manage the servicing team and operational workflows, working with Technology to automate where possible.

  • Monitor servicing KPIs (response time, resolution rate, partner NPS) and drive continuous improvement.

Customer Success:

  • Drive net revenue retention through proactive account management, upsell, and cross-sell.

  • Build a success function that identifies at-risk accounts early and intervenes effectively.

  • Develop the playbook for expanding wallet share within existing storage operator relationships.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer back into the business unit, informing product improvements and new feature priorities.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in revenue leadership, distribution, or commercial roles within insurance, insurtech, or adjacent B2B financial services.

  • Deep familiarity with the self-storage industry. Existing relationships with storage operators, REITs, and industry partners that allow you to hit the ground running are critical.

  • Proven track record of building and scaling distribution channels, ideally in specialty or commercial insurance.

  • Experience owning a revenue number (quota, retention target, or P&L line) and consistently delivering.

  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, evolving organizational structure where you’ll need to build processes and teams from scratch.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts. That means you know how to partner with product, marketing, underwriting, and engineering without needing direct authority.

  • Executive presence and communication skills suited to managing relationships with large operators, REITs, and C-suite stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience at a managing general agent (MGA), managing general underwriter (MGU), or specialty carrier.

  • Underwriting background or working knowledge of commercial P&C underwriting principles is a plus but not required.

  • Background in property insurance, tenant/occupant protection programs, or specialty P&C lines.

  • Familiarity with self-storage management software platforms (e.g., SiteLink, storEDGE, Hummingbird).

  • Prior experience in a business-unit or “company within a company” structure.

Why SafeLease?

The tech: Our prospects convert fast because we’re solving real problems and delivering serious value to commercial real estate owners.

The team: We’re a team of seasoned pros and sharp operators who know how to move fast and build smart. High standards, low ego.

The stability: We’re well-funded, growing fast, and we make sure our team shares in that success with competitive pay and equity.

The employee experience: We also offer unlimited PTO, full health benefits, flexible work setups, and the kind of culture where people want to show up to do their best work.


If you don't have all the qualifications listed, don't worry! We understand everyone's career path is unique and still encourage you to apply if you feel this role is aligned with your career trajectory.

Employment at SafeLease is contingent upon a satisfactory verification of a general and criminal background check.

jobs.title: Senior Claims Analyst- Hospital Bill Review
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Analyst with deep expertise in hospital claims adjudication, stop loss reporting, high-cost/catastrophic claims, and DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) reimbursement methodology.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Analyst with deep expertise in hospital claims adjudication, stop loss reporting, high-cost/catastrophic claims, and DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) reimbursement methodology. This individual will analyze itemized hospital bills and claims data to identify billing errors, coding discrepancies, DRG misassignments, and other overpayment opportunities, then work directly with claims administrators on behalf of our ASO clients to secure claim adjustments, recoveries, and repricing.

This is a highly analytical, client-facing role requiring both technical claims expertise and strong negotiation/communication skills.

This is a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Claims Analysis & Review

  • Perform detailed audits of hospital and facility claims, including itemized bills, UB-04 claim forms, medical records, and remittance advices, to validate billing accuracy.

  • Analyze DRG assignments and coding to identify DRG upcoding, unbundling, duplicate billing, and other irregularities that affect reimbursement.

  • Review high-cost and catastrophic claims (typically $100K+) to identify overpayments, contract misapplication, and opportunities for negotiated adjustments.

  • Evaluate claims against plan documents, provider contracts, reference-based pricing methodologies, and CMS guidelines to determine appropriate reimbursement.

Stop Loss & High-Cost Claims Expertise

  • Understand and apply stop loss (specific and aggregate) provisions, laser terms, and reporting requirements as they relate to claim adjustments and client financial exposure.

  • Coordinate with stop loss carriers and reinsurers as needed to ensure adjustments and recoveries are properly reflected in stop loss reimbursement calculations.

  • Identify claims nearing or exceeding specific deductible thresholds and prioritize review accordingly.

Client Advocacy & Claims Administrator Negotiation

  • Serve as the subject matter expert and advocate on behalf of ASO clients in disputes with claims administrators (TPAs) and carriers regarding claim payment accuracy.

  • Prepare clear, well-documented findings packages (clinical, contractual, and coding rationale) to support requested claim adjustments and appeals.

  • Lead or support negotiations with claims administrators to reach adjusted payment resolutions.

  • Track disputes through resolution, escalating unresolved cases appropriately and maintaining strong working relationships with TPA claims and provider relations teams.

Data & Reporting

  • Analyze large claims data sets to identify trends, outlier claims, and systemic overpayment patterns across client populations.

  • Build and maintain claim tracking logs, savings reports, and client-facing summaries of identified and recovered savings.

  • Partner with internal data/analytics teams to refine claim-flagging logic and improve identification of high-value review opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • Hospital/Surgical/ICU Nursing background (RN) and clinical coding background for clinical validation of DRG and medical necessity issues.

  • 5+ years of experience in hospital claims analysis, medical bill review, claims auditing, or payment integrity, with direct exposure to self-funded/ASO plans.

  • Strong working knowledge of DRG methodology (MS-DRG/APR-DRG), UB-04 billing, ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT/HCPCS coding, and hospital chargemaster structures.

  • Demonstrated understanding of stop loss insurance, including specific/aggregate deductibles, laser provisions, and how claim adjustments impact stop loss reimbursement.

  • Experience analyzing high-cost/catastrophic claims and identifying overpayment or billing error patterns.

  • Prior experience interacting with or negotiating against TPAs, insurance carriers, or claims administrators on disputed claims.

  • Proficiency with claims data analysis tools (Excel required; SQL, Access, or claims analytics platforms a plus)

  • Knowledge of policy terms, coverage guidelines, statutory/regulatory compliance requirements and litigation/dispute workflows.

  • Ability to interpret and translate in common terms legal contracts, summary plan descriptions (SPDs), and statutory guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build persuasive, well-supported adjustment requests and appeals.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage a high volume of complex claims simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Medical Bill Review Specialist, or similar credential.

  • Prior experience at a TPA, insurance carrier, hospital billing/coding department, or payment integrity/cost containment vendor.

  • Familiarity with reference-based pricing (RBP), Medicare fee schedules, and out-of-network claims repricing.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent identification of material overpayments and billing errors on high-cost hospital claims.

  • Strong track record of securing favorable claim adjustments through negotiation with claims administrators.

  • Clear, professional communication that strengthens client trust and TPA relationships.

  • Measurable contribution to client savings and stop loss cost containment.

jobs.excerpt: About VGSVGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce.
jobs.description:
About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

About the Role

In this role, you will work with the world’s largest wallets, card networks, and AI/agent platforms. This includes coordinating directly with the networks (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), and emerging AI commerce and agent-payments providers. You will be focusing on building seamless token APIs, defining and implementing protocols, and trust frameworks that let agents pay securely on behalf of humans. This industry is evolving before our eyes, and you will define what "agent-ready" payments infrastructure looks like before the rest of the industry has agreed on the answer.

What You’ll Do

  • Product Strategy & Discovery: Work directly with partner engineering teams (networks, wallets, AI platforms) to translate emerging standards like Agentic Tokens, ACP, UCP, MPP, etc… into concrete product requirements and roadmaps.

  • Own and drive multi-partner technical integrations end-to-end - you'll be in the weeds with partner engineers, not just handing off specs.

  • Represent VGS in emerging standards conversations, helping define how agent-initiated transactions are authorized, tokenized, and secured across networks.

  • Design browser automation tooling that allow for AI systems to perform human-like interactions in a way that keeps the AI system out of scope with

  • Help build a product point of view on how agentic commerce should work technically, then use that conviction to influence partners and internal engineering roadmaps.

  • Understand, integrate with, and build on top of pre-existing VGS tokenization and payments infrastructure.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 3+ years as a Product Manager, with prior experience in a technically-hands-on role - solutions engineering, technical account management, integration engineering, or software engineering - within payments, fintech, or API platforms.

  • Direct experience delivering APIs, SDKs, or protocols in a partner-facing capacity. You've been the person on the call debugging an integration in real time, and understand what’s needed to fully operationalize a product concept. This includes designing reporting, observability, and other similar systems.

  • Genuine, demonstrated interest in AI/agentic systems - side projects, contributions, or professional work exploring how AI agents interact with external systems.

  • Communication Skills: Comfortable moving between deeply technical partner engineering conversations and executive/GTM conversations about strategy and roadmap.

Mindset:

  • Partner-savvy strategist: You've spent years sitting at the intersection of technical specs and business relationships. This includes interpreting protocol docs, negotiating requirements with vendor and partner teams, and translating product ideas into a roadmap that gets delivered.

  • Curious about the frontier: You're drawn to agentic commerce because it's genuinely unsolved, not just because it's trendy.

  • Technical credibility with product instincts: You can hold your own in a technical design review, but you're increasingly motivated by shaping "what should we build" over "how do we build it.". This means that you can confidently define the differences between various agentic protocols, understand API specs across vendors, and create easy to use interfaces that solve the underlying technical problems rather than giving the issues to the end-consumer to solve.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Prior work with AI agent frameworks, LLM tooling, or agent-to-agent protocols.

We're looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft and want to help grow a team tackling some of the most critical problems in payments. People who thrive here are curious by nature, unafraid of hard problems, and motivated by the chance to build something that matters at scale.

If you're driven to make a meaningful impact, work at the leading edge of payment technology, and grow your career alongside a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, you'll feel right at home at VGS.

How We Work

At VGS, we embrace a remote-first philosophy because we believe flexibility leads to great work and a healthy work-life balance. That said, if you live within 30 miles of one of our office locations, you'll be on a hybrid schedule with some in-person time, because we know there's real value in coming together.

We're not about being in the office every day. We are about connection, collaboration, and the energy that comes from a great brainstorm, a team lunch, or celebrating a big win in person.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Data Developer to support a large-scale CRM consolidation initiative, migrating data from multiple legacy systems into Salesforce Health Cloud. This role is critical to ensure accurate, compliant, and high-quality patient, provider, and program data during system consolidation and cutover.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Salesforce data migrations, healthcare data, and complex transformation logic, and can operate confidently in regulated environments involving PHI.

Key Responsibilities

CRM Consolidation & Data Migration

  • Design and develop data migration pipelines to consolidate multiple legacy CRMs, flat files, and APIs into Salesforce Health Cloud
  • Extract, transform, and load high-volume datasets (patients, enrollments, cases, activities, clinical timelines)
  • Map legacy data models to Salesforce Health Cloud standard and custom objects
  • Implement full-load and incremental (delta) migration strategies
  • Support cutover planning, execution, and rollback readiness

Salesforce Health Cloud Data Development

  • Develop data loads using Salesforce Bulk API v2, REST, and Composite APIs
  • Implement upsert strategies using External IDs
  • Manage Salesforce governor limits and performance constraints during large migrations
  • Load and validate Person Accounts, Care Programs, Care Plans, and related objects
  • Support multi-org consolidation into a single target Health Cloud org

Data Quality, Identity & Validation

  • Perform data profiling, cleansing, normalization, and de-duplication
  • Implement patient identity resolution and survivorship logic
  • Validate referential integrity across related objects
  • Produce reconciliation reports (record counts, field-level validation)
  • Partner with business SMEs to validate migrated data

Compliance, Security & Governance

  • Ensure HIPAA-compliant handling of PHI and PII
  • Apply data masking strategies in non-production environments
  • Support consent, auditability, and data retention requirements
  • Maintain traceability and documentation for regulatory review

Testing & Cutover Support

  • Support migration dry runs and parallel testing
  • Resolve data defects during UAT
  • Participate in go-live cutover and post-migration stabilization
  • Monitor data load errors and remediate issues quickly

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Work closely with Salesforce Architects, Admins, Integration teams, and Compliance partners
  • Document data mappings, transformation rules, and load procedures
  • Communicate risks, dependencies, and data issues clearly to stakeholders

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in data development or data engineering
  • 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce data migration experience
  • Strong SQL and data transformation skills
  • Experience with ETL tools (Informatica, Talend, MuleSoft, Boomi, SSIS) or custom Python-based pipelines
  • Proficiency with REST/SOAP APIs

Salesforce & Healthcare Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Health Cloud
  • Strong understanding of Person Accounts and CRM data relationships
  • Experience migrating healthcare, pharmacy, hub services, or patient services data
  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards (FHIR / HL7 – preferred)

Compliance & Quality

  • Experience working with PHI / PII
  • Understanding of HIPAA data handling requirements
  • Strong focus on data accuracy, completeness, and auditability

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience consolidating multiple CRMs into a single Salesforce org
  • Prior hub services or patient assistance program experience
  • Exposure to CTI, omnichannel, or case management data
  • CI/CD experience for data pipelines
  • Experience supporting Salesforce Health Cloud reporting and analytics

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart's mission is to create a world where everyone has access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Online Grocery is the heart of that mission — the products millions of customers rely on every day and the team that builds them. We're looking for a Chief of Staff, Online Grocery to partner with the General Manager who leads this business and its product and R&D organization of ~200 people across product, design, research and technical program management.

People, operations and programs are the core of the work — but what should energize you is what that work makes possible. A Chief of Staff here helps the organization operate at its best: more cohesive, clearer in its purpose, sharper and faster in how it makes decisions and operates, and enabled to do the thing that matters most — building products our customers love. If you're motivated by improving how a team works, and serve as a multiplier on everything the team can ship, this is your role.

This is a highly strategic and operational individual-contributor role (no direct reports) for someone exceptionally organized, has strong business and strategic sense, high in empathy, and who has an understanding of how product, design, and engineering teams work.

About the Job

Run the operating rhythm

  • Own and continuously improve the business rhythm for the GM and the organization — leadership team syncs, all-team meetings, monthly and quarterly business reviews, planning reviews, organizational communications, and Online Grocery segments of company-wide all-hands.
  • Manage the operating cadence for the GM — prioritizing and delegating workstreams, ensuring the right things get the right attention at the right time.
  • Improve how the organization decides: clarify decision rights and the questions that matter, build the frameworks and pre-reads that bring options into focus, and remove the friction that slows good calls.
  • Once decisions are made, capture and sharpen them, ensure they're communicated to the right stakeholders, and close the loop on execution — keeping leadership priorities, decisions, and commitments visible and on track (R&D execution itself is owned by TPM).
  • Shape and run the substance of the leadership team offsites: objectives, agenda, pre-reads, the hard discussions, decisions, and follow-through (logistics and events are handled separately).
  • Be a trusted thought partner to the GM and a credible problem-solving partner to product and R&D leaders, and build strong relationships with chiefs of staff across the organization to partner effectively in getting your responsibilities done.
  • Prepare briefings and coordinate research for the GM's meetings with partners and key leaders — identifying goals, talking points, and relevant context.
  • Partner with the GM, HR and finance to manage the organization's headcount budget

Plan executive communication

  • Drive the calendar, planning, and content for upward communication and alignment with the C-suite and the board on Online Grocery priorities.
  • Support the GM in preparing content for speaking engagements (working with our comms team).

Strengthen people, culture, and organizational health

  • Help the GM spot, diagnose, and get ahead of issues across the organization — bringing structured, candid read-outs and early signals, not just status.
  • Partner with the GM and HR to address relationship and culture dynamics across the team and create a high-trust, high-performance leadership team culture.
  • Turn signals like engagement surveys into action — working across the organization to develop the right plans, pressure-test them, and ensure they get executed and the loop gets closed with teams.

Drive priority programs

  • Help the GM kick off and drive annual and long-range planning for Online Grocery.
  • Take ambiguous new efforts for the GM from unclear to fully underway — creating clarity and a plan, identifying DRIs, setting up the decisions that need to be made, aligning stakeholders, and developing the right operating rhythm to track progress.
  • Proactively identify and take ownership of emerging opportunities and risks before they become blockers.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of work experience
  • R&D experience — earned in a direct R&D role (product, design, engineering, or technical program management), an adjacent role embedded with R&D teams, or as a Chief of Staff within an R&D organization
  • Consulting, corporate strategy/operations, or finance background and experience working directly with executives
  • Working fluency to navigate a product, design, and engineering organization at scale, and to be a true problem-solving partner to R&D leaders rather than a coordinator.
  • High EQ and a genuinely people-oriented instinct — builds trusted relationships, reads organizational dynamics, and bridges leadership and teams.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication at an executive level
  • Strong analytical skills, and a commitment to consistently high-quality work.
  • Exceptional program management: organized, effective, and relentless at driving multiple hard initiatives forward to deadline at once.
  • Ability to travel 10%

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing and facilitating leadership offsites and driving organizational, culture, or operating-model change.
  • Experience building with AI (e.g., prototypes, automations, or agents) in a professional setting.
  • Experience within high-growth, technology-driven companies.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

Job Title: Clinical Research Associate II, Phase I - Florida

Job Location: Remote Florida

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Our Phase I team is currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate with 1+ years of experience. Ideal candidates would have phase I experience and reside in the Florida.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will utilize your skills, knowledge, and clinical judgement to provide a high standard of care for participants in clinical trials and respond to emergency situations based upon clinical research standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for all aspects of study site monitoring including routine monitoring and close-out of clinical sites, maintenance of study files, conduct of pre-study and initiation visits; liaise with vendors; and other duties, as assigned -

  • Responsible for all aspects of site management as prescribed in the project plans

  • General On-Site Monitoring

  • Ensure the study staff who will conduct the protocol have received the proper materials and instructions to safely enter patients into the study

  • Ensure the protection of study patients by verifying that informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to according to the applicable regulatory requirements

  • Ensure the integrity of the data submitted on Case Report Forms (CRFs) or other data collection tools by careful source document Monitor data for missing or implausible data

  • Responsible for all aspects of registry management as prescribed in the project plans - Undertake feasibility work when requested

  • Complete Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reporting, process production of repo11s, narratives and follow up of SAEs

  • Independently perform CRF review; query generation and resolution against established data review guidelines on Fortrea or client data management systems as assigned by management

  • Assist with training of new employees, eg. co-monitoring

  • Coordinate designated clinical projects as a Local Project Coordinator (with supervision, if applicable) and may act as a local client contact as assigned

  • Perform other duties as assigned by management

Requirements

  • University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g. nursing licensure)

  • 1+ years of Clinical Monitoring experience

  • Phase I experience

  • 40-50% overnight travel

The important thing for us is you are comfortable working in an environment that is:

  • Fast paced: where no deviations from the study protocol are allowed, and not meeting a timeline for even few minutes will create a quality issue.

  • Changing priorities constantly asking you to prioritize and adapt on the spot.

  • Teamwork and people skills are essential for the study to run smoothly.

  • Technology based. We collect our data directly into an electronic environment.

Work Environment:

  • Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.

  • Frequent travel to clients/ site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to sit for extended periods and operate a vehicle safely.

  • Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.

  • Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.

  • Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.

  • Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.

  • Regular and consistent attendance.

  • Varied hours may be required.

  • Target Pay Range: $100 - $120K

jobs.excerpt: About Intermedia Are you looking for a company where YOUR VOICE is heard?
jobs.description:
About Intermedia

Are you looking for a company where YOUR VOICE is heard? Where you can MAKE A DIFFERENCE? Do you THRIVE in a FAST-PACED work environment? Do you wake every morning EXCITED to work with GREATPEOPLE and create SUCCESSTOGETHER? Then Intermedia is the place for you.

Intermedia has established itself as a leading provider of cloud communications and collaboration tech that allows companies to connect better. We have a strong track record of growth, profitability, and creating an environment where everyone matters. Everyone. While we are fast-paced and admittedly a bit intense, we promise that you won’t be bored. You will find Intermedia is a place where you can indulge your passion for creating and supporting great cloud technology. What’s more, we always look to promote from within and have many employees who have been with us 10, 15, and 20+ years!

Culture at Intermedia is built on teamwork and transparency. We hold each other accountable and always have each other’s back!
Are you ready to make your mark?
About The Role:
The ServiceNow Developer is a hands-on technical contributor within the IT organization, responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and supporting ServiceNow solutions that improve business workflows, operational efficiency, and user experience. This role partners closely with IT, Security, HR, Finance, and other business stakeholders to translate process needs into scalable, maintainable platform capabilities.
As a ServiceNow Developer, you will help build and enhance the ServiceNow platform, develop integrations and automations, support ITSM and related workflows, and ensure solutions are secure, well-documented, and aligned with platform standards.
For internal candidates, this role represents advancement into a specialized platform development path, requiring strong technical aptitude, disciplined configuration practices, and the ability to deliver reliable ServiceNow solutions while collaborating across functional teams.

What you will bring to the role:

  • ServiceNow Platform Development: Design, develop, configure, and maintain ServiceNow applications, modules, forms, lists, flows, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, script includes, notifications, service catalog items, and related platform components.
  • Workflow Automation and Process Enablement Build and improve workflows using Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, approvals, catalog workflows, and automation capabilities that reduce manual effort and improve service delivery across the organization.
  • ITSM and Enterprise Service Management Support: Support and enhance ITSM processes such as Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Asset, and Configuration Management. Partner with stakeholders to extend ServiceNow capabilities into additional business functions when appropriate.
  • Integrations and Data Management: Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations with enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, import sets, transform maps, scheduled jobs, and other integration patterns. Ensure data quality, reliability, and traceability across connected systems.
  • Platform Quality and Release Management: Participate in development, testing, code review, deployment, and post-release validation. Promote changes through development, test, and production environments using disciplined release and change management practices.
  • Security, Governance, and Compliance: Implement role-based access controls, ACLs, data policies, audit practices, and secure development standards. Partner with Information Security and platform owners to ensure solutions align with organizational policies and compliance expectations.
  • Troubleshooting and Operational Support: Serve as an escalation resource for ServiceNow defects, performance issues, workflow failures, integration errors, and user-impacting incidents. Conduct root cause analysis and implement durable fixes.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain clear technical documentation, configuration notes, solution designs, support runbooks, and user guidance. Share knowledge with administrators, support teams, and business stakeholders to improve platform adoption and supportability.
  • AI and Platform Innovation: Evaluate and responsibly apply ServiceNow AI, automation, and virtual agent capabilities where they improve user experience, operational efficiency, and service quality. Follow approved guardrails for AI-assisted development and platform use.
Additional Responsibilities:
  • Embody Core Values: Lead by example in upholding Intermedia's Core Values: Deliver Exceptional Experiences, Learn and Improve, Act with Integrity, Be Transparent, Succeed as One Team.
  • Operational Excellence: Contribute to platform stability, performance, scalability, and supportability through thoughtful design, disciplined configuration, and continuous improvement.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with process owners, business analysts, administrators, and end users to understand needs, validate requirements, and deliver practical solutions.
  • Confidentiality and Compliance: Handle sensitive information with discretion and adhere to all organizational policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.

What you will bring to the role:

  • 3-6 years of progressive experience developing, administering, or supporting ServiceNow in an enterprise environment.
  • Demonstrated success delivering ServiceNow enhancements from requirements through production deployment.
  • Experience working in ITSM, enterprise service management, or business workflow automation environments.
Technical Expertise:
  • Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow configuration and development, including forms, lists, tables, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, script includes, notifications, catalog items, and Flow Designer.
  • Proficiency with JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting concepts; familiarity with HTML, CSS, APIs, and web application fundamentals.
  • Experience with ServiceNow ITSM processes; exposure to CMDB, Discovery, Service Catalog, Knowledge, Asset, or Change Management preferred.
  • Experience building and troubleshooting integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, import sets, transform maps, and scheduled data loads.
  • Understanding of ServiceNow security concepts including roles, groups, ACLs, data policies, and secure development practices.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow release management, update sets, application repository/source control concepts, testing practices, and platform upgrade readiness.
Professional Skills:
  • Strong communicator and collaborative partner, able to work effectively with a Senior ServiceNow Developer to translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable ServiceNow solutions. Skilled at clarifying requirements, explaining platform behavior, identifying dependencies, and bridging communication between technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborative problem-solver with the ability to balance stakeholder priorities, ServiceNow best practices, platform standards, and long-term maintainability.
  • Detail-oriented and quality-focused, with a bias toward durable solutions, clean documentation, and continuous improvement.

Diversity, Inclusion, and Equal Opportunity

We do not tolerate employment discrimination in the workplace, and we are committed to making reasonable accommodations for identified disabilities or other limitations as required by all applicable laws. Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Why this role matters:

We are seeking an experienced and technically skilled Senior AEM Developer to join our digital engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise-level web applications using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM / AEM as a Cloud Service). You will collaborate closely with product owners, UI/UX designers, and front-end developers to deliver high-performing, scalable, and secure digital experiences.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Technical Design & Development: Design and develop custom AEM components, templates, dialogs, schedulers, workflows, and OSGi services using Java, HTL/Sightly, and Sling Models.

  • Architecture & Implementation: Build robust multi-site, multi-lingual, and multi-channel publishing solutions leveraging AEM WCM, DAM (Digital Asset Management), and MSM (Multi-Site Manager).

  • Cloud & Modernization: Guide migration efforts and work extensively with AEM as a Cloud Service, Dispatcher configurations, and modern deployment pipelines.

  • Integrations: Integrate AEM with third-party systems and enterprise services, including CRM, analytics (Adobe Analytics/Target), and headless content APIs.

  • Code Quality & Mentorship: Conduct rigorous code reviews, enforce best practices in software development (TDD, CI/CD), and mentor junior-to-mid-level developers.

  • Performance Optimization: Troubleshoot and optimize application performance, caching strategies (Dispatcher cache flush), and security compliance.

  • AI : Demonstrate the usage of AI Agents and code assistants to improve the productivity across the software development lifecycle, by reducing boilerplate coding, automating repetitive tasks, accelerating code reviews, and reducing time-to-market for new features.

  • Agile Delivery: Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, translating business requirements into technical execution plans and accurate estimates.

What you'll bring

Required:

Experience:

  • 5+ years of total software development experience.
  • 3+ to 5+ years of hands-on technical experience specifically with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.x and AEM as a Cloud Service).

Core AEM Expertise:

  • Deep understanding of the underlying AEM framework, including Apache Sling, Apache Felix (OSGi), JCR (Java Content Repository), and CRX.
  • Proficiency in building Touch UI components using Granite UI, HTL (HTML Template Language), and Sling Models.
  • Experience configuring Dispatchers, replication agents, and cloud manager pipelines.

Backend & Frontend Technologies:

  • Advanced proficiency in Core Java / J2EE, web services (REST) and enterprise design patterns.
  • Solid front-end foundation: HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript (ES6+), SCSS,Tailwind CSS, and responsive design frameworks (e.g., Bootstrap, React, or Vue).

DevOps & Tooling:

  • Experience with build automation and version control tools: Maven, Webpack, Babel, Git, Jenkins, and Adobe Cloud Manager.
  • Familiarity with unit testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito).

Methodologies:

  • Strong background working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Experience we consider a plus:

  • Adobe-certified expert credentials (e.g., Adobe Certified Expert – AEM Sites Developer).
  • Experience with headless content delivery (AEM Content Services / GraphQL).
  • Hands-on exposure to Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem tools (Adobe Target, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Campaign).

How you’ll benefit:

  • Attractive Discretionary Time Off
  • Private Medical Insurance with optional dependent coverage
  • Educational Assistance Reimbursement Program
  • Opportunities for reimbursement for conferences, trainings, and other personal development events
  • Maternity and Paternity Leave
  • Ask recruiter for country specific information

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

About Triplemoon

About Triplemoon

Our Vision

We help families add years to their life—and life to their years.

Our Mission

Triplemoon exists to close the pediatric mental health gap. Founded in 2023, we partner with pediatricians and family medicine practices to deliver integrated, evidence-based behavioral health care that’s fully covered by insurance, including Medicaid. Our mission is simple: make high-quality mental health support accessible to every family—while helping providers reclaim time, improve outcomes, and build sustainable practices. By combining collaborative care, modern technology, and a whole-family approach, Triplemoon is transforming how—and where—children receive the behavioral health support they deserve.

Our Values

  • Whole Human – We treat the whole child and family
  • Evidence-Based – We rely on proven, data-driven care
  • Endlessly Curious – We are always learning and improving
  • Make It Happen – We take ownership and move quickly
  • Radically Candid – We communicate openly and honestly

Continuously Improving – We iterate and grow together

Position Summary

We are seeking a compassionate, dynamic, and dedicated Head of Psychiatry with excellent pediatric clinical experience and extensive organizational leadership skills. In this role, you will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals to deliver high-quality psychiatric consultation within a virtual context. Your work will be essential in providing accessible, timely, and effective mental health support to the children and families who need it most.

At this time we are seeking individuals with licenses in: TN, TX, CA, MD, FL, VA, CT, CO. If you are not licensed in one of these states we welcome your application if you are willing and able to obtain this licensure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set overall vision for Triplemoon’s psychiatry function
  • Serve as owner of the Company's affiliated professional corporation(s) including all hiring, training, and oversight of Triplemoon’s psychiatry medical staff including psychiatric advanced practice providers.
  • Support quality assurance
  • Support care planning development through the creation of structured psychiatric medication management recommendations and guidelines
  • Oversee professional development of Triplemoon’s broader clinical team including serving as a primary culture carrier and role model of our pediatric care modelCollaborate with behavioral health care managers and PCPs to review patient caseloads, providing treatment recommendations for patients with depression, anxiety, ADHD, bipolar disorder, and other behavioral health conditions
  • Conduct weekly systematic caseload reviews to monitor patient progress and adjust care plans
  • Provide indirectpsychiatric consultation on diagnostic clarification, psychopharmacologic treatment options, and complex cases

jobs.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

TopDog Law is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director of Treasury to lead the firm’s treasury function and ensure the organization has the liquidity, cash visibility, banking infrastructure, and financial controls needed to support continued growth.

This role will oversee daily cash management, banking relationships, cash forecasting, liquidity planning, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and treasury risk management. The Director of Treasury will partner closely with Accounting, Finance, Executive Leadership, and other business leaders to ensure capital is efficiently managed and financial decisions are supported by accurate, timely cash-flow information. This role will also support our Trust Operations department, which processes settlement receipts and disbursements.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, operationally minded, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This person will build scalable treasury processes while remaining close to the day-to-day execution of the function.

What You Will Own

  • Lead the firm’s overall treasury function, including cash management, liquidity, banking, and payment operations.
  • Develop and maintain short- and long-term cash flow forecasts to provide leadership with clear visibility into liquidity and funding needs.
  • Monitor daily cash positions across bank accounts and entities and optimize the movement and allocation of cash.
  • Manage banking relationships, including account structures, banking services, fees, credit facilities, and ongoing relationship management.
  • Establish and maintain treasury policies, procedures, controls, and approval processes.
  • Oversee cash disbursements, wires, ACH activity, transfers, and other treasury-related payment processes.
  • Recommend and implement proper segregation of duties between IOLTA trust account activities and settlement accounting.
  • Ensure appropriate controls are in place around bank access, payment authorization, segregation of duties, and fraud prevention.
  • Partner with Accounting to ensure bank activity, cash balances, and treasury transactions are accurately recorded and reconciled.
  • Analyze cash utilization, working capital, and liquidity trends and identify opportunities to improve cash efficiency.
  • Support the development and implementation of treasury technology, banking platforms, and automation initiatives.
  • Manage relationships with financial institutions and third-party treasury service providers.
  • Evaluate banking products, investment options, and other financial services as appropriate to the organization’s needs.
  • Assist with debt management, credit facilities, financing activities, and other capital structure initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain reporting that provides leadership with actionable insight into cash balances, liquidity, forecast accuracy, and treasury activity.
  • Identify and mitigate treasury-related risks, including fraud, counterparty, liquidity, interest-rate, and operational risks.
  • Establish scalable treasury processes that can support TopDog Law’s continued growth and expansion.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Operations, and Executive Leadership on projects involving cash, banking, payments, and financial risk.
  • Provide analysis and recommendations to senior leadership regarding liquidity, cash management, and treasury strategy.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor treasury team members as the function grows.
  • Take ownership of special projects and other strategic financial initiatives as needed.

What You Bring

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in treasury, corporate finance, banking, or a closely related function.
  • Experience leading or managing a corporate treasury function in a high-growth or complex organization.
  • Strong understanding of cash management, liquidity forecasting, banking operations, and treasury controls.
  • Demonstrated experience managing banking relationships and financial institutions.
  • Experience managing IOLTA accounts and knowledge of IOLTA compliance laws.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills with the ability to build and analyze complex cash-flow models.
  • Experience with treasury management systems, banking platforms, ERP/accounting systems, or financial automation tools.
  • Strong understanding of ACH, wire transfers, payment processing, bank reconciliations, and cash controls.

Position Title: Procurement Lead

BibliU is an award-winning, technology-led B2B company transforming the $65bn educational content industry. With a 90% CAGR the past 5 years, we are just getting started. Founded in late 2015 as an Oxford University spin out, we've grown explosively with 90% CAGR over the last five years, including 65% in FY25, reaching $100m in annual revenue. Our Series B raised $23m led by Nesta Impact Investments (with Guinness Asset Management, Stonehage Fleming, and Oxford Sciences Enterprises). We're hungry for more. We're actively building our M&A pipeline as we compete head-to-head against legacy bricks-and-mortar providers to improve the faculty and student experience while boosting the financial sustainability of universities.

Our culture is collaborative, high-growth, and agile. You’ll join an experienced and motivated executive team with backgrounds from Instructure (Canvas) and other successful edtech companies with exit experience. We operate as a distributed team across the UK and US, with offices in London.

Position Overview

The Procurement Lead is responsible for owning the end-to-end procurement process, sourcing, negotiating, and managing suppliers to ensure the organization gets quality goods and services at the best possible cost. Sitting within Finance, this role pairs hands-on procurement execution with budget discipline and financial controls, working closely with FP&A and Accounting to keep spend visible, forecastable, and compliant.

The Procurement Lead uses ERP and spend-analytics tools to drive data-informed sourcing decisions and to tie procurement activity directly to the company's broader financial planning and reporting.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies across assigned spend categories
  • Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers on pricing, terms, and contracts

  • Partner with FP&A on procurement forecasting, budget planning, and cost-savings targets
  • Partner with Accounting/AP on invoice matching, accruals, and month-end close for procurement-related spend
  • Build and maintain procurement policies, approval workflows, and spend controls (thresholds, competitive bidding requirements)
  • Partner with Legal and business stakeholders to align procurement with company needs
  • Support audit readiness and internal controls (e.g., SOX) for procurement and vendor spend
  • Resolve supplier quality, delivery, and invoicing issues
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and drive continuous process improvement

What we are looking for

Must have:

  • 5+ years of progressive procurement experience.
  • Experience with strategic sourcing and vendor contract negotiation across multiple spend categories
  • Proven experience designing procurement processes, policies, and systems from the ground up
  • Experience running RFPs and vendor selection processes on behalf of business stakeholders
  • Experience partnering with Security, Compliance, and Legal on vendor risk assessments
  • Comfortable operating with significant ambiguity and building structure where none exists today

Good to have:

  • Experience with AI tools
  • Prior experience in a procurement function embedded within Finance (vs. Operations or Supply Chain)
  • Familiarity with AP/invoice processes, accruals, or audit/SOX controls

Benefits

Our benefits are all aimed at supporting a healthy work-life balance and cultivating a company culture where you can bring your whole, human self to work.

Here's what we offer:

  • 🌴 35 holiday per year - yep, that’s not a typo! (in addition to public holidays)
  • 🎂 Your birthday off
  • 🌱 12 scheduled company wellness Fridays off per year (in addition to your vacation entitlement)
  • 🩺 Medical, vision & dental insurance (BibliU contributing 70% of all monthly premiums)
  • 📄 401k plan (Company Match: 100% of the first 3%; 50% of the next 2%)
  • ❤️ Enhanced maternity & paternity allowance
  • 💸 Flexible Spending Account
  • ⏰ Flexible working hours - we’re a remote team spread across the US and UK
  • 💻 Work-from-home allowance to help you set up your dream WFH station

We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds, experiences and identities to apply. Each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective and BibliU is committed to building an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone can do rewarding work.

You will serve as the internal design authority for our CRM and integration landscape: reviewing and challenging technical decisions, ensuring our architecture remains sound, scalable, and secure, and guiding both internal staff and external delivery partners.

Working with AI as a Force Multiplier

We expect this role to make active, strategic use of AI tools — Claude in most regions, an equivalent in China — as a core part of how work gets done. This is not optional and not peripheral.

What this means in practice:

  • Using AI to generate solution design options, integration patterns, and configuration drafts — then applying your domain judgment to validate, challenge, and improve what is produced
  • Prompting AI to write DataWeave transformations, Apex code, or MuleSoft flows as a starting point — then reviewing and refining with the expertise to know when the output is wrong
  • Accelerating documentation: architecture diagrams, decision records, integration specs, runbooks
  • Using AI to research platform capabilities, compare design options, or stress-test a proposed approach against edge cases
  • Staying ahead of what AI can and cannot do reliably — and calibrating how much to trust its output in each context

You do not need to be the deepest Salesforce or MuleSoft expert in every room. You need to be technically strong enough to validate what AI and external partners produce, and to intervene decisively when something is wrong.

What You Will Do

Architecture & Technical Design Authority

  • Own the architectural vision for Banyan Group's CRM and integration landscape — current state (Salesforce + MuleSoft) and future state
  • Lead technical design sessions with internal teams and external delivery partners; produce and maintain architecture diagrams, data flow documentation, and decision records
  • Act as design authority and gatekeeper: review and approve (or challenge) solution blueprints from external vendors before implementation proceeds
  • Define scalable data models, integration patterns, and API contracts aligned to enterprise standards and long-term platform flexibility
  • Identify technical debt, anti-patterns, and architectural shortcuts early — and recommend remediation paths

Integration & Data Architecture

  • Govern the integration landscape between Salesforce and hotel PMS systems (Opera Cloud, Opera On-Premise, Opera 5), booking engines, spa and F&B platforms, and third-party vendors
  • Ensure integration patterns remain consistent, auditable, and maintainable — with MuleSoft as the current hub but without assuming it is permanent
  • Define identity resolution, data quality, and deduplication standards across the guest profile ecosystem
  • Oversee data flow design for real-time and batch processing, ensuring consistency between CRM, Data Cloud, and downstream marketing and operations systems

Vendor Oversight & Delivery Governance

  • Independently review and challenge technical deliverables from external implementation partners — you must be capable of identifying gaps without depending on the partner to self-report
  • Establish and maintain internal runbooks for hotel onboarding, PMS integration, and platform configuration — progressively reducing Banyan's dependency on external vendors
  • Define test case standards and UAT expectations; ensure testing covers not just functional requirements but integration reliability, data integrity, and security controls
  • Participate in architecture review boards and steer discussions toward outcomes that serve Banyan's long-term interests, not vendor preferences

Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Collaborate with the Corporate IT and Cybersecurity team to ensure the platform meets security standards, including VAPT remediation, access controls, and data residency requirements
  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, PDPA, PIPL (for China operations), and internal data governance policies
  • Define and enforce least-privilege access models across Salesforce roles and MuleSoft credentials
  • Flag and escalate compliance risks proactively — particularly around guest PII, cross-border data flows, and AI connector usage

Platform Operations (Selective)

  • Provide hands-on support for complex platform issues where architecture judgment is needed — not routine administration
  • Support environment management, release planning, and deployment governance in collaboration with the external delivery partner
  • Oversee data quality monitoring and coordinate remediation when integration failures or data integrity issues affect live operations

Hands-On Platform Evolution

You are expected to build, not just govern. Using AI as a force multiplier, you will own and deliver bounded platform changes end-to-end:

  • Scope, design, and implement well-defined platform changes: retiring unused data streams, adjusting identity resolution rules, modifying integration mappings, updating Loyalty Cloud tier logic, reconfiguring Marketing Cloud journeys or suppression lists
  • Apply SDLC discipline to your own changes: sandbox-first development, review of AI-generated code or configuration, regression testing, documented deployment, and a rollback plan
  • Distinguish clearly between what you can deliver independently, what needs external delivery support, and what requires a full architecture review before any work begins
  • Produce your own test cases and verify your own changes before release — not dependent on a separate QA function for routine platform evolution
  • Use AI tools (Claude or equivalent) to generate DataWeave transformations, Apex code, Flow logic, or configuration scripts — then review and validate with the technical depth to catch errors before they reach production

A practical example: if Banyan decides to stop managing transactional email sends from Loyalty Cloud and to deprovision non-member records from both CRM and Data Cloud, you would scope the impact, design the change safely, execute it across Salesforce and MuleSoft, test it end-to-end, and document what changed — with AI assistance throughout, but under your own judgment and ownership.

What We Are Looking For

Foundation (Required)

  • A background in software engineering, enterprise integration, or data architecture — Salesforce and MuleSoft came later in your career, not first
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in integration architecture, enterprise application architecture, or equivalent — you have built things, debugged production failures, and owned technical decisions under pressure
  • Solid understanding of integration design patterns: event-driven architecture, API-first design, pub/sub, synchronous vs asynchronous flows, idempotency, error handling at scale
  • Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming or scripting language; comfortable reading and evaluating code across languages you did not write yourself
  • Grounded understanding of data modelling, identity resolution, and the realities of data quality at enterprise scale (duplicate records, incomplete profiles, schema migrations)
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation — architecture diagrams, data flow specs, decision records — that non-specialists can also follow

Salesforce & MuleSoft (Hands-On Working Knowledge Required)

  • Enough depth in Salesforce (Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Loyalty Cloud, Service Cloud) to make real configuration and logic changes independently — not just review them
  • Able to sit down with AI assistance and evolve the platform in a controlled way: modifying data streams, adjusting flows, updating integration mappings, retiring unused components, or reconfiguring journey logic
  • Working knowledge of MuleSoft / CloudHub 2.0 — integration flows, DataWeave, connector configuration, error handling, and monitoring — sufficient to write, debug, and deploy changes with AI support
  • Understanding of Salesforce multi-tenant constraints, governor limits, and security model — enough to catch bad practices early and design safely
  • Familiarity with Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Bulk, Streaming) and how they are used in large-scale PMS and third-party integrations
  • Understanding of SDLC as it applies to a configuration-heavy platform: sandbox management, change sets or CI/CD deployment, regression testing, and change documentation

Domain Experience (Advantageous)

  • Hospitality, travel, retail, or loyalty-driven industries — particularly guest 360, membership ecosystems, or omnichannel personalisation
  • Experience with hotel PMS systems (Opera Cloud or On-Premise) — even at the integration interface level — is genuinely valuable given our current programme
  • Prior experience overseeing or governing an external implementation partner, not just working alongside one
  • Multi-jurisdiction data privacy experience — GDPR, PDPA, and ideally PIPL for China operations

AI Fluency (Required)

  • Active, confident user of AI tools (Claude, GPT-4, or equivalent) in a technical context — not for general productivity but for architecture, code review, and design work
  • Capable of crafting effective prompts that produce useful technical output, and of recognising when AI output is incorrect, incomplete, or subtly wrong
  • Comfortable working in a context where AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an occasional novelty
  • Awareness of AI governance considerations — what data should and should not be sent to external AI services, and how to operate responsibly in a regulated, guest-data environment

Who we are looking for

An architect by formation — someone whose foundation is software engineering, enterprise integration, or data systems — who has since mastered Salesforce and MuleSoft as tools in service of a broader craft. We are explicitly not looking for someone whose entire career has been built on the Salesforce platform.

The immediate technology context is Salesforce and MuleSoft. But the architecture decisions made today must remain defensible if those platforms change tomorrow. For example, our E-commerce domain is making use of Kong as an API gateway for integration. We need someone who thinks in domain terms first — loyalty mechanics, integration patterns, data governance, guest identity — and platform terms second.

What we deliberately do not require

  • Salesforce certifications — domain depth and independent judgment matter more than credential accumulation
  • Full-stack MuleSoft or Apex development capability — you will use AI to generate and iterate on implementation, with your own judgment applied to validate and own the result
  • A background that is 100% Salesforce — in fact, we actively prefer candidates who can evaluate Salesforce critically because they know alternatives
  • Experience with every integration in our current stack — curiosity and architecture first principles transfer across systems
