jobs.title: Customer Service Rep 1
jobs.excerpt: Position Summary:The FEMA Call Center Customer Service Representative (CSR) serves as a direct telephone point of contact for individuals registering for federal disaster assistance, callers seeking information about a prior registration, and individuals seeking referrals to disaster relief programs and other assistance providers.
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The FEMA Call Center Customer Service Representative (CSR) serves as a direct telephone point of contact for individuals registering for federal disaster assistance, callers seeking information about a prior registration, and individuals seeking referrals to disaster relief programs and other assistance providers. The CSR conducts customer interactions with patience, tact, courtesy, and professionalism; determines the caller's needs; provides approved instructions and referrals; and accurately enters information into FEMA-approved computer systems while following a scripted interview process.

The CSR performs work in direct support of FEMA's Individual Assistance mission during periods of disaster activity. Depending on the applicable Call Order, assigned duties may include Registration Intake (RI), Basic Helpline (HL), Transitional Sheltering Assistance (TSA), outbound calling, document review or validation, case-related support, and referrals to other disaster assistance providers.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a direct point of contact for disaster survivors and other callers seeking federal assistance, registration services, status information, or referrals.
  • Conduct every call with patience, tact, courtesy, empathy, and professionalism.
  • Listen actively and determine the caller's needs using approved procedures and scripts.
  • Provide accurate instructions, information, telephone numbers, and referrals based on current FEMA-approved guidance.
  • Conduct scripted interviews and collect required information from callers.
  • Accurately enter caller-provided information into FEMA's Windows-compatible database or other FEMA-approved systems.
  • Complete required data entry and other call-agent work while the caller is on the telephone, except for limited after-call work permitted by the contract.
  • Perform Registration Intake (RI) duties when assigned.
  • Perform Basic Helpline (HL) duties when assigned, including assisting callers with questions concerning prior registrations.
  • Perform Transitional Sheltering Assistance (TSA) or other specialized lines of business when authorized and trained.
  • Conduct outbound calls when assigned.
  • Perform document review, document validation, or other specialized processing functions when assigned and trained.
  • Provide referrals to appropriate secondary support organizations and other disaster assistance providers.
  • Attend required pre-shift meetings and briefings and remain current on event-specific information, priorities, procedures, and policy changes.
  • Follow FEMA-approved scripts, job aids, Standard Operating Procedures, work instructions, and supervisor direction.
  • Maintain required availability and readiness to receive calls during assigned production periods.
  • Meet applicable customer service, quality, productivity, attendance, schedule-adherence, and call-handling standards.
  • Participate in quality monitoring, coaching, calibration, remedial training, and performance-improvement activities.
  • Immediately report system, security, privacy, technical, or operational issues through established CRI procedures.
  • Perform other related duties assigned in response to FEMA's level of support and the requirements of the applicable Call Order.

Security, Privacy, & Protection of Information:

  • Protect FEMA Personally Identifiable Information (PII), Sensitive but Unclassified (SBU) information, and other protected information always.
  • Access FEMA information only when authorized and when access is necessary to perform assigned duties.
  • Do not retain PII or other information from calls outside authorized FEMA systems and procedures.
  • Do not create or retain handwritten or electronic notes containing caller PII unless expressly authorized by the contract and applicable procedures.
  • Immediately destroy any permitted temporary notes in accordance with FEMA requirements.
  • Do not discuss or expose FEMA caller information to unauthorized persons.
  • Perform all work in an approved environment that satisfies FEMA/HSPD-12 security requirements.
  • Never handle FEMA calls from a public environment or another location where unauthorized persons may hear or access protected information.
  • Comply with all DHS, FEMA, CRI, HSPD-12, cybersecurity, privacy, and information-security requirements.
  • Immediately report suspected security incidents, unauthorized disclosure, lost equipment, improper access, or other security concerns.

Mandatory Eligibility & Security Requirements:

  • Must be a United States Citizen.
  • Lawful permanent resident are not eligible for this FEMA assignment.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Must successfully complete the FEMA-required background investigation and receive the required favorable adjudication before receiving access to protected FEMA information or systems.
    • Not in default on federal student loans.
    • Demonstrated financial responsibility.
    • No felony convictions within the past 7 years.
    • Misdemeanor convictions within the past 7 years may impact eligibility.
    • No non-medical collections totaling $7,500 or more.
  • Must satisfy applicable HSPD-12 and FEMA access requirements.
  • Must complete required DHS IT Security and Privacy Training.
  • Must complete all FEMA-required training applicable to the assigned line of business before performing production duties.
  • Must maintain required credentials and system access throughout the assignment.
  • Must comply with any additional security, suitability, background-investigation, or access requirements established by a specific FEMA Call Order.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • United States Citizenship.
  • At least 18 years of age.
  • Ability to read, write and speak English fluently.
  • Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with individuals by telephone.
  • Basic computer proficiency and demonstrated ability to work in a Microsoft Windows based environment.
  • Ability to accurately enter information while simultaneously communicating with a caller.
  • Ability to follow detailed scripts, instructions, policies and procedures.
  • Ability to learn and retain program-specific information and apply it accurately.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and safeguard sensitive information.
  • Ability to work effectively in a high-volume contact center environment.
  • Ability to remain calm, patient, tactful, and professional when assisting individuals who may be experiencing stressful circumstances.
  • Ability to successfully complete required background investigation, security, privacy, and FEMA training requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous call center or contact center experience.
  • Previous customer service experience involving high-volume telephone contacts.
  • Experience with data entry or case-management systems.
  • Experience working with government programs, public benefits, emergency management, disaster assistance, or related services.
  • Experience following scripted interviews or structured data-collection processes.
  • Prior FEMA Registration Intake or Helpline experience.
  • Prior experience working in a secure environment involving PII or other sensitive information.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Excellent telephone communication and customer-service skills.Strong active listening and information-gathering skills.
  • Patience, tact, courtesy, empathy, and professionalism.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer applications while maintaining a customer conversation.
  • Ability to accurately interpret and apply written procedures.
  • Ability to learn and apply complex program requirements.
  • Ability to protect confidential and sensitive information.
  • Ability to accept coaching and apply quality-assurance feedback.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing disaster-event priorities, procedures, and workloads.

Performance Expectations:

  • Customer Service: Provide courteous, professional, empathetic, and accurate assistance.
  • Quality: Follow scripts and procedures and maintain required accuracy in customer interactions and data entry.
  • Productivity: Meet applicable production-hour, availability, call-handling, and productivity expectations.Schedule
  • Adherence: Report as scheduled and remain available and ready to accept assigned contacts.
  • Security: Maintain strict compliance with FEMA, DHS, HSPD-12, and CRI security and privacy requirements.
  • Training: Successfully complete all required training and demonstrate competency before performing assigned production duties.
  • Professional Conduct: Maintain professional conduct with callers, supervisors, coworkers, FEMA personnel, and other stakeholders.
  • Responsiveness: Promptly communicate operational, technical, security, or customer-service issues to CRI leadership.
  • Continuous Improvement: Participate constructively in quality reviews, coaching, calibration, and remedial training.

Work Environment and Remote Work Requirements:

  • Work may be performed at a CRI facility or from an authorized remote location when permitted by the applicable FEMA Call Order.
  • Remote employees must work from an approved location that satisfies FEMA security and privacy requirements.
  • Remote work requires a private work environment where unauthorized individuals cannot hear calls or view FEMA information.
  • Remote personnel must use CRI-approved equipment, systems, connectivity, and security controls.
  • Employees must not conduct FEMA calls from public locations, vehicles, restaurants, classrooms, malls, or other unauthorized environments.
  • The position requires prolonged periods of sitting, computer use, telephone communication, and headset use.
  • The operation may require shifts during evenings, weekends, holidays, and other extended operating periods based on FEMA demand and Call Order requirements.

jobs.title: ICT/Telecom
jobs.excerpt: TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition.
jobs.description:
TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition. We are growing — multiple teams across the US, UK, and India are actively hiring to grow their teams.

When you apply here, you are applying to TEECOM for a role in ICT/Telecom. Rather than interviewing for a single posted role, you will go through a structured Discipline Assessment that establishes your level and demonstrated capability. Once your level is determined, TEECOM's recruiting and leadership teams match your profile to the best available opening on a team that fits your skills, experience, and goals.

Roles span Designer II through Principal, Senior Consultant. Your level — and your title — are determined by your assessment, not by the role you apply to.

If you have meaningful experience in more than one discipline, apply to your primary discipline and tell your recruiter about your secondary discipline(s) during your Introduction Call. You may be scheduled for a separate Discipline Assessment for each one.

ICT/Telecom at TEECOM

    TEECOM's ICT/Telecom practice designs and documents the telecommunications and structured cabling infrastructure that connects buildings, campuses, and organizations. Our clients span a wide and growing range of industries and facility types across the US, UK, and India.

    Work spans structured cabling systems (copper and fiber), outside plant infrastructure, distributed antenna systems (DAS), public safety radio coverage, passive optical networks, and other low-voltage communications infrastructure. ICT/Telecom designers at TEECOM work across the full project lifecycle — from concept design and basis of design through construction documents, specifications, and construction administration. You will collaborate with architects, MEP engineers, IT teams, and construction managers to deliver coordinated, buildable technology infrastructure drawings.

    At more senior levels, you will lead design decisions, mentor junior staff, manage client relationships, and help grow TEECOM's ICT/Telecom practice.

What We're Looking For

    We hire at all levels — the strongest ICT/Telecom candidates are proactive, curious about how infrastructure actually gets built, and take ownership of producing documents that contractors can follow without guessing.

    If you don’t have everything on this list yet, that’s expected — TEECOM develops people through structured documentation, mentorship, and real project work.

    • Experience designing structured cabling systems (copper and fiber) across a range of facility types and industries
    • Familiarity with BICSI standards, TIA/EIA cabling standards, and applicable low-voltage code requirements (NFPA 70, local codes)
    • Ability to read and produce construction documents — floor plans, riser diagrams, details, and specification sections
    • Experience with Revit and/or AutoCAD for technology systems documentation
    • Understanding of outside plant infrastructure, including conduit routing, manholes, and fiber optic systems — preferred
    • Experience with DAS design or public safety radio systems (NFPA 72, IFC) — preferred
    • BICSI RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer) certification — preferred
    • PE license (electrical preferred) — preferred
    • Ability to manage your own work independently across multiple concurrent projects

      • *TEECOM covers exam fees and study materials for certifications relevant to your discipline, pays a one-time bonus when you pass, and funds all continuing education — including conference attendance.

TEECOM is a fully remote consulting firm. We hire across all US states, the UK, and India. Our projects span the globe — some roles involve international travel, so share your comfort level with your recruiter.

If you're ready to be assessed on your own merits and matched to the right team, apply here. If you have questions about the process, contact recruiting directly.

epilot is building a SaaS product to sell complex products online, focusing on solving ecommerce in the rapidly transforming energy market. Our mission: Make selling complex energy products as easy as selling a pair of shoes online.

As Software Engineer at epilot you will be a driving force in shaping this mission. What makes working as a Software Engineer at epilot so special? Our unique engineering culture is defined by a few core engineering principles.

We "epilots" are a team of experts from the fields of software development, energy management, product management and sales. In order to bring our solution even faster to the top in the energy world, we are looking for you as a Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack).

Requirements

What awaits you

As a Product Engineer at epilot, you’ll go beyond just coding. You’ll play an integral role in building our cutting-edge platform using technologies like TypeScript, React, Svelte, and serverless AWS microservices. Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Immerse yourself in our tech stack: Microfrontends, serverless AWS, and best-in-class developer tooling and automation. Learn more here:

  • Be part of a cross-functional dream team: Collaborate with full-stack, backend, and frontend developers, designers, and product managers to deliver impactful features.

  • Work end-to-end: From ideation to delivery, you’ll team up with product management and design to bring features to life and make product decisions.

  • Take ownership: Got an idea? Draft an RFC (Request for Comment), drive the initiative, and own it from start to finish.

  • Foster growth: Mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and continuously learn new technologies.

  • Innovate with agility: Participate in diverse, exciting development projects, leveraging pair programming and agile methodologies.

What you bring

We’re looking for a Product-Minded Engineer who resonates with our values and has the following skills and mindset:

  • Product Thinking: You care about delivering value to customers and users, not just writing code.

  • Technical Expertise:

    • Hands-on experience with React or other JavaScript frameworks.

    • Knowledge of RESTful APIs or GraphQL.

    • Familiarity with microservices architecture and public/private cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).

  • Ownership Mentality: You take initiative, drive features to completion, and thrive on responsibility.

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: You think like a business owner, understanding how your work impacts our goals.

  • Problem-Solver: You see challenges as opportunities for growth.

  • Collaborative Mindset: You’re a true team player who motivates and inspires those around you.

  • Agile Know-How: You’re familiar with methodologies like Scrum, Kanban, or XP and understand how to apply them effectively.

What we offer you

At epilot, we believe in rewarding performance, fostering growth, and creating an environment where you’ll thrive:

  • Impactful Work: Be part of a product-driven company that’s reshaping the energy sector.

  • Startup Mentality: Enjoy a dynamic atmosphere with flat hierarchies and open communication.

  • Flexibility: Work remotely or from our centrally located office in Cologne, with flexible working hours.

  • Growth Opportunities: Your career will grow as fast as we do. Learn, experiment, and embrace a “Fail Fast and Often” mentality.

  • Competitive Compensation: We take your desired salary seriously and value performance.

  • Team Spirit: Join us for regular events like summer parties, company breakfasts, and our epic annual epilot summit, where you’ll connect with co-epilots worldwide.

  • Transparency and Openness: Everything is open for discussion in our inclusive and supportive culture.

What to/we expect in your first 180days

By Week 1 you will:

  • Start learning the business: who our customers are, what we're building toward, why it matters

  • Connect with the team and empower the team

By Month 1 you will:

  • Own a topic: have your name on a topic, be the main driver of that topic from refinement to delivery. Already shipping the first iteration of it

  • Have a good understanding of the codebase and how our services connect

  • Know enough about our customers and domain to push back on bad ideas, including ours

By Month 3-6 you will:

  • Be the undisputed owner of your domain: the go-to person, the one who spots problems before they're reported and fixes them before they're assigned

  • Have shipped something that visibly moved a metric: adoption, reliability, performance, or revenue

jobs.excerpt: Department: Sales Reporting to: UK Pod Lead Employment type: Full-time Salary: £40,000-£45,000; OTE up to £105,000 Location: Remote, UK-based, with monthly London meetups and regular periods working from China of up to 3 weeks at a time Languages: Fluent Mandarin and professional-level English About GocertifyGocertify is a bootstrapped UK tech start-up helping brands run smarter, more targeted reward campaigns.
jobs.description:
Department: Sales

Reporting to: UK Pod Lead

Employment type: Full-time

Salary: £40,000-£45,000; OTE up to £105,000

Location: Remote, UK-based, with monthly London meetups and regular periods working from China of up to 3 weeks at a time

Languages: Fluent Mandarin and professional-level English

About Gocertify

Gocertify is a bootstrapped UK tech start-up helping brands run smarter, more targeted reward campaigns.

We verify eligible audiences such as students, key workers and seniors, so brands can move away from broad discounting, protect brand value and offer the right rewards to the right customers.

We are trusted by 500+ brands, including Samsung, Sainsbury's and FARFETCH. We work with 2m+ shoppers a year, drive £125m+ in retail sales, and have grown profitably and bootstrapped since 2020.

We are a team of around 20 people, working remotely with monthly meetups in London.

Why this role exists

China is becoming an increasingly important market for Gocertify. We are already seeing strong opportunities with over 50 Chinese consumer brands looking to grow in the UK and other international markets, and now want someone focused on developing that market full-time.

Some of our strongest progress has come through events, introductions and face-to-face relationships in China. We now want to turn that early traction into a more consistent commercial channel.

Role and scope

This is a hands-on commercial role focused on building Gocertify's presence with Chinese brands.

You'll own the China new-business pipeline from identifying the right brands and opening conversations through to demo, negotiation and close. A big part of the role is building relationships directly with Chinese businesses, both remotely and during regular time in China.

You'll stay close to new partners through launch where your Mandarin, market knowledge or existing relationship helps, before Client Success takes over the ongoing relationship.

This isn't a mature territory with a fixed playbook. You'll build your own pipeline, win Chinese brands and help us work out the most effective way to grow Gocertify in China.

As our first full-time commercial hire focused on China, you'll also help shape how we approach the market as we learn what works.

What you will focus on

1. Build a pipeline of Chinese brands

You will work on

  • Building and prioritising a target list of Chinese consumer brands with strong UK or international growth potential
  • Creating new opportunities through outbound, WeChat, LinkedIn, email, events, introductions and relevant partner networks
  • Finding and building relationships with the right contacts
  • Using time in China to meet priority brands in person, attend relevant industry events and develop relationships that are harder to build remotely
  • Testing which brands, messages and channels generate the strongest opportunities and adjusting your approach based on what works

2. Own and close new business

You will work on

  • Owning opportunities from first conversation through discovery, demo, negotiation and close
  • Understanding how prospective brands are approaching international growth, customer acquisition and promotions
  • Demoing Gocertify in Mandarin and English and tailoring the commercial case to what the brand is trying to achieve
  • Managing multiple stakeholders and keeping opportunities moving through clear next steps and consistent follow-up
  • Negotiating commercial terms and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast information

3. Help build a stronger China go-to-market

You will work on

  • Sharing what you are learning about Chinese brands, buying processes, objections and competitors
  • Improving how we position and sell Gocertify in the Chinese market
  • Building useful Mandarin-language sales materials, case studies and other assets where they will help opportunities progress
  • Identifying which events, networks, partners and routes into the market are producing the strongest results
  • Turning what works into a more repeatable approach as our China business grows

4. Support new partners through launch

You will work on

  • Coordinating a clear handover into Client Success once a new partnership is agreed
  • Staying involved through onboarding where your Mandarin, market knowledge or relationship with the partner helps move things forward
  • Supporting clear communication around onboarding and implementation requirements
  • Creating or adapting Mandarin-language onboarding materials where useful
  • Feeding recurring questions or onboarding friction back into the wider team so we can improve the experience for future Chinese partners

Requirements

  • Fluent Mandarin and professional-level English
  • Experience in B2B sales, business development or partnerships
  • Evidence of creating opportunities yourself through outbound, networking, introductions or account research
  • Experience progressing commercial opportunities through discovery, demo, negotiation and close
  • Confidence running product demonstrations and commercial conversations with prospective clients
  • Experience building relationships with Chinese businesses and a strong understanding of how commercial relationships are developed in China
  • Strong pipeline management, with clear follow-up, prioritisation and forecasting
  • Comfort managing your own territory or pipeline with a high level of independence
  • Experience using different routes to create opportunities, including digital outreach, networking and face-to-face relationship building

Experience in ecommerce, retail, affiliate/performance marketing, SaaS, loyalty or related technology would help you get up to speed more quickly, but we do not require it.

Who will thrive in this role

This role will suit someone who is comfortable operating between two markets and can combine strong relationship-building with commercial discipline.

  • You can bridge different ways of doing business. You'll often be the person closest to the Chinese market, so you'll need to understand what a prospect is really telling you and help the UK team understand the context behind it. Equally, you can explain Gocertify's approach in a way that makes sense to a Chinese partner, without simply translating a UK sales pitch word for word.
  • You balance adaptability with commercial discipline. You'll need to adjust how you communicate and build relationships depending on the brand and situation, while still qualifying opportunities properly, maintaining momentum and being clear about what it will take to get a deal done.
  • You're comfortable being the person closest to the market. There won't always be someone else internally who knows the answer about how a Chinese prospect, event or route to market works. You'll be expected to form a view, bring the right context back to the team and help us make sensible decisions from it.

How we work

  • Fully remote (UK-based) with monthly in-person meetings in London.
  • Core working hours: 10am-4pm UK time with flexible remote work.
    • When working from the UK, you'll work 6am-2pm up to three days a week to overlap with the Chinese working day.
  • Regular travel to China, typically in trips of up to 3 weeks and totalling around 3 months across the year.

Benefits

  • 25 days annual leave + UK bank holidays
  • Private health insurance with AVIVA, including optical and dental cashback and the option to self-fund partners/dependents
  • EMI share options
  • Work-from-home budget
  • Flexible remote work in many countries around our core hours, 10am-4pm UK
  • Unlimited access to coworking spaces in 48+ countries through Hubble
  • Access to incredible Gocertify offers

jobs.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies.
jobs.description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the role

As a Mid-level Software Engineer at Ledgy, you’ll build reliable, scalable product experiences that help companies manage their equity with confidence. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn complex equity workflows into clear, automated, user-friendly software.

This role is a strong fit if you’re ready to take ownership of well-scoped projects, grow your technical judgement, and contribute across the stack while learning from senior peers.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

Teams we are hiring for:

  • Core Equity — Owns the foundational logic that powers Ledgy’s equity engine. Every equity-related event — such as issuing shares, creating new pools, or adjusting ownership — generates transactions. This team defines and maintains the transaction logic, data model, and core domain behaviour that ensure Ledgy’s platform remains accurate, scalable, and compliant. They also enable employees to sell their shares seamlessly once vested.
  • Workflows & Automation — Focuses on automating complex equity workflows and integrating with third-party services, including the trading exchange. The team builds systems that help company admins efficiently onboard and offboard employees, automate equity grants and terminations.
  • Reporting — Transforms Ledgy’s core equity data into financial, operational, and compliance reports. The team manages large, complex datasets and ensures reporting is accurate, performant, and reliable across jurisdictions and company structures. Their work powers the insights companies and auditors rely on for decision-making and transparency.
  • Tax — Ensures taxes are correctly reflected throughout equity operations, especially moments such as exercising, selling, mobility, and other taxable events. As a future team, Tax will build end-to-end product capabilities across the stack, helping customers manage complex tax and compliance requirements accurately across jurisdictions.

You will thrive in the role if you

  • You have 3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer
  • You are comfortable building and shipping production-quality features across the stack
  • You enjoy learning complex domains and turning them into simple, maintainable product experiences
  • You care about clean, tested, readable code and thoughtful collaboration
  • You are curious about equity, financial workflows, and their real-world impact on companies and employees
  • You’re excited to grow your technical judgement through code reviews, pairing, and architecture discussions
  • You take ownership of your work while asking for input early when trade-offs are unclear

Our Tech Stack*:

We have a modern, cohesive stack that lets us move fast while maintaining quality:

  • Language: TypeScript
  • Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, tRPC
  • Backend: tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, Temporal
  • Infrastructure: GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions

*We don’t expect proficiency in this specific stack

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

  • Be paired with an onboarding buddy who will introduce you to the world of equity management
  • Get to know your engineering team, product managers, and designers
  • Learn how your team’s domain connects to the broader Ledgy platform
  • Set up your development environment and start contributing small, well-scoped changes
  • Build familiarity with our codebase, product workflows, and engineering practices

First 3 months:

  • Ship product features and improvements with increasing independence
  • Work with teammates to break down problems, understand trade-offs, and deliver reliable solutions
  • Participate actively in code reviews and team discussions
  • Develop a deeper understanding of how companies manage and automate equity
  • Contribute to improving quality, maintainability, and user experience in your team’s domain

First 6–12 months:

  • Own medium-sized features from implementation through release
  • Collaborate with Product and Design to shape pragmatic, user-centric solutions
  • Contribute to technical discussions around data models, workflows, and scalability
  • Continue growing toward senior-level ownership, judgement, and impact

The interview process:

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session focused on practical problem-solving, clear trade-offs, and how you structure technical thinking
  • Case Study (60 min): Collaborate with a product manager and engineer to explore a problem related to Ledgy’s domain. Focus is on understanding requirements, product thinking, and implementation trade-offs.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy’s mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means:

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.
  • For candidates based in London or Zurich we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.

As Marketing Data Analyst, you will own the analytical point of view on marketing performance across Coalition's insurance and security businesses. You will connect data from across the marketing and sales stack, explain what is driving results, and bring marketing leadership recommendations that change what we do next. This role is weighted toward insight over reporting. Dashboards matter and you will keep them healthy, but the true value you’re going to bring is analysis and the judgment behind it. You will partner closely with marketing operations, sales operations, data engineering, data science, and marketing leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Funnel & Campaign Analysis: Run end-to-end analysis across both the insurance and security businesses, from awareness and demand capture through intent, pipeline, and closed revenue. The two funnels behave differently and you will need to understand each, including the go to market motions that go into them so you can identify where the funnel is leaking, which channels are carrying weight, and what should change.
  • Insights & Recommendations: Get past simple metrics to the insight. Bring campaign managers, growth leads, and marketing leadership data-backed recommendations they can act on. That includes calls on what to repeat, what to cut, and where to move our collective marketing efforts.

Often, data arrives messy, from sources that don’t join cleanly. You should be able to reach an answer on your own, and to escalate upstream data issues to Data Engineering, Data Science, or Sales Operations when the fix belongs there.

jobs.description:
The Sales Development Representative, IBERIA is responsible for generating qualified pipeline for Omilia's IBERIA enterprise sales team through structured outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification. The role sits at the top of the sales funnel — identifying, engaging, and qualifying senior decision-makers at target enterprise accounts across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and converting interest into discovery meetings for Account Executives. Success is measured by qualified meetings booked, pipeline contribution, and outbound activity quality across assigned IBERIA territories.

Accountabilities

  • Own the top-of-funnel pipeline generation for assigned IBERIA territories — consistently delivering a volume of qualified meetings that meets or exceeds monthly and quarterly targets.
  • Maintain a structured, data-driven outbound prospecting motion — building and executing multi-touch, multi-channel sequences across phone, email, LinkedIn, and social that reach senior CX, IT, and operations decision-makers at target IBERIA enterprise accounts.
  • Qualify inbound leads from marketing campaigns, events, and website activity — rapidly assessing fit, intent, and timing, and advancing qualified prospects to the appropriate Account Executive.
  • Act as the first commercial representation of Omilia in IBERIA prospect interactions — communicating Omilia's value proposition clearly and compellingly across diverse European markets and cultural contexts.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of all prospecting activity in Salesforce — ensuring that the Sales Director has full visibility of pipeline generation activity, conversion rates, and outreach performance across the IBERIA region.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound Prospecting

  • Research, identify, and build targeted prospect lists for assigned IBERIA territories — drawing on Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and other intelligence tools to map target accounts, identify buying centres, and pinpoint senior decision-makers across CX, IT, contact centre operations, and digital transformation functions.
  • Execute structured multi-touch outbound sequences — combining personalised cold email, phone outreach, LinkedIn engagement, and social selling to engage senior prospects at target IBERIA enterprise accounts across priority verticals including financial services, insurance, telecommunications, utilities, healthcare, and public sector.
  • Craft compelling, personalised outreach in English and relevant IBERIA languages as applicable — connecting Omilia's conversational AI and contact centre capabilities to each prospect's known business challenges and demonstrating genuine understanding of each target account and market context.
  • Conduct high-quality discovery conversations with senior prospects — qualifying on budget authority, need, and timing, uncovering the prospect's contact centre environment and automation objectives, and building sufficient interest and context to secure a substantive first meeting for the Account Executive.
  • Adapt outreach approach and communication style to the distinct procurement cultures and business norms of assigned IBERIA markets — recognising that prospecting into UK and German enterprises, for example, requires meaningfully different tone, cadence, and messaging.

Inbound Lead Management

  • Respond to inbound leads from marketing campaigns, content downloads, event registrations, and website enquiries within agreed SLAs — assessing fit and intent rapidly and advancing qualified prospects through to AE handover.
  • Partner with the marketing team on IBERIA campaign follow-up — ensuring that leads generated from webinars, events, and digital campaigns are worked promptly and effectively, and providing feedback on lead quality and regional relevance to improve targeting.

Account Executive Collaboration

  • Work closely with assigned IBERIA Account Executives to align prospecting activity to territory priorities — understanding each AE's target account list, preferred verticals, and current pipeline gaps, and focusing outbound effort accordingly.
  • Prepare and deliver clear, structured meeting briefs for AEs prior to each booked discovery call — summarising the prospect's role, company context, key business challenges, and the conversation that led to the meeting.
  • Participate in joint account planning sessions with AEs — contributing outbound intelligence, contact mapping, and engagement history to inform IBERIA territory strategy.

Omilia Platform and Market Knowledge

  • Develop and maintain a working knowledge of Omilia's product portfolio — OCP, miniApps, Pathfinder, CoPilot, TalkGuard, and OptimizeIQ — sufficient to hold an intelligent first conversation with a senior prospect, articulate Omilia's key differentiators, and connect platform capabilities to common contact centre pain points across IBERIA verticals.
  • Maintain awareness of GDPR and the EU AI Act as they relate to enterprise AI and contact centre deployments — sufficient to address basic compliance questions in initial prospect conversations and position Omilia credibly in the European regulatory context.
  • Stay current with Omilia's IBERIA target verticals, competitive landscape, and key industry trends — ensuring that outreach messaging reflects current market context and positions Omilia credibly against incumbent CCaaS and IVR vendors active in European markets.

Reporting and Process

  • Maintain Salesforce as the system of record for all prospecting activity — logging calls, emails, LinkedIn touches, meetings booked, and pipeline progression accurately and consistently.
  • Track and report on personal KPIs — including outreach volume, connection rates, meeting booking rates, and pipeline contribution — and use this data to continuously refine messaging, sequencing, and targeting across IBERIA markets.
  • Participate in regular pipeline reviews and coaching sessions with the Sales Director — sharing what is working, identifying regional blockers, and incorporating feedback to improve performance.
  • Occasionally travel within IBERIA to support trade shows, industry events, and internal sales team meetings — up to 10% of the time.

Requirements

Required:

  • 1–3 years of experience in a sales development, business development, or outbound prospecting role — preferably within enterprise SaaS, CCaaS, conversational AI, or B2B technology.
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding outbound prospecting and meeting-booking targets in a structured SDR or BDR environment.
  • Proficiency with outbound sales tools — including Salesforce CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, Spanish and Portuguese — able to craft personalised, compelling cold outreach and hold confident discovery conversations with senior CX, IT, and operations decision-makers across IBERIA markets.
  • Awareness of and sensitivity to the distinct business cultures, procurement norms, and communication styles across key IBERIA markets — and the ability to adapt outreach tone and approach accordingly.
  • Organised and self-directed work style — able to manage a high volume of outbound activity across multiple accounts and geographies without losing attention to quality or personalisation.
  • Genuine curiosity about enterprise technology, contact centre automation, and conversational AI — and the motivation to develop deep product and market knowledge over time.
  • Coachable and growth-oriented — open to feedback, willing to iterate on messaging and approach, and committed to continuous improvement.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, or a related discipline.

Nice to have:

  • Fluency in one or more European languages (German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch) — directly relevant for outreach into non-English-speaking IBERIA markets.
  • Prior exposure to contact centre technology, CCaaS, IVR, or conversational AI — either through sales experience or personal interest.
  • Familiarity with Omilia's platform or competing platforms (Genesys, Avaya, Nuance/Microsoft, Google CCAI, Amazon Connect).
  • Experience prospecting into large enterprise accounts across IBERIA financial services, insurance, telecommunications, or utilities verticals.

Omilia Note

  • Contribute actively and effectively as an integrated team member.
  • Act as an Omilia ambassador in all interactions.

Benefits

  • Fixed compensation;
  • Long-term employment with the working days vacation;
  • Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);
  • Being part of successful cutting-edge technology products that are making a global impact in the service industry;
  • Proficient and fun-to-work-with colleagues;
  • Apple gear

Local Progress is seeking a Senior Staff Attorney

Position Location: Remote, U.S.

About Local Progress and Local Progress Impact Lab

Local Progress and the Local Progress Impact Lab work collectively to advance a racial and economic justice agenda through all levels of government. Local Progress (LP) is a movement of more than 1,800 local elected officials advancing a racial and economic justice agenda through all levels of local government. The Local Progress Impact Lab (the Impact Lab) brings together local leaders, partners, and experts to build the knowledge, skills, and leadership needed to advance racial and economic justice at the local level.

About the Position:

Working as part of a national legal and policy team, the Senior Staff Attorney will provide legal, policy, and research support to local elected officials in a variety of geographies, with particular emphasis on the organization’s priority issue areas, which include immigrant justice, economic justice and worker power, reimagining public safety, home rule and local democracy, and advancing housing justice for all. In light of growing attacks on democracy and marginalized communities, the Senior Staff Attorney will be tasked with leading and supporting a number of strategies and tactics which include, for example, providing legal analysis on specific local policies, drafting amicus briefs and other litigation tactics, and coming up with creative policy solutions for local leaders to govern despite state and federal preemption.

The Senior Staff Attorney will play a leading role in driving the organization’s work on advancing immigrant justice. This role will collaborate with national, state, and local partners to advance shared goals of protecting immigrant communities from federal attacks and advancing a proactive vision of full immigrant inclusion.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is eager to build the policy and legal capacity of the Local Progress network, which is comprised of elected officials serving in cities, counties, and school boards, as well as closely collaborate with these members in working hand-in-hand with impacted communities to win transformational local policy on some of the most pressing issues facing communities today. This role will provide timely resources, strategy, and collaboration to Local Progress members on the forefront of these efforts, and lead the organization’s Immigrant Justice Steering Committee to set and implement network-wide goals and programming..

The Senior Staff Attorney will report to the Managing Director, Legal and Policy.

Location: This is a remote position based in the U.S. with no in-office requirement.

Travel Requirement: This position is required to travel to in-person events up to six days a month.

Primary Responsibilities.

  • Legal and Policy
    • Produce, edit, and review legal memos, amicus briefs, and other legal documents; manage and oversee the production of such documents by partners.
    • Lead development of resources that enable us to move members into action across the full diversity of our network, test and popularize bold policy ideas, and model collaborative governance in our work, including policy briefs, campaign toolkits, template resolutions, and training curricula.
    • Engage with LP staff, members and partners to assess and advise on policy and legal questions, and perform research and policy analysis to respond to those questions, sometimes in rapid response situations.
  • Issue Area Programming
    • Serve as the expert and lead strategist for the organization’s work on immigrant justice.
    • Envision, plan, and implement program offerings to advance immigrant justice, both in-person and virtual.
      • LP and the Impact Lab’s programs include webinars, interactive meetings, virtual working groups, in-person gatherings, site visits, and large-scale conferences involving anywhere from a few to several hundred elected officials, government staffers, and allies. Find examples here, here, and here.
    • Staff the Immigrant Justice Steering Committee comprised of Local Progress members and develop the leadership of the Steering Committee’s members
    • Build and maintain strong working relationships with external partners on immigrant justice.
    • Additional issue area policy leadership as needed, including potentially land use, procurement, legal authority of counties, and first amendment / democracy protections.
  • Support Local Progress and the Impact Lab's work
    • Collaborate across Local Progress teams to support organizational activities and infrastructure including caucus work, state chapter activities, Collaborative Governance Academy trainings, reports, convenings, web products, etc.
    • Play a supporting role in maintaining funder relationships and identifying new opportunities for expanding support.

Required Qualifications:

  • A juris doctor degree and admission to a state bar.
  • At least 9 years of relevant policy or legal experience and at least 4 years working on immigrant justice issues via policy, organizing, direct legal representation, impact litigation, etc..
  • Experience with organizing and campaigns, including working with organizers or movement lawyering.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, create and execute work plans, anticipate obstacles and identify ways to navigate challenges, and identify and involve stakeholders appropriately.
  • Awareness of and ability to address issues of power, race, class, gender, and other forms of privilege within the internal dynamics and culture of a workplace.
  • A demonstrated commitment to social, racial, and economic justice and interest in local policy, politics, and government.
  • Experience in relational organizing and an ability to relate to and move to action a diverse group of people from a variety of local contexts and backgrounds, including in a virtual setting.
  • Ability to take initiative and exercise strategic judgment.
  • Ability to travel monthly.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • Experience with “inside/outside” strategies and movement governance that features deep partnership between “outside” organizing and “inside” elected officials.
  • Litigation experience.

Salary will be determined according to a salary scale which takes into account years of experience and advanced degrees, and will be between $108,600 and $111,000.

Developer Relations Engineer

🌎 Remote (U.S. or Canada) | 💼 Full-Time | ✈️ Quarterly Travel

About Akuity

With the move to the cloud Kubernetes has become widely adopted by DevOps and Platform Engineering teams, but it has also added complexity. While scaling Kubernetes at Intuit, the Akuity founders started building Argo CD in order to streamline the adoption of Kubernetes. Argo CD helps developers own, understand and deploy their K8s deployments via GitOps.

Today, Argo CD is the third most popular project in the CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) and is used by 70% of companies who are using Kubernetes in production. The list of Argo CD users includes companies like Intuit, BlackRock, Tesla, Major League Baseball, Peloton, and many more.

The team founded Akuity in 2021 to enable enterprises to ship software faster and more reliably with modern GitOps best practices. The Akuity Platform enables teams to manage the development and deployment across hundreds – if not thousands – of Kubernetes clusters from a single control plane. Trusted by top companies around the globe, the Akuity Platform provides the only end-to-end GitOps platform for the enterprises.

Our mission is to simplify the software delivery process so that DevOps and Platform Engineering teams can move fast, and deploy code effortlessly without the fear of breaking things.

The Opportunity

This is a hybrid technical role focused on bridging the gap between Akuity and its developer community by combining software engineering with developer relations. Responsibilities include creating technical content like tutorials and demos, providing developer support, gathering feedback for product teams, and engaging with the community at events and online. This role helps drive product adoption by ensuring the developer experience is positive and effective.

What You’ll Do

  • Content Creation: Develop technical assets such as code samples, SDKs, demos, tutorials, documentation, and blog posts to help developers use a company's product.
  • Community Engagement: Actively participate in online forums, social media, and other community channels to answer questions, provide support, and gather feedback.
  • Technical Support: Serve as a point of contact for external developers, helping them resolve technical issues and offering guidance.
  • Event Participation: Represent the company at developer conferences, meetups, and workshops, and potentially help organize these events.
  • Collaboration: Work with internal product and engineering teams to relay developer feedback and contribute to improving the overall developer experience and tools.
  • Evangelism: Advocate for the company's technology by presenting its value and capabilities to the broader developer community.

What We Look For

Must Have

  • Technical Expertise: A strong background in software development to build credible demos and understand developer workflows.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for creating content, giving presentations, and interacting with the community.
  • Empathy: The ability to understand and relate to the challenges and needs of other developers.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving abilities to help developers overcome technical hurdles.
  • Community Focus: A passion for building and nurturing relationships with developers and contributing to open-source communities.

Why Akuity?

At Akuity, we believe open-source software is the most impactful way to build lasting technology. We founded this company to advocate for Argo, share our expertise, and be a trusted partner to its users.

Our culture is grounded in humility, authenticity, and diversity. We value people from different backgrounds and paths in life. We trust our team members to take ownership, act responsibly, and support one another. If you are collaborative, curious, and dedicated to helping customers succeed, we’d love to meet you.

Akuity is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. jobs.description:
Szukamy Junior Developerów do zespołu IT w związku z intensywnym rozwojem organizacji, mających już solidne podstawy i chcących programować z AI. Jeśli nie pracowałeś jeszcze z AI - najlepiej zacznij :) (będzie to potrzebne w rekrutacji i w pracy). Po nawiązaniu współpracy możemy Ci pokazać to i owo, jak można mądrze wykorzystywać AI w developmencie.

Stare czasy w IT minęły, nowa era rozwoju oprogramowania już tu jest - w Telemedi dołączamy do prekursorów zmian w procesie developmentu. Wierzymy, że łącząc użycie najnowszych technologii z biegłością techniczną i ponadprzeciętnym zaangażowaniem możemy budować więcej, szybciej, i lepiej, niż to było kiedykolwiek możliwe.

Developerzy w naszym IT pracują z Cursor AI (cursor.com) - to IDE zmienia kompletnie paradygmat programowania. My potrafimy w kilka godzin zrobić to, co innym deweloperom zajmuje kilka dni. I tego też będziemy oczekiwać od Ciebie.

Aplikuj do nas, jeśli:

  • chcesz pracować w firmie produktowej, w której domena biznesowa jest bardzo ciekawa, rozległa i złożona, a Twoja praca dziś przekłada się na wymierny efekt jutro
  • jesteś ambitny i chcesz się rozwijać nie przez kursy, tylko w boju
  • masz solidne podstawy teoretyczne i/lub praktyczne do nowoczesnego programowania
  • lubisz dynamiczne środowisko, w którym dużo się dzieje
  • czujesz i bierzesz odpowiedzialność za to, co robisz Ty i cały zespół
  • chętnie i otwarcie przyjmujesz konstruktywny feedback do wykonywanej pracy
  • nie boisz się wyzwań, i odnajdziesz się w skomplikowanej aplikacji
  • lubisz poznawać biznes i dobrze się komunikujesz z innymi (nie tylko w IT)
  • potrafisz szybko i sprawnie tworzyć jakościowe aplikacje / feature’y
  • chętnie poprawiasz procesy wokół siebie

Twoje zadania:

  • udział w tworzeniu rozwiązań IT od początku do końca (u nas IT nie jest “silosem”)
  • rozwój aplikacji webowych (nowe funkcje, bugfixing, refactors)
  • udział w projektowaniu architektury nowych rozwiązań i infrastruktury deweloperskiej
  • udział w code review i dbałość o jakość tworzonych rozwiązań
  • stałe podnoszenie standardów procesów developmentu
  • ścisła współpraca z zespołem (Devs, PMs/POs, QAs)
  • dbanie o wysoką jakość programistyczną i wysokie tempo dostarczanych zadań (indywidualnie i jako team)

Requirements

  • Solidnych podstaw z wiedzy dot. programowania - dla Juniorów: min. ukończone studia (licencjat/inżynier) z kierunków informatycznych lub pokrewnych, LUB min. 2 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia w pracy z PHP +
  • Chęci i umiejętności bardzo szybkiego uczenia się i poznawania skomplikowanych aspektów rozwiązań technicznych
  • Umiejętności korzystania z nowoczesnych narzędzi AI w programowaniu (jak Cursor / Windsurf - Github Copilot nie jest “good enough”). Nie musisz mieć w tym doświadczenia - ale musisz rozumieć paradygmat i mieć to "przećwiczone".
  • Praktycznej znajomości wzorców projektowych i dobrych praktyk programowania (SOLID, KISS, DRY itd)
  • Sprawności w pracy z systemami kontroli wersji, np. Git.
  • Ownershipu - samodzielności i odpowiedzialności za powierzone zadania
  • Dokładności i sumienności w pracy (indywidualnie i w zespole)
  • Płynnej znajomości języka polskiego.

Mile widziane:

  • Znajomość zagadnień zw. z wydajnością i optymalizacją aplikacji web.
  • Znajomość zagadnień zw. z infrastrukturą aplikacji w chmurze (np. GCP)
  • Doświadczenie w rozwoju architektury mikroserwisowej.
  • Praktyczna znajomość obszaru środowisk skonteneryzowanych (Docker)
  • Doświadczenia w pisaniu testów jednostkowych i integracyjnych.
  • Doświadczenie komercyjne z Node.js / Nest.js

Pracujemy z:

  • Backend: Symfony, PHP + MySQL/PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, GraphQL, Hasura
    • architektura: mikroserwisy + duży monolit
  • Frontend: React.js + Typescript + Twig w panelach admina
  • Infrastruktura: Google Cloud Platform + Kubernetes, Datadog
  • Build (CI): Docker, Github Actions
  • Kontrola wersji: Github
  • Issue Tracker: JIRA, Confluence
  • Testy: PHPUnit + Playwright + QA manualne

Benefits

  • Wynagrodzenie: 8 000 - 13 000 PLN netto (B2B)
  • Elastyczny model pracy (hybrid/remote)
  • Opieka medyczna
  • Karta Multisport
  • Współpraca w oparciu o B2B lub umowę zlecenie

Co wyróżni Cię spośród innych kandydatów:

  • Twoja zdolność do myślenia poza schematami
  • Komunikatywność - jasna, klarowna i rzeczowa
  • Umiejętność rozwiązywania problemów "end to end".

Nasze wartości

  • Organizational "YES": Witamy osoby, które z entuzjazmem podchodzą do zmian i nowych możliwości.
  • 5x why, first principles: Zachęcamy do zadawania pytań "dlaczego?" i szukania lepszych rozwiązań.
  • Data-driven: Wspieramy decyzje rzetelnymi danymi i analizami. Zawsze weryfikujemy informacje u źródła - nie przyjmujemy założeń bez sprawdzenia faktów i danych.
  • Startup mindset: Cenimy szybkie działanie i eksperymentowanie poprzez prototypy.
  • Getting things done as an A-player: Koncentrujemy się na realnych efektach i wspólnie świętujemy sukcesy. Nie tolerujemy zaniedbań i nie popełniamy błędów wynikających z niedbalstwa.
  • Transparency: Stawiamy na radykalnie szczerą komunikację w duchu "radical candor" - feedback jest bezpośredni, konstruktywny i natychmiastowy. Mówimy otwarcie co działa, a co wymaga poprawy.
  • Sense of urgency: Działamy sprawnie i efektywnie, dążąc do szybkiej realizacji celów.
  • Accountability: Nie chowamy głowy w piasek - otwarcie przyznajemy gdy coś nie działa i bierzemy odpowiedzialność za wprowadzanie niezbędnych zmian.

Co nie wpisuje się w naszą kulturę pracy

  • Ignorowanie problemów.
  • Brak zaangażowania w testowanie nowych inicjatyw.
  • Opieranie działań na nieaktualnych danych i brak elastyczności w działaniu.
  • Unikanie odpowiedzialności
  • Stagnacja: Oczekiwanie, że metody, które były efektywne w przeszłości, będą działać na zawsze.
  • Przeciwstawianie się zmianie
  • Brak transparentności
  • Niewłaściwe zarządzanie czasem. Brak pilności w działaniu.
  • Odkładanie zadań na później
  • Ignorowanie problemów
  • Popełnianie błędów wynikających z zaniedbania

Etapy procesu rekrutacyjnego:

  1. krótki quiz online (5-10 min)
  2. zadanie techniczne
  3. rozmowa z Hiring Managerem
  4. (opcjonalnie) Assessment Day dla wybranych kandydatów

Dzięki takim etapom rekrutacji nie wymagamy dużego zaangażowania czasowego na początku, proces rekrutacyjny idzie sprawnie (feedback dostajesz szybko!) oraz możemy dać szansę szerszemu gronu kandydatów.

Jeżeli uważasz, że jesteś właściwą osobą do tego stanowiska, skontaktuj się z nami i dołącz do zespołu, który naprawdę robi różnicę! W swoim CV pokaż nam, że jesteś komandosem, którego szukamy.

Nie zwlekaj, dołącz do nas już dziś!

jobs.title: Managing Director, Services
jobs.excerpt: Type: Full-time contractor (hours negotiable) Location: Remote - Africa/Europe time zones (strong preference for candidates based in Africa) Reports to: CEO Direct reports: Head of Implementation, Implementation Engineering Director, and Senior Advisors on the Services Team OpenFn is the digital public good for public service automation & AI orchestration.
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time contractor (hours negotiable)
Location: Remote - Africa/Europe time zones (strong preference for candidates based in Africa)
Reports to: CEO
Direct reports: Head of Implementation, Implementation Engineering Director, and Senior Advisors on the Services Team

OpenFn is the digital public good for public service automation & AI orchestration. Our platform automates data exchange and digital workflows so that governments and NGOs can deliver public services more efficiently, achieve interoperability across fragmented systems, and scale critical public services across health, humanitarian, and government programs.

Our team, Open Function Group, the primary steward of this open-source platform, is a lean, fully-remote team of integration specialists, solution architects, and implementation consultants working across 40+ countries.

We are not making marginal improvements to already comfortable lives. We are building the infrastructure that allows governments to function, clinics to operate, and vulnerable populations to access services they depend on. The solutions you design will shape whether a ministry can reach its citizens, whether a health system can act on its own data, and whether a government can adopt AI on its own terms rather than someone else's.

The role

This is a chance to influence how governments approach AI adoption, public service automation, and digital transformation, not from the outside, but embedded in the delivery of real programs. This year we have 8 government implementations across Africa and Latin America, with global adoption accelerating, and we're at an inflection point in scaling that critical work. At the same time, we're trying to solve something few digital public goods have solved: how to be both deeply impactful and financially sustainable, borrowing hard-won lessons from enterprise software and open source companies and adapting them to markets those playbooks weren't built for. This role sits squarely at that intersection, owning both the impact and financial sustainability of what we deliver, because we believe the two are meant to reinforce each other, not compete.

We are hiring a Managing Director, Services to own the full portfolio of delivery work at OpenFn, from project-based implementations to the management and delivery of capacity building “expert days” on retainer for subscribing governments and iNGOs. This role is primarily about team leadership and enablement, business strategy, sales support and scoping, and technical/implementation strategy consulting for government clients and external partners, including both large consulting firms and small local implementers.

OpenFn's Services organization has historically operated like a traditional IT consulting practice: the same people won new business, scoped it, and delivered it. As we sell more subscription bundles and shift toward recurring, subscription-shaped revenue for our consulting, support, and expert-days work, that model is changing. Sales and account management responsibilities are moving into our Growth organization, and Services is becoming a focused delivery and technical authority function: accountable for scoping accuracy, delivery quality, and SLA performance, not for owning the entire end-to-end sales relationship.

You will be a central architect of that transition: helping design, validate, and then operationalize OpenFn's new subscription-centered delivery model. You’ll be part of the core strategy team, interfacing regularly with the Head of Product, Head of Growth, CEO and COO, while working closely with our Head of Implementation (who owns day-to-day portfolio execution and financial governance), our Growth organization's BD Leads and Partner Managers (who own new pipeline and deal-closing), and our Implementation Engineering Director (who owns technical architecture and quality across the delivery portfolio).

Think of this as the role that holds Services accountable for what it delivers, while giving the team the leadership, scoping discipline, and strategic clarity to thrive as the business model shifts underneath it.

What you’ll be doing

Team Leadership & Enablement

  • Lead and develop the Services leadership team, including the Head of Implementation, Director of Engineering, and senior engagement/consulting leads, ensuring they have the strategy, tools, and support to deliver high-quality, profitable work
  • Own hiring, performance management, and career development for the Services leadership bench
  • Maintain the operating rhythm (OKRs, review cadences, portfolio check-ins) that keeps Services focused on financial sustainability and delivery quality
  • Champion adoption of the Implementation Playbook, productization efforts, and AI tooling across the wider team, so delivery knowledge stops living in individual people's heads
  • Partner closely with the Head of Product to support strategic alignment and a continuous feedback loop between service delivery and the OpenFn platform

Sales Support, Scoping & Deal Negotiation

  • Partner closely with the Growth team during pre-sale to scope engagements accurately, size Expert Days allocations within subscription bundles, and structure pricing that protects target margins
  • Serve as the senior technical and delivery voice in deal negotiations, providing the delivery sign-off on scope, timeline, and resourcing that's required before any contract is signed
  • Advise Growth on what is realistically deliverable, flagging over-commitment risk before it reaches a client
  • Support RFP responses and proposal development for complex government and NGO engagements

Technical & Implementation Strategy Consulting

  • Serve as a trusted technical and strategic advisor to government ministries, NGOs, and implementation partners, including both large consulting firms and small local providers, on how to structure successful OpenFn-based programs
  • Advise ministry and NGO leadership on broader digital transformation and AI adoption strategy, not just OpenFn-specific implementation choices
  • Represent OpenFn in high-stakes client conversations, escalations, and strategic account relationships
  • Travel to conferences and partner workshops to represent OpenFn and provide expert strategic and technical advisory
  • Provide implementation strategy guidance that balances client needs, platform capabilities, and OpenFn's delivery capacity

Delivery Portfolio Oversight

  • Own the delivery-side financial accountability for the Services portfolio, translating booked revenue into profitable, efficient execution: gross margin, operating costs, and delivery efficiency against target
  • Oversee delivery of both traditional implementation projects and the expert-days component of subscription bundles, ensuring consistent quality and SLA adherence across both
  • Partner with the Head of Implementation on portfolio-level financial governance (dashboards, margin monitoring, invoicing discipline), while she owns day-to-day operational execution of these systems

Subscription Operating Model Design & Transition

  • Play a leading role in designing, validating, and operationalizing OpenFn's shift from a traditional IT-consulting delivery model to a subscription-shaped delivery and revenue model
  • Participate in OpenFn’s Global Strategy Team to design, validate, and iterate on our business model, including drawing on how established enterprise software and open source companies structure recurring-revenue delivery, and adapt those lessons to the realities of LMIC government and NGO markets
  • Help define how Services engages with the emerging “front door” structure: the division of labor between Growth (lead generation, pre-sale, partnerships) and Services (scoping input, SLA delivery, Expert Days, training, and implementation-partner enablement)
  • Provide input into pricing, scoping frameworks, and delivery playbooks specific to bundled subscriptions as they're piloted and rolled out
  • Identify and flag structural or operational gaps as the model evolves, and adapt team processes accordingly

Requirements

To successfully ensure the technical quality of solutions implemented by the OpenFn services team, you should have the following qualifications and be comfortable consulting with a diverse range of technical stakeholders.

  • 12+ years experience in technical or professional services delivery in B2B/B2G
  • 5+ years at a public-sector-facing technology organization
  • 3+ years leading a technical or professional services delivery team at a B2B or public-sector-facing technology organization
  • Demonstrated experience delivering large, national-scale technology implementations for government partners (e.g., national registries, health information systems, social protection platforms) is a strong advantage
  • Demonstrated experience owning portfolio-level financial accountability (gross margin, operating costs, and delivery efficiency against target); this role is accountable for efficient, profitable delivery of booked revenue, not a new-business sales target
  • Strong financial fluency: comfortable owning financial targets, and translating them into team-level operating discipline
  • Proven experience managing and developing a team of managers or technical delivery leads, not just individual contributors
  • Experience scoping and negotiating complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally with government, NGO, or large enterprise clients
  • Willingness to travel internationally (at least once per quarter) for conferences, partner meetings, and government workshops
  • Working knowledge of the operational differences between project-based (services) and subscription-based (recurring) revenue models, and how delivery needs to adapt between them
  • Demonstrated experience being the senior technical/delivery voice in commercial negotiations and public sector contracts
  • Experience working with or managing external implementation partners (systems integrators, consulting firms, or similar)
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication, including facilitating strategic conversations with government and NGO stakeholders
  • Working proficiency in French or Spanish is a strong advantage
  • Background in international development, digital public goods, govtech, or global health is a strong advantage
  • Proven ability to operate effectively in a lean, fully-remote, distributed organization
  • Ability to work from home or a shared office space with fast, stable internet, preferably in a country that is located in Africa/Europe time zones

Benefits

Financial compensation is commensurate with experience.

N.B.: Selling to NGO & government customers, we don’t offer Silicon Valley pay, but high quality of life and fair, transparent, and competitive compensation is important to us.

Flexible working schedule.

We’re fully remote, with team meetups across Europe and Africa (our last three were in Kigali, Cape Town, and Dakar).

Exposure to hottest industry and technology trends and leading health and humanitarian interventions in the sector.

Opportunity for leadership and advancement. You will be a key contributor to our company’s strategy and direction.

The opportunity to shape our strategy and impact millions of lives through our open source software in a small, mission-driven organization.

Porch Light Health is a local leader in outpatient treatment of Opioid Use Disorders and other addictive disorders. Our staff is passionate about helping other people. We offer Medication Assisted Treatment and behavioral health services. We believe there is life beyond addiction and strive to help our patients discover their purpose and community in a healthy environment.

Who are you:

Porch Light Health is looking for a licensed Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant with certification in Psychiatry to work virtually and/or in-clinic to support our patients via telehealth to our clinics across Colorado and New Mexico.

Looking for a Medical Provider that is empathetic, non-judgmental, works well on teams, understands the “harm reduction” approach when it comes to treating substance use disorders and psychiatric illness, and can work within certain prescribing parameters. We are professional, agile and collaborative team. The right candidate will be willing to be cross trained in delivering Medication for Addiction Treatment (MAT).

Clinical Setting:

  • Virtual/telehealth to support our patients for our clinics across Colorado and New Mexico
  • Must currently reside in Colorado or New Mexico and be licensed
  • Mental health providers do not prescribe controlled substances.

Qualifications:

  • Completes medication and health education to include but not limited to informed consent, benefits, risks, side effects, and alternative treatments for medications ordered, health/wellness management, metabolic risk reduction strategies
  • Competent and comfortable with conducting Telemedicine technology appointments- both for intake and follow up encounters
  • Completion of an accredited Psychiatric Mental Practitioner program, required
  • Current Licensed Practitioner with full active and unrestricted licensure in the state of practice (CO and NM) and active state DEA License required
  • At least 1 Year of Psych providing and working in EMR systems
  • Skills:

    • Strong clinical assessment and diagnostic skills.
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
    • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with patients and collaborate effectively with healthcare teams.
    • Understanding of regulatory compliance and documentation requirements in MAT settings.

Job Duties:

  • The Psychiatric Practitioner provides direct client care, including assessing, diagnosing, planning, and prescribing pharmacologic and non-pharmacologic treatment of health problems, health promotion and preventive care within this specialized area of practice
  • Performs psychiatric diagnostic evaluations to determine diagnoses, treatment strategies, and care coordination needs for clients with mental health, substance use, or other psychiatric and medical needs
  • Provide all psychiatric and/or medical services within reasonable and expected medical standards, timelines, and in conformance with all requirements imposed by the applicable health licensing boards
  • Applies medical knowledge and skills to the process of diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of illnesses
  • Maintain timely, complete, accurate and legible medical records for all patients evaluated and treated by the Practitioner in organization medical record system
  • Performs timely, concurrent, accurate clinical/billing documentation meeting professional standards in compliance with State and Federal regulations, clinical necessity, and appropriate coding standards

Most importantly, you’re someone who shares in our passion for improving the lives of students through communication.

This role will include:

  • Align with Sales, Marketing, and Product on identifying expansion signals across the segment and acting on them
  • Measure the effectiveness of our SMB programs, and move your team’s effort toward what the data shows is working

Our ideal candidate will have the following:

  • 4+ years of people leadership, including developing managers or leading a multi-layer team

Role Summary

The Senior Director, MSP Channel Sales leads the strategy, growth, and operating performance of the Sophos Managed Service Provider (MSP) channel program across the Americas. This role influences future channel strategy and business results by translating market, partner, and customer insights into scalable go-to-market models that expand recurring revenue, increase active MSP productivity, and strengthen Sophos’ position in the managed security services market.

Reporting to senior channel leadership, this role leads key business operations through direct and matrixed teams and serves as the executive voice of the MSP business. The Senior Director sets the Americas MSP channel vision, aligns regional execution with global priorities, manages strategic partner and distributor relationships, and influences program design, pricing, product readiness, enablement, and investment decisions. Success requires a strategic, hands-on leader who can build market opportunities, negotiate complex decisions, and deliver consistent end-to-end execution.

  • Set MSP strategy and direction: Define the multi-year Americas MSP channel strategy and operating plan, aligned with Sophos business priorities, global partner strategy, product direction, and market trends.
