  • Create scalable distribution-led motions that improve MSP recruitment, time to first revenue, activation, product deployment, and long-term partner value.
  • Shape the program and portfolio: Represent the voice of MSP partners to Global Partner Programs, Product, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Sales Operations, and Enablement; influence program design, consumption-based licensing, incentives, partner experience, and product readiness.
  • Identify new market opportunities and innovative MSP business models that differentiate Sophos and accelerate adoption of managed security offerings, including MDR, endpoint, firewall, XDR/EDR, cloud, and related services. Align MSP strategy with regional sales and channel leadership, and establish clear rules of engagement across MSP and term business.
  • Lead through others: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing MSP sales organization with clear expectations, career development, accountability, and a strong team culture. Set objectives, resource plans, and operating rhythms across direct reports and matrixed teams, and build the capabilities required to scale the MSP business.
  • Ensure end-to-end execution across partner recruitment, enablement, demand generation, co-selling, technical support, and partner lifecycle management while managing the budget and investments for the area.
  • Use data to improve outcomes: Establish KPIs and executive reporting for partner health, onboarding, activation, tier progression, time to first revenue, recurring revenue growth, attach, retention, product adoption, and program return on investment.
  • Use insights from performance data, market intelligence, and competitive programs to resolve systemic barriers, adjust investments, and improve program effectiveness.

What You Will Bring

  • 15+ years of progressive channel sales, partner management, or business development experience in cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, or enterprise technology, including significant leadership of MSP programs or recurring-revenue channel businesses.
  • Proven success setting strategy and scaling a complex MSP business through direct, distribution, marketplace, and alliance channels.
  • Deep understanding of MSP operating models, partner economics, consumption-based billing, service lifecycle, partner portals, program tiers, onboarding, and recurring-revenue forecasting.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership, shape policy and investment decisions, and negotiate complex agreements with partners, distributors, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience leading high-performing sales teams and matrixed organizations, allocating resources, managing budgets, and driving consistent execution across regions and functions.
  • Strong knowledge of the Americas cybersecurity market and managed security portfolio, including MDR, endpoint, firewall, XDR/EDR, cloud, and security services.
  • Executive-level communication, business planning, financial acumen, negotiation, and analytical skills, with the ability to convert data and market insights into clear decisions.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to travel within the Americas for partner meetings, business reviews, and industry events.

jobs.excerpt: This role is a remote role to be based in Thailand.
jobs.description:
This role is a remote role to be based in Thailand.

About our company
Join Triptease — a high-growth SaaS company reshaping the future of hotel distribution. We help hoteliers take back control from OTAs by equipping them with the tools to grow direct bookings, protect margins, and strengthen guest loyalty.

Our platform combines proprietary hotel data, AI-driven marketing tools, and advanced pricing intelligence to give hoteliers an edge. With over £1 billion in direct revenue driven for clients annually and a global presence, this is your chance to be part of something big.

About our role

Ready to accelerate your career in Customer Success while making a real difference in the travel industry?

We're looking for a smart, driven and customer-obsessed individual to join our global CS team as a Customer Success Manager overseeing a group of our Mid Market accounts. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with 2–3 years of experience who's ready to take the next step, own relationships, and grow fast with a supportive team around them.

What you'll do

  • Own Your Portfolio — Manage ~25–35 hotel accounts. You'll be their go-to advisor, ensuring they're successful on the platform, achieving their goals, and sticking around long term.
  • Be Their Strategic Partner — Go beyond support. You'll help hoteliers improve their digital guest experience, boost direct bookings, and maximize revenue. Think of yourself as a consultant, not just a CSM.
  • Drive Impact with Data — Turn insights into action. Use our platform data to show the value your hotels are getting, and help them do more with it.
  • Grow and Renew Your Accounts — Own the commercial arc of every relationship. You'll convert trials into long-term contracts by making sure clients actually hit the expectations set at kick-off, uncover expansion opportunities as their needs grow (additional products, new properties, etc.), and lead renewal conversations and negotiations when the time comes. Retention and growth in your portfolio are yours to drive.
  • Build Real Relationships — You'll work with everyone from hotel marketing managers to GMs, and with our internal teams (Product, Sales, Engineering) to make sure your clients get what they need.
  • Level Up Their Success (and Yours) — Share best practices, lead training, gather feedback, and advocate for your hotels internally. We're big believers in customer-led growth.
  • Represent & Inspire — Encourage happy clients to become advocates at events, webinars, and in our hotelier community. Represent Triptease and your clients proudly.

Requirements

  • Experience: 2–3 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role, ideally within B2B SaaS. You've owned a portfolio, grown that book of business and been accountable for whether those customers renewed.
  • Language: Native-level proficiency in English and Thai (written and spoken) is essential. You must be able to communicate commercial and technical nuance clearly, and hold a confident conversation with a hotel's commercial leadership.
  • The "Automate Everything" Mindset: You are obsessed with efficiency and hate doing the same manual task twice. You approach work with this logic:
    • First time: You solve it and wonder if it will happen again.
    • Second time: You build a template or tool to automate the majority of the task.
    • Third time: You actively work to automate the process from start to finish so you never have to do it manually again.
  • In practice, this means the CSM who builds a reusable reporting template will always beat the one who rebuilds the same deck 30 times a quarter. We give you AI tools and the freedom to use them — we expect you to.
  • Commercial Ownership: You're comfortable owning renewal conversations, spotting risk early, and identifying growth opportunities in your accounts. You can talk about numbers — retention, revenue impact, ROI — without flinching.
  • Data Fluency: You can get into a spreadsheet or dashboard, find the story in the numbers, and build a recommendation from it. You don't just forward a report to a client; you tell them what it means and what to do next.
  • Technical Curiosity: You don't need to code, but you should be comfortable enough with web technologies to understand how our product sits on a hotel's website, what a tag manager does, and when an issue needs Support or Engineering. You're able to hold a credible conversation with a client's web agency rather than deferring every technical question.
  • Platform Proficiency: Confident using a modern CS platform (Vitally, Gainsight, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) and support tooling such as Intercom. More importantly, you pick up new tools quickly and don't need a training course to get started.
  • Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can lead a call with a GM or commercial director, present performance clearly, and handle pushback without losing the room.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: You enjoy the investigation. When a hotel's performance dips, you want to understand why, not just report that it happened.
  • Adaptability: Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and new features ship frequently.
  • Self-Direction: You manage your own time, portfolio, and priorities across a distributed team without needing to be chased.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in hospitality, travel tech, or a hotel commercial function (revenue management, e-commerce, distribution).
  • Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, or the metasearch and OTA landscape.
  • Experience using issue-tracking tools like Linear or JIRA.
  • Hands-on experience building with AI tools — automations, custom GPTs or Claude projects, scripts, no-code workflows.

Benefits

We’re a well-looked-after bunch, with excellent benefits (these vary by location):

  • A competitive salary and bonus plan
  • Regular career development reviews — we reward great work
  • Something important to you that’s not on this list? Talk to us

Please note: benefits may vary depending on employment type and location, and some benefits listed may not apply to contractor arrangements.

We set big goals and move fast, but we support each other every step of the way. If you're a CS pro who thrives on customer focus, data, and impact, we'd love to hear from you.

We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.

Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.

About this role

As part of Intersect's FP&A team, you'll own budgeting, liquidity forecasting, and financial reporting for our growing capital portfolio funding gigawatt-scale clean energy and data center infrastructure. Sitting close to executive leadership, you will translate multi-faceted operational and project-level data into actionable strategic insights that guide major capital allocation decisions. You will serve as a vital link between corporate finance, treasury, project development, and senior leadership.

You will bring structure to high-growth complexity, driving rigorous corporate financial planning while developing the next generation of FP&A talent.

Team overview

This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition by delivering the financial clarity, forecasting rigor, and liquidity management necessary to construct transformational infrastructure. The FP&A team partners directly with corporate leadership, development, and operational groups to allocate capital efficiently, mitigate risk, and maximize long-run value across our utility-scale clean energy and data center portfolio.

What you'll do

Lead Portfolio Forecasting and Liquidity Planning

  • Build, maintain, and enhance dynamic corporate cash flow, liquidity, and capital forecast models for multi-gigawatt energy and data center assets.

  • Monitor ongoing liquidity positions, working capital needs, and capital draw schedules across project pipelines.

Drive Executive Decision-Making and Reporting

  • Synthesize complex financial and operational metrics into strategic analysis and executive presentation decks for the CFO and senior management.

  • Develop scenario models and sensitivity analyses to evaluate business trade-offs, market shifts, and capital structure decisions.

Partner Cross-Functionally Across the Enterprise

  • Collaborate closely with Corporate Treasury, Project Finance, Accounting, and Capital Markets to align liquidity management with strategic objectives.

  • Establish scalable budgeting frameworks and standardized forecasting protocols across corporate and project entities.

Build and Elevate FP&A Team Capabilities

  • Provide direct guidance, technical mentorship, and quality control for financial models built by junior FP&A analysts.

  • Champion continuous process improvement in modeling standards, workflow automation, and tool utilization across Google Workspace and Excel.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related quantitative field; MBA or CFA credentials preferred.

  • 7+ years of progressive corporate FP&A, treasury, or financial modeling experience within capital-intensive sectors like clean energy, power, or infrastructure.

  • Advanced mastery of corporate cash flow forecasting, liquidity tracking, and quantitative modeling using Google Sheets and Excel, complemented by executive presentation skills in Google Slides.

  • Deep familiarity with utility-scale capital project expenditure cycles, project finance dynamics, and corporate capital allocation strategies.

  • Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of presenting complex financial analyses directly to C-suite executives and senior leaders.

  • Demonstrated capability to navigate fast-paced, ambiguous environments with autonomy, analytical rigor, and sound business judgment.

  • Alignment with Intersect's core values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First, with a dedication to mentoring and elevating team members.

Total Rewards

Total Compensation: $188,000 - $195,000 (total compensation includes base salary + bonus in USD)

Equity: Beyond your salary, you’ll receive an Equity Grant, giving you a meaningful stake in our parent company.

Health & wellness: 100% premium coverage for you and your dependents on medical, dental, and vision

Time to recharge: Unlimited PTO, plus two company-wide breaks (Fourth of July & end of year)

Family support: Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, plus 6 additional weeks for birth parents; access to family planning and family care support through Carrot and Maven

Mental health: Free access to Spring Health, including 5 free therapy and psychiatry sessions, plus a Headspace account for mindfulness and meditation through our physical health vendor, Wellhub+

Perks & extras: $150 monthly food stipend, $150 monthly reimbursement for cell phone and internet, pet insurance allowance, full home office setup, free access to UrbanSitter with $625 in quarterly company-paid credits, ActiveHero, and One Medical

Full-time • Competitive Pay • Excellent Benefits • Work from Anywhere in the Contiguous U.S.

MoveOn is a people-powered force for progress. We wield independent political power by bringing millions together to take action to create a country with a place of honor and dignity for everyone—where all are welcome, we take care of one another, and where everyone is set up to thrive.

For more than a generation, MoveOn has been a bulwark against the radical right and has channeled millions of voices to end wars, protect democracy, and advance justice for all. We've built political power for progressive change so that we can advance our vision of an America for all.

MoveOn is the largest multi-issue digital-first political campaigning organization in the country. We drive rapid-response campaigns at scale. Whether it's democracy, health care, foreign policy, immigration or otherwise, MoveOn provides our members with timely ways to take action for change.

Opportunity for Impact:

This role oversees the organization’s finance, operations, legal, and people functions across its entities: C3, C4 and PAC. The Chief Operating Officer is responsible for MoveOn’s long-term core business functions and operational and financial strategy, ensuring that these systems are designed and implemented efficiently and effectively, in line with the organization’s strategy and values; and in compliance with donor, government and other standards and requirements. The Chief Operating Officer serves as Chief Financial Officer and Assistant Treasurer of MoveOn’s entities.

The ideal candidate will be a strategic, experienced, values-driven leader with the ability to drive highly complex systems that deliver impeccable results in a rapidly changing environment. The Chief Operating Officer is a member of the Senior Management Team, and is responsible for ensuring that our operational and financial strategy enables us to grow the power of our membership in service of our vision to build an America for all, including building excellent organizational culture, values and practices that are rooted in equity, and systems and structures that allow for ongoing learning, accountability, and growth.

Responsibilities:

Operating Strategy:

  • Lead the implementation of MoveOn’s vision, strategic direction and operating model, in alignment with organizational objectives.

  • Serve as a member of the Senior management team Team, reporting to the Executive Director, and partner effectively with other department heads to translate MoveOn’s strategic goals into Operations Department objectives, KPIs.

  • Lead and direct the Operations Department to advance MoveOn’s culture, and its overall goals and strategies.

  • Strengthen MoveOn’s culture rooted in equity, championing innovation and appropriate risk-taking in service of growing progressive political power.

  • Serve as a thought partner and sounding board to the Executive Director and other senior leaders, and as a resource for staff to raise ideas and concerns.

  • Lead a distributed, high-performing Operations Department, maintaining and improving the infrastructure, systems, and culture needed to manage staff across the United States.

Financial & Fiscal Oversight:

  • Lead the development of strategies for a financially solvent and sustainable organization, directing MoveOn's combined annual budget and reserves strategy to safeguard long-term financial health.

  • Oversee the annual budgeting process across all entities, guiding the Finance & Operations Team in monitoring progress and resolving challenges.

  • Oversee grant management, guiding the Finance & Operations Team in its administration, deliverables, reporting, compliance, and cross-organizational coordination.

  • Oversee all income reporting to boards, staff, and stakeholders.

  • Build and conduct financial forecasting and analysis for future planning

  • Ensure the Senior Management Team, boards, budget holders, and other stakeholders receive accurate, relevant financial information, and articulate MoveOn's budget and accounting philosophy to internal and external audiences.

Team & Talent:

  • Oversee human resources and organizational development, ensuring human capital strategies align with MoveOn’s overarching vision and goals, and that organizational culture drives collaboration, alignment, adaptability, and shared success.

  • Translate the organization’s overarching vision and goals into operational strategies, including structural talent requirements, to ensure the right staffing levels and skill sets are in place.

  • Oversee talent retention strategies to ensure MoveOn attracts and retains top-tier talent and maintains a competitive edge in the movement.

  • Direct and support effective succession planning to ensure organizational continuity and resilience.

  • Along with other senior leadership, shape MoveOn’s culture by overseeing initiatives that promote employee engagement, diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility (DEIA), and overall workforce well-being.

  • Direct the development and implementation of performance management frameworks, including performance evaluations, feedback systems, and leadership and management development programs.

  • Provide strategic leadership to future-proof MoveOn’s human resources and organizational development strategies and practices by ensuring people operations, talent strategies, and systems remain resilient, adaptable, and effective amid external disruptions.

  • Supervise the People Team to lead human resources and organizational development efforts, from talent planning and acquisition, talent management and development, total rewards, and offboarding to change management, culture-building, and team-building interventions that keep staff engaged.

Risk, Compliance & Legal:

  • Lead the organization's enterprise risk management program, directing the development of strategies to assess and mitigate organizational financial, operational, employment, and reputational risks.

  • Oversee MoveOn's legal operations, managing and addressing legal risks, issues, and board management.

  • Ensure MoveOn’s entities uphold best practices in board governance, fiduciary duty, compliance, and transparency.

  • Secure appropriate liability insurance across all entities and activities.

  • Oversee the Finance & Operations Team in successfully leading the annual audit process and reporting to MoveOn's boards of directors, and direct all state and federal campaign finance, lobbying, tax, and charitable registration reporting.

  • Maintain and enforce the resource separation agreement between MoveOn entities at every level of the organization.

  • Represent the organization publicly as needed, and take on other responsibilities as assigned by the Executive Director.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 5+ years serving as the COO, CFO, or comparable role of a mid-sized multi-entity nonprofit.

  • 10+ years of senior-level or executive leadership experience with a demonstrated track record of leading high-performing operational functions, preferably within political, nonprofit, advocacy, and/or social justice environments

  • Experience with multi-entity organizations; including C3, C4 and PAC entities.

  • A deep experience in assessing and mitigating operational, financial, and reputational risks.

  • A deep understanding of and commitment to justice, equity, diversity and inclusion, and embedding equity-centered practices into communications, culture, and organizational strategy

  • Strong ability to think strategically and translate overarching goals and strategies into operational objectives.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to translate complex organizational data into clear and simple messages for a wide range of audiences.

  • Experience managing and leading high-performing staff across the Finance and People Teams.

  • Ability to manage complex projects, deadlines, and work across departments, while prioritizing effectively across a wide range of responsibilities.

  • Comfort and ease working in a fast-paced environment demonstrating grace under pressure.

Reports to: Executive Director

Location: Position may be based anywhere in the contiguous United States. May require occasional travel.

To counter systemic compensation issues in this country and pay inequality, we have a nonnegotiable compensation practice. Business Development & Client Engagement

﻿Quality, Compliance & Regulatory

  • Management System (QMS), and sponsor requirements.

﻿People Leadership, Talent & Organizational Development

Cold Email Specialist (Deliverability, Client Success & Campaign Operations) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible, with overlap during U.S. business hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly execution-focused Cold Email Specialist to own client campaign performance, deliverability, retention, and operational execution within a fast-growing startup environment.

This is not a passive account management role.

You’ll be responsible for the full lifecycle of outbound cold email campaigns—from inbox placement and deliverability to campaign optimization, client communication, and long-term retention. You’ll work closely with the founder, outreach team, developers, and operations to ensure campaigns perform, clients stay successful, and delivery standards continue to scale.

If you understand cold email beyond basic outreach—including infrastructure, warm-up, deliverability, inbox health, copy performance, and campaign optimization—this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Client Campaign Ownership

  • Manage a portfolio of 20–30 active client accounts.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for campaign performance and communication.
  • Lead client check-ins and performance reviews.
  • Manage expectations and provide proactive campaign updates.
  • Build long-term client relationships.
  • Identify risks early and proactively reduce churn.

Cold Email Campaign Performance

  • Diagnose and optimize underperforming campaigns.
  • Troubleshoot:
    • Deliverability issues
    • Inbox placement
    • Domain reputation
    • Spam issues
    • List quality
    • Low reply rates
  • Optimize:
    • Subject lines
    • Messaging
    • Sequences
    • Personalization
  • Quality-check campaigns before launch.
  • Continuously improve campaign performance through testing and optimization.

Deliverability & Infrastructure

  • Manage and optimize:
    • Warm-up systems
    • Inbox reputation
    • Sending domains
    • DNS configuration
    • SPF
    • DKIM
    • DMARC
  • Monitor inbox placement and sender health.
  • Troubleshoot technical campaign issues independently.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to improve outbound infrastructure and automation.

Copywriting & Campaign Optimization

  • Write and refine outbound cold email copy.
  • Improve:
    • Open rates
    • Reply rates
    • Positive response rates
  • Test messaging variations using campaign performance data.
  • Balance personalization with scalable outreach.

Process Improvement & Operations

  • Build and maintain campaign documentation and SOPs.
  • Improve operational workflows and delivery processes.
  • Track:
    • SLAs
    • Client health
    • Campaign performance
    • Operational metrics
  • Help build scalable systems as the company grows.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
    • Developers
    • Infrastructure teams
    • Outreach specialists
    • Leadership
  • Coordinate campaign execution and issue resolution.
  • Report directly to the founder on:
    • Campaign performance
    • Client risks
    • Retention
    • Operational improvements

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients remain satisfied and renew their services.
  • Campaigns maintain strong inbox placement and deliverability.
  • Reply rates and conversion rates improve consistently.
  • Campaigns launch accurately and on time.
  • Operational workflows remain organized and scalable.
  • Technical and client issues are resolved proactively.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership instead of waiting for direction.
  • You thrive in startup environments with evolving systems.
  • You understand that deliverability is just as important as messaging.
  • You’re equally comfortable solving technical and client-facing challenges.
  • You communicate confidently with founders and executives.
  • You focus on outcomes, execution, and continuous improvement.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • Experience working in:
    • Cold email agencies
    • Lead generation companies
    • Outbound sales organizations
    • Startup operations
  • Strong expertise in:
    • Cold email strategy
    • Deliverability
    • Inbox placement
    • Warm-up systems
    • Outbound infrastructure
  • Strong outbound copywriting skills.
  • Experience troubleshooting:
    • Spam issues
    • Domain reputation
    • Low-performing campaigns
  • Technical understanding of:
    • APIs
    • Automations
    • Workflows
    • Outbound systems
  • Daily experience using:
    • ChatGPT
    • Claude
    • AI-powered automation workflows
  • Strong client communication and relationship management skills.
  • Comfortable working independently in fast-paced environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using:
    • Instantly
    • Smartlead
    • Clay
    • Apollo
    • Lemlist
    • Outreach
    • HubSpot
  • Familiarity with:
    • Zapier
    • Make
    • Webhooks
    • Automation platforms
  • Experience scaling outbound systems for startups or agencies.
  • SaaS or lead generation industry experience.

Tech Stack

  • Instantly
  • Smartlead
  • Clay
  • Apollo
  • Lemlist
  • Outreach
  • HubSpot
  • Zapier
  • Make
  • ChatGPT
  • Claude

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review campaign dashboards and inbox health.
  • Troubleshoot deliverability and reply-rate issues.
  • Optimize copy, targeting, and sequencing.
  • Meet with clients to review campaign performance.
  • Coordinate with outreach and technical teams.
  • Launch and quality-check new campaigns.
  • Monitor domain reputation and warm-up systems.
  • Update SOPs and operational documentation.

In short: You’ll own the technical performance, operational execution, and client success of outbound cold email campaigns while helping scale reliable systems that generate consistent results.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Client retention and churn reduction.
  • Inbox placement and deliverability rates.
  • Campaign reply and conversion rates.
  • Client satisfaction and relationship health.
  • SLA adherence and operational consistency.
  • Overall improvement in client campaign performance.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership with direct impact on client success.
  • Close collaboration with founders and technical teams.
  • Blend of:
    • Deliverability
    • Campaign operations
    • Client success
    • Outbound strategy
    • Copywriting
  • Opportunity to build scalable outbound systems.
  • Fast-paced startup environment with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Career progression into:
    • Client Success Manager
    • Outbound Operations Lead
    • Deliverability Specialist
    • Growth Operations Manager

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Founder Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your experience managing cold email campaigns, and explain how you’ve improved deliverability, inbox placement, campaign performance, and client retention. You’ll also have the chance to demonstrate your knowledge of outbound infrastructure, warm-up systems, copy optimization, and the AI tools you use to improve operational efficiency. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the founder interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about cold email, understand deliverability inside and out, and enjoy owning client outcomes from campaign launch through long-term success, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build high-performing outbound systems that drive measurable business growth.

Job Title: Customer Success Manager
Location: Denver, CO or U.S. (Remote)

About FusionAuth
FusionAuth is a fast-growing startup and leading provider of customer identity and access management (CIAM) software headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Our mission is to make authentication and authorization simple and secure for every developer. Our product helps businesses securely manage customer identities and access, ensuring a seamless and safe user experience for some of the largest brands in the world. We are committed to delivering exceptional value and satisfaction to our clients through top-notch service and support. With a great team and strong investors, we are expanding our team to help accelerate our growth and take FusionAuth to the next level.

Job Summary

At FusionAuth, our Customer Success charter is simple: create customers for life. As a CSM, you'll own a portfolio of accounts, ensuring long-term success with FusionAuth. We're looking for someone passionate about understanding our customers, account by account and across their portfolio, to help us shape best practices and influence overall customer outcomes.

You'll bring curiosity, a strong technical aptitude, and a data-first mindset to every engagement. Your day-to-day spans working with customers across their adoption journey, deepening executive and developer relationships, facilitating renewals, and identifying growth opportunities. You'll also build customer advocacy through referrals and case studies, contributing to best practices that benefit the whole team and customer base.

This is a revenue-accountable role. You'll operate through the lens of net retention — measuring success by retention, growth, and advocacy participation across your portfolio.

Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of accounts across their full lifecycle with FusionAuth.
  • Drive customer health and adoption by proactively monitoring adoption metrics, addressing risks, and delivering personalized engagement so customers realize the full value of FusionAuth
  • Manage renewals by owning the process from start to closure, ensuring timely processing with an eye toward future customer needs.
  • Grow your portfolio by understanding customer use cases and goals, identifying expansion opportunities, and partnering with sales and marketing to execute.
  • Build customer advocacy by capturing case studies, referrals, and best practices that improve the experience for the broader customer base.
  • Ensure accurate revenue forecasting by maintaining updated renewal and expansion forecasts and keeping CRM records current.

How You'll Get There

  • Apply a portfolio mindset to define engagement strategies aligned to both FusionAuth and customer business objectives, using data and insights to prioritize and scale your activities.
  • Know the product deeply enough to partner with customers on adoption strategies, identify growth opportunities, and deliver meaningful business reviews tied to customer outcomes.
  • Represent your customers internally by bringing their objectives and feedback to the product team, and giving them visibility into FusionAuth's roadmap and strategy.
  • Partner with support, sales, and product to ensure a cohesive customer experience from onboarding through renewal

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or related roles in a B2B organization, including ownership of customer retention and growth goals.
  • Familiarity with CRM and CS platforms such as Salesforce, Gong, or similar tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude. Able to quickly learn and credibly explain complex technology concepts, and to partner with customers on adoption and solution strategies.
  • Customer-centric communicator: equally comfortable presenting to a developer and an executive, with the empathy and clarity to meet each where they are.
  • Data-driven problem solver: curious by nature, able to identify patterns across a portfolio, and skilled at prioritizing and addressing customer risk and opportunity.
  • Proven ability to grow accounts by uncovering new use cases and confidently navigating commercial conversations through to close.
  • Highly organized and self-directed; able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
  • Growth mindset. Open to feedback, committed to continuous improvement, and eager to grow with FusionAuth as we scale.

Compensation

  • $110k - 115k expected OTE range*
*Pursuant to various state laws, we must display the pay range for this job. Since we are willing to hire within a broad spectrum of qualifications, this range is broad. The expected base salary may be adjusted based on individual qualifications, role, level and location.

Benefits

For full-time team members, we offer:

  • Comprehensive health insurance including medical, dental, and vision coverage, with the company covering the majority of your medical premiums to keep your costs low
    • Fully employer-paid High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) option paired with a Health Savings Account (HSA), including employer contributions
  • Basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage fully paid by the company for essential financial protection
  • Voluntary life insurance options to provide additional financial protection for you and your loved ones
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) to save pre-tax dollars on eligible expenses
  • 401(k) plan with company match to help you save for retirement
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) plus paid company holidays to support work-life balance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential counseling and support services
  • Professional growth and development opportunities to boost your career journey
  • Eligibility for performance-based bonuses or variable compensation tied to individual, team, or company results

Important Details

  • Application Submission: We value authentic, thoughtful responses. Copy/pasted or AI-generated answers to application questions that don’t reflect your own experience may disqualify your application.
  • In-Person Interview: Please be aware that participating in an in-person interview is a required step in the FusionAuth hiring process prior to employment. This visit allows both FusionAuth and the candidate to get to know each other better and confirm a strong mutual fit and alignment with our team and work environment. Candidates are encouraged to plan accordingly, and FusionAuth supports this process by reimbursing reasonable travel and lodging expenses associated with onsite interviews.
  • Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

If you are passionate about technology that solves real-world customer problems, and want to join a company that is moving the industry forward, FusionAuth is a perfect fit for you!

Equal Employment Opportunity
FusionAuth provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
E-Verify | Right to Work

Recruiters
FusionAuth does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of FusionAuth.

jobs.excerpt: Hey there!  KodeKloud is a young, fully remote, bootstrapped startup growing fast.
jobs.description:
Hey there! KodeKloud is a young, fully remote, bootstrapped startup growing fast. Trusted by over 1 million users worldwide, we're an EdTech SaaS company dedicated to transforming the way businesses upskill their teams in DevOps, Cloud Computing, and IT by offering hands-on, practical learning experience.

As trailblazers in the remote-first workforce, we seamlessly blend work from cozy cafes, sunny beaches, mountain retreats, and vibrant cities or from our company-sponsored home office setups. Our team spans the globe, and we're all about creating a fun, no-ego environment where everyone can learn, grow, and make an impact.

For this role, we're looking for someone who can build an IT function from nothing and run it properly. We're 110+ people across 22 countries with no offices - which means everything a traditional IT team would own (identity, devices, access, tooling, security controls) is currently spread across different teams. You'd be the first person to take all of it, decide how it should work, and make it work.

This is a "build + run" role in the truest sense. Some of it is hands-on and immediate - someone's laptop has died in Moldova, a new joiner starts in Singapore on Monday. Some of it is systemic - choosing and deploying MDM, owning our SOC 2 technical controls, building a device lifecycle that works across borders. You'll need to be good at both, and comfortable deciding what to fix first.

Note: This is a hands-on individual contributor role to start with, and it's our first IT hire. You won't be inheriting a function - you'll be designing one, with the opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale.

Responsibilities

What You'll Own & Lead:
  • Google Workspace & Identity Own Workspace end to end - org structure, security settings, licences, groups, mail routing, and retention. Enforce SSO and MFA across every business tool, and make sure our domain can't be spoofed in mail sent to our customers.
  • Access Management & Privileged Access Governance Own joiner, mover and leaver access across all systems. Run quarterly access reviews on a least-privilege basis, control third-party app access, and put real governance around privileged access - an approval path for account and mailbox access, audit log monitoring, and a record of who used elevated access and why.
  • Device & Endpoint Management Select, deploy and run MDM across every company-owned device - encryption, screen lock, patching, endpoint protection, remote lock and wipe. Build a workable approach for personally-owned devices where full management isn't available to us.
  • Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Global Logistics Build and own a single asset register - every device, who holds it, what it costs, which entity owns it, when it's due for refresh. Set standard specs, run regional procurement (buy, lease, or device-as-a-service, whichever actually wins), and own returns, buyback, resale and secure disposal with proof of data destruction.
  • Enterprise Tooling & SaaS Governance Bring tool administration out of individual inboxes and into managed ownership. Maintain a central register of every business tool with its owner, cost, renewal date, data classification and DPA status. Reclaim licences at exit, kill duplicate tools, and surface shadow IT - including AI tools, and what data is going into them.
  • Security & Compliance Execution (SOC 2 & GDPR) Own the technical side of compliance: implement the controls, run them, and evidence them. Access reviews, onboarding and offboarding trails, change records, compliance automation tooling, incident response (including rehearsing it), and the vendor and subprocessor register. Coordinate penetration tests and track remediation. Be our named owner for customer security questionnaires and enterprise security reviews.
  • Security Awareness & Enablement Run security awareness and phishing training that people actually complete, and build an internal knowledge base so the same question doesn't get answered twice. Explain risk to non-technical teammates without hand-waving or lecturing.
  • IT Support & Day-1 Readiness Run a real support channel with published response times that works across our time zones. Make sure every new KodeKlouder has their accounts live and their laptop in hand before day one, and that leavers are fully offboarded the same day, with an evidence trail.
  • Automation, Vendors & IT Budget Automate the repetitive work - provisioning, deprovisioning, reporting. Manage IT vendors and renewals in partnership with Finance, with a clear view of what we're spending and why.

Requirements

Must-have:
  • 5-8 years in IT operations or IT and security, including a distributed or remote-first environment
  • Deep Google Workspace administration - real depth, not familiarity with the admin console
  • Hands-on MDM ownership across macOS and Windows
  • Identity and access management: SSO, MFA, provisioning, access reviews
  • Experienced in vendor negotiation and renewal management

Nice-to-have
  • Has carried SOC 2 (or ISO 27001) controls through an audit as an implementer, not a policy author
  • Working GDPR knowledge in a technical context
  • Multi-country asset lifecycle management
  • Scripting and automation for provisioning and reporting
  • Experience administering JumpCloud and using Drata or equivalent compliance platforms

Benefits

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere - yes, your couch in pajamas is totally fine.

We're seeking a Product Manager, Parcel Management, to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of one of Schneider Geospatial's flagship product lines. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer (CPO), you'll partner with Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and customers to deliver innovative solutions that help local governments manage parcel data, support property assessment and taxation workflows, and provide reliable public access to property information.

You'll combine strategic product thinking with a deep curiosity for how assessors, auditors, treasurers, GIS teams, and other local government professionals work, translating complex parcel and property-data challenges into intuitive, scalable software that improves accuracy, efficiency, and transparency.

This is a unique opportunity to own a high-impact product in a PE-backed company entering an exciting phase of growth and modernization. You'll shape product strategy, influence customer outcomes, and help define the next generation of parcel management and public access solutions.

Why Join Us

  • Mission + Impact: Build technology that helps local governments better serve citizens and businesses.

  • Ownership + Innovation: Lead a flagship product with meaningful ownership and strategic influence.

  • Growth + Learning: Partner with experienced product and executive leaders committed to mentorship and professional development.

  • Culture + Collaboration: Join a company recognized for its values-driven culture, collaborative environment, and relentless focus on customer success.

  • Compensation + Opportunity: Competitive salary, benefits, and clear pathways toward senior product leadership.

  • Define and execute the product vision for Schneider Geospatial's Parcel Management solutions.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering to translate product strategy into actionable user stories, features, and technical priorities.

  • Develop data-driven business cases for new features and enhancements that improve data quality, customer outcomes, and business value.

  • Support Sales and Marketing through product demonstrations, competitive positioning, launch planning, and customer education.

  • Leverage AI-enabled tools, product analytics, customer insights, and experimentation to accelerate product discovery, improve decision-making, and continuously enhance the user experience.

Customer & Market Insight

  • Build strong relationships with customers to understand parcel-data workflows, operational challenges, statutory requirements, integration needs, and opportunities for innovation.

  • Monitor product performance, industry trends, data standards, legislation, and competitive offerings to inform ongoing product strategy.

What You Bring

Our Product Managers are both strategic and hands-on, comfortable defining long-term vision while diving into product details that create exceptional customer experiences. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, solving complex business problems, and building products customers genuinely love.

jobs.description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the role

As a Mid-level Software Engineer at Ledgy, you’ll build reliable, scalable product experiences that help companies manage their equity with confidence. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn complex equity workflows into clear, automated, user-friendly software.

This role is a strong fit if you’re ready to take ownership of well-scoped projects, grow your technical judgement, and contribute across the stack while learning from senior peers.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

Teams we are hiring for:

  • Core Equity — Owns the foundational logic that powers Ledgy’s equity engine. Every equity-related event — such as issuing shares, creating new pools, or adjusting ownership — generates transactions. This team defines and maintains the transaction logic, data model, and core domain behaviour that ensure Ledgy’s platform remains accurate, scalable, and compliant. They also enable employees to sell their shares seamlessly once vested.
  • Workflows & Automation — Focuses on automating complex equity workflows and integrating with third-party services, including the trading exchange. The team builds systems that help company admins efficiently onboard and offboard employees, automate equity grants and terminations.
  • Reporting — Transforms Ledgy’s core equity data into financial, operational, and compliance reports. The team manages large, complex datasets and ensures reporting is accurate, performant, and reliable across jurisdictions and company structures. Their work powers the insights companies and auditors rely on for decision-making and transparency.
  • Tax — Ensures taxes are correctly reflected throughout equity operations, especially moments such as exercising, selling, mobility, and other taxable events. As a future team, Tax will build end-to-end product capabilities across the stack, helping customers manage complex tax and compliance requirements accurately across jurisdictions.

You will thrive in the role if you

  • You have 3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer
  • You are comfortable building and shipping production-quality features across the stack
  • You enjoy learning complex domains and turning them into simple, maintainable product experiences
  • You care about clean, tested, readable code and thoughtful collaboration
  • You are curious about equity, financial workflows, and their real-world impact on companies and employees
  • You’re excited to grow your technical judgement through code reviews, pairing, and architecture discussions
  • You take ownership of your work while asking for input early when trade-offs are unclear

Our Tech Stack*:

We have a modern, cohesive stack that lets us move fast while maintaining quality:

  • Language: TypeScript
  • Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, tRPC
  • Backend: tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, Temporal
  • Infrastructure: GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions

*We don’t expect proficiency in this specific stack

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

  • Be paired with an onboarding buddy who will introduce you to the world of equity management
  • Get to know your engineering team, product managers, and designers
  • Learn how your team’s domain connects to the broader Ledgy platform
  • Set up your development environment and start contributing small, well-scoped changes
  • Build familiarity with our codebase, product workflows, and engineering practices

First 3 months:

  • Ship product features and improvements with increasing independence
  • Work with teammates to break down problems, understand trade-offs, and deliver reliable solutions
  • Participate actively in code reviews and team discussions
  • Develop a deeper understanding of how companies manage and automate equity
  • Contribute to improving quality, maintainability, and user experience in your team’s domain

  • Collaborate with Product and Design to shape pragmatic, user-centric solutions
  • Contribute to technical discussions around data models, workflows, and scalability
  • Continue growing toward senior-level ownership, judgement, and impact

Envoy Global is a proven innovator in the global immigration space. Our mission combines our industry-leading tech platform with holistic service to streamline, simplify and expedite the immigration process for employers and individuals.

We have an opening within Envoy's growing Legal team for a Junior Legal Counsel to join us on a full-time basis. This role provides legal support to the in-house legal team across multiple jurisdictions in EMEA, applying a sound grounding in legal concepts and legal research to advise internal teams on straightforward matters and to assist, under supervision, on more complex matters. The role negotiates and drafts a range of commercial contracts, including in German, and coordinates with internal stakeholders to gather facts and timelines for legal projects, tracks matters through to resolution, and flags issues requiring senior input. The role requires adaptability, sound judgement on when to escalate, and the ability to work across different legal systems and languages.

As an International Junior Legal Counsel, you will assist in managing legal matters related to our global subsidiary entities as we continue to grow organically and through M&A, including:

  • Advise internal teams and triage requests. Serve as a first point of contact for internal legal queries; provide clear, practical advice on straightforward matters using approved guidance, playbooks and precedent, and identify and escalate more complex or high-risk matters to senior counsel with a recommended course of action.

  • Assist on complex matters under supervision. Support senior counsel on complex or novel legal matters and projects; carry out preparatory analysis, draft initial positions and options, and help implement agreed strategy, working within clearly defined supervision and escalation lines.

  • Negotiate and draft contracts, includingin German. Draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts, NDAs and related agreements, including with German-speaking counterparties, adapting company templates and precedent to the deal at hand, and flag any departure from approved positions to senior counsel before agreeing terms.

  • Track matters and coordinate stakeholder engagement. Maintain trackers and dashboards reflecting the lifecycle status of contracts, renewals and corporate filings across multiple jurisdictions, and alert stakeholders to upcoming deadlines and required actions; engage with internal stakeholders across jurisdictions to gather facts, documents and timelines for legal matters and projects, and follow up on outstanding information to keep matters on schedule.

  • Provide practical legal input to commercialand operational teams. Respond to day-to-day legal queries from commercial, finance and operational stakeholders; explain legal concepts in clear business language, and route matters requiring senior input to the appropriate lawyer.

  • Conduct legal research and produce practical advice. Perform legal research on statutes, regulations, case law and industry guidance relevant to ongoing matters; identify risks and key developments, and translate findings into clear, structured advice for internal stakeholders and senior counsel, including issue framing, citations and practical implications for the business.

  • Improve contract templates and playbooks. Identify opportunities to improve contract templates, clause libraries and negotiation playbooks; propose process improvements that reduce turnaround time and improve consistency across jurisdictions.

  • Provide corporate governance support. Assist with maintaining corporate records and statutory registers across multiple jurisdictions, preparing routine resolutions and filings, organizing board materials, and ensuring governance documents are accurate, up to date, and properly stored. Assist with annual compliance tasks under attorney supervision. Assist with responding to KYC and due‑diligence requests by preparing corporate information packs, coordinating cross‑functional input, and ensuring accurate, timely submissions.

To apply for this role, you should possess the following skills, experience and qualifications:

  • 2-3 years’ experience as a lawyer, ideally in commercial or corporate legal practice, at an international in-house team and/or at a law firm.
  • Proven experience drafting, reviewing, negotiating and redlining contracts, including NDAs, commercial agreements and other legal documents, in both English and German.
  • Business fluency in German, with the ability to advise, negotiate and draft in German as well as English.
  • Strong project‑management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of contracts and contribute to strategic legal initiatives.
  • Demonstrated capability conducting legal research and translating findings into clear, practical advice for internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent time‑management and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines efficiently.
  • Ability to advise independently on straightforward matters and collaborate effectively with senior counsel on complex ones, within a fast-paced, cross-border team environment.
  • Experience maintaining and improving document templates, clause libraries, and standard forms.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills, with the ability to identify issues early, escalate appropriately, and propose practical solutions.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to different legal systems, cultures, and ways of working in an international environment.

In return, you will work for a supportive, employee-focused organization that encourages staff to achieve a work-life balance, teamwork, and communication on a global scale with other offices.

This role is 100% remote, working from homewithin the United Kingdom.

If you feel that you meet our requirements, we look forward to hearing from you asap!

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an AI-native builder and generalist to lead practical AI adoption across the organization.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI-native builder and generalist to lead practical AI adoption across the organization. This is primarily a hands-on technical role focused on rapidly building, integrating, and deploying high-impact AI solutions—not a traditional data science or machine learning research position.

The ideal candidate moves fluidly between AI engineering, software development, systems integration, and business process automation. You should be comfortable taking loosely defined operational challenges and independently driving them from problem to prototype to production.

Location:LATAM 100% Remote. Working hours are based on the US Pacific Time Zone. Minimum 6-hour overlap

About the Company:

Abstra is a fast-growing, Nearshore Tech Talent services company, providing top Latin American tech talent to U.S. companies and beyond. Founded by U.S.-bred engineers with over 15 years of experience, Abstra specializes in sourcing skilled professionals across a wide range of technologies to meet our clients’ needs, driving innovation and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Internal AI & Knowledge Tools: Build, deploy, and maintain internal AI agents and intelligent search tools to answer common organizational questions using internal documents, standards, pricing models, policies, and naming conventions.
  • Process & Workflow Automation: Automate repetitive business workflows by building agentic systems capable of executing multi-step, autonomous actions across multiple internal tools.
  • Systems & Platform Integration: Extend existing back-office platforms (e.g., Monday.com, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Ironclad, and other SaaS tools) by building custom integrations with AI models, APIs, databases, and document repositories.
  • Document Intelligence & Content Generation: Automate document review, comparison, summarization, data extraction, classification, and creation. Build automated templates, prompts, and workflows for recurring deliverables like RFPs, RFIs, proposals, reports, and presentations.
  • Custom Application Development: Rapidly design and deploy lightweight internal applications, web tools, and scripts when off-the-shelf software falls short.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Serve as the internal AI lead—identifying high-impact automation opportunities, evaluating the AI features of software during procurement, and determining when to build custom tools versus buying existing solutions.
  • Infrastructure, Security & Governance: Establish reusable AI infrastructure, tool-calling patterns, permissions, logging, security frameworks, and evaluation methods, while developing clear organizational AI best practices.
  • User Support & Iteration: Collaborate directly with business teams and leadership to prototype solutions rapidly. Train, support, and enable employees to leverage AI tools effectively in their day-to-day work.

Required Qualifications:

  • AI & LLM Ecosystem Expertise: Deep hands-on experience building with modern LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, etc.), LLM APIs, function/tool calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and current AI agent frameworks.
  • Software Development & Integration Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, REST APIs, relational/vector databases, SaaS API integrations, and modern cloud or containerized deployment workflows.
  • Pragmatic Product Mindset: Proven ability to rapidly prototype, iterate, and ship functional software solutions independently.
  • Communication & Problem-Solving: Excellent collaboration skills to translate ambiguous business requirements into practical technical solutions and train non-technical users on new tools.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation paid in USD.
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO) per year.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development.
  • Company-provided equipment.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and multicultural work environment.
  • The opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects alongside a talented and supportive team.

Pre-Employment Verification
As part of our standard onboarding process, candidates who successfully complete the interview process and accept an employment offer will be required to complete an employment verification check, and background check. This process will confirm job titles and dates of employment with two previous employers and is a standard requirement for all new employees joining the company.

Why Apply to Koombea?

Did you know that Koombea is one of Latin America's fastest-growing software development companies? We help our clients all over the world build digital products that make users' lives better.
By joining our team, you will not only receive amazing benefits and become part of a flexible and innovative work culture. You will also get to share directly with some of the region's most talented and intelligent software developers.

The Job

You'll own features end-to-end — from a Postgres data model to a deployed React interface on AWS — while keeping infrastructure costs, test coverage, and release safety front of mind. The foundation is solid engineering: strong programming fundamentals, architecture intuition, and comfort working inside a regulated, data-sensitive platform.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across a Django monolith, Postgres, and a React front end
    • Build backend services and APIs in Python, and front-end functionality in React/TypeScript, for both web and mobile use cases
    • Optimize query strategies, caching, and state management to improve performance and control infrastructure costs as the platform scales

jobs.title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer, AI Infrastructure (m/f/x)
jobs.excerpt: MAIA is the AI platform built for companies where generic AI tools break down because the data is complex, the stakes are high, and precision matters.
jobs.description:
MAIA is the AI platform built for companies where generic AI tools break down because the data is complex, the stakes are high, and precision matters.

We work on the difficult parts of enterprise AI: understanding complex documents, integrating AI into real workflows, making organisational knowledge accessible, and operating the underlying systems reliably and securely.

As our customer base, product capabilities, and engineering team grow, we are investing further in the platform beneath MAIA. We are looking for our first dedicated Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to take technical ownership of our infrastructure and production operations.

You will develop an existing platform and shape its next stage across architecture, automation, observability, security, and AI infrastructure. Our environment combines self-administered Linux servers, European infrastructure providers, dedicated hardware, and services from AWS, Azure, and GCP. Over time, we will also expand our European infrastructure and inference options as one part of our platform strategy.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role without people management. You will initially be the only dedicated Platform Engineer, working closely with our software engineers and company leadership.

We are opening this role to remote candidates across Germany. For this setup to work, you need a strong track record of independently operating production systems, communicating proactively, and moving complex infrastructure work forward without constant coordination.

Tasks

  • You take technical ownership of MAIA’s production infrastructure. You operate and evolve self-administered Linux systems across virtual machines and dedicated servers, including containers, networks, reverse proxies, and API gateways.
  • You make deployments safe, repeatable, and easy for engineers to use. You improve our Infrastructure as Code, GitHub Actions workflows, deployment processes, automated checks, versioning, and rollback capabilities.
  • You operate and improve PostgreSQL in production. This includes performance analysis, connection pooling, capacity planning, backups, and regularly tested restore procedures.
  • You develop our self-hosted observability stack. You connect metrics, logs, traces, and actionable alerts so that we understand system behaviour and identify problems before they affect more customers.
  • You strengthen security across our infrastructure. You implement and maintain IAM, least privilege, secrets management, TLS, vulnerability scanning, and patch management.
  • You implement technical controls for ISO 27001. You design them so that evidence is generated continuously and remains understandable and auditable.
  • You help shape our AI infrastructure. You integrate model and inference providers and evaluate them based on reliability, latency, throughput, cost, and operational effort.
  • You explore self-hosted LLM inference where it creates real value. Over time, this may include GPU infrastructure and serving technologies such as vLLM. Previous production experience in this area is helpful but not required.
  • You improve incident response and operational resilience. You investigate root causes, establish useful runbooks, document operational knowledge, and turn incidents into lasting improvements.
  • You improve the internal developer experience. You reduce manual work, create clear interfaces and workflows, and help engineers ship changes with confidence.
  • You make infrastructure and inference costs transparent. You identify relevant cost drivers and help us make informed build, buy, and hosting decisions.

You will help determine the initial priorities after assessing the existing platform. We expect you to identify the most relevant risks, explain the available options, and take improvements through to reliable production operation.

Requirements

Your technical experience

  • You have several years of experience operating production SaaS systems on Linux servers you or your team administered directly. Experience limited to fully managed hyperscaler services is not sufficient for this role.
  • You have operated Docker and Docker Compose in production and understand reverse proxies or API gateways such as Traefik or Kong.
  • You have practical experience operating PostgreSQL, including backups and restores you have personally configured and tested, performance analysis, and connection pooling.
  • You have built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or comparable systems.
  • You have managed infrastructure through Terraform, Pulumi, or comparable Infrastructure as Code tooling.
  • You have operated an observability stack using tools such as Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, Sentry, or comparable technologies.
  • You understand the security foundations of production infrastructure, including IAM, least privilege, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and patching.
  • You can design infrastructure that is reliable for customers and straightforward for engineers to use.
  • You communicate fluently in English. German is helpful but not required.

Your AI foundation

You understand how RAG systems work and where they commonly fail in production. You can discuss the basic trade-offs involved in LLM serving, including latency, throughput, reliability, cost, and operational complexity.

You follow developments in models, inference providers, and the wider GenAI market closely enough to evaluate new options critically.

We do not expect you to arrive as an expert in GPU operations or self-hosted inference. We expect a strong platform engineering foundation and the technical curiosity to develop deeper expertise in AI infrastructure.

How you work

  • You take responsibility from initial investigation through production operation.
  • You investigate unfamiliar systems until you understand the relevant behaviour and failure modes.
  • You make architecture decisions deliberately and document the reasoning behind them.
  • You value maintainability, automation, tested recovery, and clear operational processes.
  • You prioritise according to risk and impact and communicate trade-offs openly.
  • You remain structured during incidents and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You use AI tools productively while remaining accountable for every architecture decision and production change.
  • You communicate proactively in a distributed team and make your progress, decisions, risks, and blockers visible.

The bar for this remote role

This position combines broad technical responsibility with a high degree of autonomy. For the remote setup, we are therefore looking for candidates who have already demonstrated that they can:

  • independently operate business-critical production systems;
  • identify and prioritise infrastructure work without waiting for detailed instructions;
  • lead technical improvements across team boundaries;
  • communicate reliably in writing and remotely; and
  • remain accountable after a change has been deployed.

Interest in growing into these responsibilities is valuable, but for this particular opening, we need evidence that you have already carried a substantial part of them in practice.

Helpful, but not required

  • Experience with Hetzner, NixOS, or self-hosted Supabase.
  • Experience implementing technical ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence.
  • Experience with SRE practices such as SLOs, error budgets, and incident reviews.
  • Experience operating GPUs or serving LLMs with technologies such as vLLM.

Benefits

  • A substantial technical area to shape and own in a well-funded, growing AI startup.
  • Direct influence on MAIA’s architecture, reliability, security, and engineering productivity.
  • The opportunity to deepen your expertise in AI infrastructure and the operation of LLM workloads.
  • Close collaboration with our engineering team, CTO, and company leadership.
  • Short decision paths and the authority to move important infrastructure work forward.
  • €75,000–€85,000 gross annual salary, depending on experience and scope.
  • The opportunity to participate in our VSOP.
  • A permanent, full-time position with flexible working hours.
  • Fully remote work from anywhere within Germany.
  • Regular opportunities to meet and work with the team in Leipzig, with travel and accommodation covered.
  • Access to a WellPass fitness membership.

This role is open exclusively to candidates currently based in Germany. Applications from outside Germany cannot be considered for this position.

Our hiring process consists of three stages:

  1. A 30-minute introductory conversation.
  2. A 90-minute technical interview.
  3. A final conversation with company leadership.

We move quickly and keep you informed throughout the process.

Instead of a traditional cover letter, please send us your CV and brief answers to these three questions:

  1. What is the most critical production system you have personally operated, and what were you directly responsible for?
  2. Tell us about one infrastructure risk, incident, or reliability problem you identified and improved.
  3. Why does this remote role and its level of ownership fit the way you work?

Please write these answers yourself and do not submit an AI-generated cover letter. We are not assessing polished marketing language. We want to understand your actual experience, judgement, and motivation.

We review this remote opening against a deliberately focused profile. If your experience matches the core requirements and you are ready to take independent responsibility for a growing AI platform, we would like to hear from you.
